questions.question:
A man was charged with the armed robbery of a convenience store and pleaded not guilty. At trial, the man testified on direct examination that he had never been inside the store that was robbed. Intending the man to testify that he told police the same, the man's attorney then asked, "What, if anything, did you tell the police when you were arrested?" The prosecutor has objected.
Is the intended testimony admissible?

choices.a: No, because the man has a substantial motive to fabricate his testimony that he had never been inside the store.
choices.b: No, because the testimony is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.c: Yes, because the statement to police was made before the man had a motive to fabricate his testimony.
choices.d: Yes, to prove that the man had never been inside the store.

data.questionStem:
Q87059

A man was charged with the armed robbery of a convenience store and pleaded not guilty. At trial, the man testified on direct examination that he had never been inside the store that was robbed. Intending the man to testify that he told police the same, the man's attorney then asked, "What, if anything, did you tell the police when you were arrested?" The prosecutor has objected.

Is the intended testimony admissible?

一名男子被控告持械抢劫一家便利店，并作了无罪辩护。在庭审中，该男子在直接询问时作证称，他从未进入过被抢劫的那家商店。随后，该男子的律师意图让其证明他也对警察说了同样的话，于是问道：“在您被捕时，您对警察说了些什么（如果有的话）？”检察官对此提出了反对。

该预期的证言是否可被采纳？
options:
A. No, because the man has a substantial motive to fabricate his testimony.
否，因为该男子有重大的动机去捏造其证词。

B. No, because the testimony is hearsay not within any exception.
否，因为该证言是传闻证据，且不符合任何例外规定。

C. Yes, as a prior consistent statement.
是，作为先前的一致性陈述。

D. Yes, to prove that the man had never been inside the store.
是，用以证明该男子从未进入过该商店。
data.explanation:
Nonhearsay statements by declarant-witness


Prior statement of identification (FRE 801(d)(1))Identifies person as someone declarant perceived earlier
Prior inconsistent statementInconsistent with declarant's current testimony and made under penalty of perjury at former proceeding
Prior consistent statementConsistent with declarant's current testimony and offered to either:
  • rebut charge of fabrication/improper influence if made before motive arose or
  • rehabilitate declarant's credibility when attacked on other grounds
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Hearsay refers to out-of-court statements (eg, prior statement to the police) offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein (eg, that the man had never been inside the store). Such statements are inadmissible unless specifically excluded or excepted from the rule against hearsay. One hearsay exclusion applies when the declarant is on the witness stand and the out-of-court statement is:
  • consistent with the declarant-witness's current testimony and
  • offered to rebut a charge of fabrication/improper influence OR to rehabilitate the declarant-witness's credibility when attacked on other grounds.

Here, the man's prior statement is consistent with his current testimony that he had never been inside the store. But since the man has not been accused of fabrication or improper influence and his credibility has not been attacked, his intended testimony does not fall under the hearsay exclusion for prior consistent statements (Choice C). And since no other hearsay exclusion or exception applies, the man's intended testimony is not admissible.

(Choice A) The man may have a substantial motive to fabricate his testimony because he has been accused of a crime. That motive does not provide a basis to exclude otherwise admissible testimony but may be used by the prosecution to impeach the man by attacking his credibility as a witness.

(Choice D) The man's intended testimony cannot be admitted to prove that the man had never been inside the store because it is hearsay not within any exception.

Educational objective:
A declarant-witness's prior consistent statement is excluded from the rule against hearsay if it is offered (1) to rebut a charge of fabrication/improper influence or (2) to rehabilitate the witness's credibility.

选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 30%（正确选项），C选项 53%，D选项 13%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

由作为证人的陈述人所作的非传闻证据陈述


先前的指认陈述 (FRE 801(d)(1))指认某人即陈述人早前感知到的人
先前的不一致陈述与陈述人当前的证词不一致并且是在先前程序中以伪证罪处罚的宣誓下作出的
先前的一致性陈述与陈述人当前的证词一致并且提出用以：
  • 反驳关于捏造/不正当影响的指控，如果该陈述是在动机产生前作出的或者
  • 当陈述人的可信度因其他理由受到攻击时，恢复其可信度
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence)。

传闻证据是指庭外陈述（例如，先前对警察的陈述），其被提出是为了证明其所主张事项的真实性（例如，该男子从未进入过该商店）。除非被禁止传闻证据规则明确排除或作为例外，否则此类陈述不可采纳。当陈述人在证人席上，且其庭外陈述符合以下条件时，一项传闻证据排除规则适用：
  • 与作为证人的陈述人当前的证词相一致并且
  • 提出用以反驳关于捏造/不正当影响的指控，或在作为证人的陈述人的可信度因其他理由受到攻击时，用以恢复其可信度。

在本案中，该男子先前的陈述与其当前关于他从未进入过该商店的证词相一致。但由于该男子尚未被指控捏造或受不正当影响，其可信度也未受到攻击，因此他预期的证言不属于“先前一致性陈述”的传闻证据排除规则范畴 (选项C)。并且，由于没有其他传闻证据排除或例外规则适用，该男子预期的证言不可采纳。

(选项A) 该男子可能因为被指控犯罪而有重大的动机去捏造其证词。该动机本身不构成排除本可采纳的证词的依据，但检察官可以利用它来通过攻击该男子作为证人的可信度来弹劾他。

(选项D) 该男子预期的证言不能被采纳以证明他从未进入过该商店，因为这是传闻证据，且不符合任何例外规定。

教学目标：
作为证人的陈述人，其先前的一致性陈述在以下情况下被排除在禁止传闻证据规则之外：(1) 为反驳关于捏造/不正当影响的指控而提出，或 (2) 为恢复证人的可信度而提出。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 801(d)(1)(B) (declarant-witness's prior consistent statement).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence (证据法) - Hearsay (传闻证据)

核心考点：传闻证据与增信 (Bolstering)

本题考察的是联邦证据规则 (FRE) 801 关于传闻证据的定义以及“先前一致性陈述” (Prior Consistent Statement) 的适用条件。

关键事实：

  • 被告在直接询问 (Direct Examination) 阶段作证。
  • 被告试图引入自己之前对警察说的“我没进过那家店”的陈述。
  • 目的：证明他当时说的话和现在一样（即他是诚实的）。

正确答案解析：选项 B

结论：该证言不可采纳，因为它是传闻证据且不符合任何例外。

法律依据：

  1. 传闻证据 (Hearsay)： 被告在庭外（被捕时）所做的陈述，现在在庭上提出，目的是为了证明该陈述内容的真实性（即他确实没进过商店）。这符合 FRE 801(c) 的传闻定义。
  2. 自我增信 (Bolstering) 禁止： 一般规则是，证人不能通过引入先前的陈述来通过“自我印证”提升自己的可信度。
  3. 例外不适用： 虽然 FRE 801(d)(1)(B) 允许引入“先前一致性陈述”，但有一个严格的前提条件：必须是为了反驳关于“近期捏造” (Recent Fabrication) 或“不正当动机” (Improper Motive) 的指控。

本案分析： 此时正处于直接询问阶段，检察官尚未进行交叉询问 (Cross-Examination)，也没有指控被告在撒谎或有不良动机。因此，引入先前一致性陈述为时过早 (Premature)，仅仅属于不可采纳的传闻。

陷阱选项分析：选项 C

错误原因： 选项 C 认为是“先前一致性陈述”所以可采纳。这是 MBE 中最常见的陷阱之一。

区分关键：

  • 仅仅“一致”是不够的。 法律不允许证人仅仅因为“我以前也这么说过”来证明自己现在说的是真话。
  • 触发条件 (Trigger)： 只有当证人的可信度受到特定类型的攻击（如被指控最近才编造谎言）后，先前一致性陈述才可作为恢复名誉 (Rehabilitation) 的手段被引入。

其他选项简析

  • 选项 A (错误)： 证人有“捏造动机”是对方律师在交叉询问时用来弹劾 (Impeach) 证人的理由，而不是法官在直接询问时排除证词的理由。动机影响的是证据的分量 (Weight)，而非可采性 (Admissibility)。
  • 选项 D (错误)： 这恰恰描述了传闻证据的定义——为了证明所主张事项的真实性 (To prove the truth of the matter asserted)。正因为目的是为了证明他没进过商店，所以它是传闻，应当被排除。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

看到证人试图引用自己过去的陈述来支持现在的证词时，请立即警惕 "Bolstering" (增信) 问题。

记住公式：
直接询问 (Direct Exam) + 引用自己过去的一致陈述 = 通常不可采纳 (Inadmissible Hearsay)。

除非题目明确指出对方已经指控其“最近捏造” (Charge of recent fabrication)，否则不要选“先前一致性陈述”这个例外。

questions.question:
In a defendant's prosecution for assault, a witness is called to testify that the victim had complained to the witness that the defendant was the assailant.
When is the witness's testimony most likely to be admitted?

choices.a: The witness is a doctor whom the victim consulted for treatment.
choices.b: The witness is a minister whom the victim consulted for counseling.
choices.c: The witness is a police officer whom the victim called on instructions from her husband.
choices.d: The witness is the victim's husband whom she telephoned immediately after the event.

data.questionStem:
Q87046

In a defendant's prosecution for assault, a witness is called to testify that the victim had complained to the witness that the defendant was the assailant.

When is the witness's testimony most likely to be admitted?

在一起针对被告人的攻击罪（assault）诉讼中，一名证人被传唤作证，称受害人曾向该证人抱怨被告人是攻击者。

该证人的证言在何种情况下最有可能被采纳？
options:
A. The witness is a doctor whom the victim consulted for treatment.
该证人是受害人为寻求治疗而咨询的医生。

B. The witness is a minister whom the victim consulted for counseling.
该证人是受害人为寻求心理辅导而咨询的牧师。

C. The witness is a police officer whom the victim called on instructions from her husband.
该证人是受害人根据其丈夫的指示呼叫的警官。

D. The witness is the victim's husband whom she telephoned immediately after the event.
该证人是受害人的丈夫，她在事件发生后立即给他打了电话。
data.explanation:
Reasoning for common hearsay exceptions


ExceptionReason for reliability
Present sense impression
Excited utterance		No time to fabricate statement
Past recollection recordedRecords made when fresh in person's mind
Then-existing mental/physical conditionPersons can perceive their own mental or physical state
Statement for medical diagnosis/treatmentSelf-interest creates motive for truth
Business & public records
Documents & statements on property interest
Certificates of birth, marriage, baptism		Accuracy verified to preserve legal rights & reputation
Hearsay is an out-of-court statement offered for the truth of the matter asserted therein. This type of statement is presumed unreliable and is therefore generally inadmissible. But certain statements are excepted from the rule against hearsay because they are inherently reliable (eg, because they would be hard to fabricate). This includes:
  • excited utterances - statements related to a startling event or condition that are made while the declarant is still under the stress of excitement from the event or condition and
  • present sense impressions - statements describing or explaining an event or condition that are made while or immediately after the declarant perceived it.


Here, a witness seeks to testify that the victim had complained to the witness that the defendant was her assailant. This out-of-court statement is hearsay since it is being offered for its truth. But if the witness is the victim's husband - whom she telephoned immediately after the assault - the victim's statement likely qualifies as an excited utterance or present sense impression. Therefore, testimony on this statement would most likely be admissible.

(Choice A) Another hearsay exception exists for statements made for and reasonably pertinent to medical diagnosis or treatment that describe the declarant's medical history, symptoms, or their inception or general cause. Therefore, the doctor could testify to the victim's statements about her medical condition - but not about the assailant's identity (unrelated to the victim's medical care).

(Choices B & C) No hearsay exception exists for out-of-court statements made to clergy (eg, a minister) for the purpose of receiving counsel or for statements made to law enforcement (eg, a police officer).

Educational objective: Statements excepted from hearsay include statements (1) related to a startling event or condition made while the declarant is still under stress from it (ie, excited utterances) and (2) describing or explaining an event or condition made while or immediately after the declarant perceived it (ie, present sense impressions).

选项正确率统计：A选项 11%，B选项 0%，C选项 14%，D选项 72%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

常见传闻证据例外的理由


例外可靠性原因
即时感官印象
激动言辞		没有时间捏造陈述
过往记忆记录记录制作时，当事人记忆犹新
当时存在的精神/身体状况个人能够感知自己的精神或身体状态
为医疗诊断/治疗目的作出的陈述自身利益促使说出真相
商业和公共记录
关于财产权益的文件和陈述
出生、结婚、洗礼证明		为维护合法权利和声誉而核实准确性
传闻证据（Hearsay）是指在庭外作出，并为证明其所述事项的真实性而提出的陈述。这类陈述被推定为不可靠，因此通常不予采纳。但某些陈述因其内在的可靠性（例如，因为它们难以捏造）而被排除在传闻证据规则之外，成为例外。这包括：
  • 激动言辞 - 与某一惊人事件或状况相关的陈述，且陈述人在作出该陈述时仍处于该事件或状况所致的激动压力之下，并且
  • 即时感官印象 - 描述或解释某一事件或状况的陈述，且陈述人在感知到该事件或状况的同时或之后立即作出该陈述。


在本案中，一名证人试图作证称，受害人曾向其抱怨被告人是攻击者。这一庭外陈述因其被用于证明所述事项的真实性而构成传闻证据。但如果证人是受害人的丈夫——她在攻击事件发生之后立即给他打了电话——那么受害人的陈述很可能符合激动言辞或即时感官印象的条件。因此，关于此陈述的证言极有可能被采纳。

(选项 A) 另一个传闻证据例外是为医疗诊断或治疗目的而作出、且与此合理相关的陈述，这些陈述描述了陈述人的病史、症状、其发病或一般病因。因此，医生可以就受害人关于其医疗状况的陈述作证——但不能就攻击者的身份作证（这与受害人的医疗无关）。

(选项 B 和 C) 对于为寻求辅导而向神职人员（如牧师）作出的庭外陈述，或向执法人员（如警官）作出的陈述，不存在传闻证据例外。

教学目标：传闻证据的例外情况包括：(1) 与惊人事件或状况相关的陈述，作出陈述时陈述人仍处于该事件所带来的压力之下（即激动言辞）；以及 (2) 描述或解释某一事件或状况的陈述，作出陈述时陈述人正在感知或刚刚感知到该事件（即时感官印象）。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 803(1)-(2) (hearsay exceptions - present sense impression, excited utterance).

MBE 考点解析

证据法 (Evidence) - 传闻证据例外
核心考点：传闻证据 (Hearsay)

庭外陈述（Out-of-court statement）如果用于证明其所述内容的真实性（Truth of the matter asserted），即为传闻证据，原则上不可采纳，除非符合法定例外。

✅ 正确答案分析 (选项 D)

正确理由

证人是受害人的丈夫，她在事件发生后立即给他打了电话。

这里适用的法律规则是 FRE 803(1) 即时感官印象 (Present Sense Impression) 或 FRE 803(2) 激动言辞 (Excited Utterance)。

  • 激动言辞 (Excited Utterance): 与惊人事件（攻击）有关的陈述，且是在受害人仍处于该事件造成的压力/兴奋状态下作出的。
  • 即时感官印象 (Present Sense Impression): 描述或解释某一事件，且是在感知该事件时或感知后立即 (immediately) 作出的。

🔑 破题关键： 题目中的 "Immediately"（立即）一词是 MBE 考试中暗示这两个例外的强烈信号。受害人在攻击后立即打电话，此时她既没有时间编造谎言（保证了可靠性），也仍处于事件的影响之下。

❌ 干扰项分析

选项 A (医生)

陷阱：医疗诊断例外 (FRE 803(4))

虽然为医疗诊断目的所作的陈述是传闻例外，但这通常仅限于描述症状、病史或受伤的起因。

为什么错： 关于"是谁"造成了伤害（攻击者的身份）通常被认为与医疗诊断或治疗无关。医生不需要知道是谁打了受害人才能治疗她的伤口。因此，指认被告的部分不符合此例外。

选项 B (牧师) & C (警察)

普通传闻

仅仅因为听众是牧师或警察，并不会自动产生传闻证据的例外。

  • 牧师： 可能涉及特权（Privilege），但特权是用来拒绝作证的，而不是让传闻证据变得可采纳。
  • 警察： 受害人对警察的陈述通常被视为“证言性”（Testimonial），在刑事案件中若受害人不出庭，甚至可能违反《第六修正案》对质条款。且警察报告本身在针对被告时通常不符合公共记录例外。
🎓 MBE 实战技巧

看到 "Hearsay" 问题时，按以下步骤思考：

  1. 定位陈述： 谁在庭外说了什么？（受害人说“被告是凶手”）
  2. 确定目的： 是否为了证明内容属实？（是的，为了证明被告确实是凶手） -> 它是传闻。
  3. 寻找例外：
    看到 "Immediately" -> 优先考虑 Present Sense Impression。
    看到 "Screamed", "Crying", "Excited" -> 优先考虑 Excited Utterance。
    看到 "Doctor" -> 警惕 Identity（身份）通常不被采纳。

questions.question:
A defendant is on trial for bribing a government procurement officer by providing the officer with free vacation facilities. When the defendant was approached by an FBI investigator, the defendant stated that her invitation to the procurement officer to spend his vacation in the defendant's mountain cabin was a favor to a friend, unrelated to his government office. The defendant also said to the investigator that she would reveal some "hot" information on a large-scale fraud in exchange for the investigator's promise to "stop worrying about a little vacation."
Is the investigator's testimony about the defendant's offer to give information admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: No, because the defendant made the offer in a negotiation for settlement of a criminal investigation.
choices.c: Yes, as a matter observed and reported by the investigator pursuant to a duty imposed by law.
choices.d: Yes, as a statement of an opposing party.

data.questionStem:
Q87814 A defendant is on trial for bribing a government procurement officer by providing the officer with free vacation facilities. When the defendant was approached by an FBI investigator, the defendant stated that her invitation to the procurement officer to spend his vacation in the defendant's mountain cabin was a favor to a friend, unrelated to his government office. The defendant also said to the investigator that she would reveal some "hot" information on a large-scale fraud in exchange for the investigator's promise to "stop worrying about a little vacation."

Is the investigator's testimony about the defendant's offer to give information admissible? 一名被告因向一名政府采购官员提供免费度假设施而以贿赂罪受审。当被告被联邦调查局（FBI）调查员约谈时，被告声称她邀请采购官员到她的山间小屋度假是对朋友的帮助，与他的政府职务无关。被告还对调查员说，她可以透露一些关于大规模欺诈的“猛料”，以换取调查员承诺“不再为一个小小的假期操心”。

调查员关于被告提出提供信息提议的证词是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
不可采纳，因为这是不符合任何例外的传闻证据。

B. No, because the defendant made the offer in a negotiation for settlement of a criminal investigation.
不可采纳，因为被告是在刑事调查的和解谈判中提出的这一提议。

C. Yes, as a matter observed and reported by the investigator pursuant to a duty imposed by law.
可采纳，作为调查员根据法律规定的职责所观察和报告的事项。

D. Yes, as a statement of an opposing party.
可采纳，作为对方当事人的陈述。
data.explanation:
Nonhearsay statements (FRE 801(d))


Statement by declarant-witnessOut-of-court statement admissible if witness subject to cross-examination & prior statement:
is inconsistent with current testimony & was made under penalty of perjury
is consistent with current testimony & offered to (1) rebut charge of fabrication/improper influence or (2) rehabilitate witness or
identifies person witness perceived earlier
Statement by party-opponentOut-of-court statement admissible if offered against opposing party & statement was:
made or adopted by party
made by person authorized by party
made by party's agent/employee on matter within scope of relationship or
made by party's coconspirator during & in furtherance of conspiracy
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Under the rule against hearsay, out-of-court statements offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein are generally inadmissible. But under Federal Rule of Evidence (FRE) 801, some out-of-court statements being offered for their truth are excluded from this rule and therefore are nonhearsay. One hearsay exclusion applies to statements made by and offered against an opposing party.

As a result, the defendant's offer to give information to the FBI investigator is admissible as a statement of an opposing party (Choice A).

(Choice B) Under FRE 408 and 410, statements made during settlement or plea negotiations are generally inadmissible because public policy encourages the settlement of disputes. But for these rules to apply, both parties must intend to enter settlement negotiations (not seen here). Additionally, in a criminal case, the statements must be made to a prosecuting attorney—not a law enforcement agent (as seen here).

(Choice C) The public records exception to the hearsay rule applies to a public office's records or statements that set out (1) office activities, (2) matters observed by an office representative while under a legal duty to report, and (3) in a civil case or against the government in a criminal case, factual findings from a legally authorized investigation. But this exception is inapplicable here since the defendant's statement is nonhearsay.

Educational objective: Statements made by an opposing party that are offered against that party are excluded from the hearsay rule.

非传闻证据陈述 (《联邦证据规则》第801(d)条)


陈述人-证人作出的陈述庭外陈述可采纳，如果证人接受了交叉询问且先前的陈述：
与当前证词不一致且是在伪证罪处罚的约束下作出的
与当前证词一致且用于(1)反驳关于捏造/不正当影响的指控或(2)恢复证人信誉 或者
指认证人早些时候感知到的人
对方当事人的陈述庭外陈述可采纳，如果用于对抗对方当事人且该陈述是：
由该当事人作出或采纳的
由该当事人授权的人作出的
由该当事人的代理人/雇员在关系范围内就相关事项作出的 或者
由该当事人的同谋在共谋期间为促进共谋而作出的
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》（Federal Rule of Evidence）。

根据反对传闻证据的规则，为证明其所主张事项的真实性而提出的庭外陈述通常是不可采纳的。但根据《联邦证据规则》（FRE）第801条，一些为证明其真实性而提出的庭外陈述被排除在该规则之外，因此属于非传闻证据。其中一项传闻证据排除规则适用于由对方当事人作出并用于对抗该当事人的陈述。

因此，被告向FBI调查员提出提供信息的提议，作为对方当事人的陈述是可采纳的（选项D）。

(选项B) 根据《联邦证据规则》第408条和第410条，在和解或认罪协商期间作出的陈述通常是不可采纳的，因为公共政策鼓励解决争议。但要适用这些规则，双方必须都有意图进行和解谈判（此处情况并非如此）。此外，在刑事案件中，陈述必须是向检察官作出——而不是向执法人员作出（如此处所示）。

(选项C) 传闻证据规则的公共记录例外适用于公共机构的记录或陈述，这些记录或陈述列出了(1)机构的活动，(2)机构代表在有法律报告义务的情况下观察到的事项，以及(3)在民事案件中或在刑事案件中用于对抗政府的、来自合法授权调查的事实认定。但此例外在此处不适用，因为被告的陈述属于非传闻证据。

教学目的： 由对方当事人作出并用于对抗该当事人的陈述，被排除在传闻证据规则之外。

References
Fed. R. Evid. 801(d)(2) (opposing party's statement is not hearsay).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 证据法考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay & Exclusions
正确答案：D 是的，作为对方当事人的陈述 (Statement of an opposing party)。
⚖️ 核心考点：非传闻证据
Federal Rule of Evidence 801(d)(2) 对方当事人陈述 (Statement of an Opposing Party)：
如果一项陈述是由一方当事人作出的，并且由对方当事人作为证据提出用来针对该当事人，那么该陈述不属于传闻证据 (Non-hearsay)，因此可以直接采纳。

在证据法中，这不仅仅是一个“例外 (Exception)”，而是被定义为“排除 (Exclusion)”，即它从根本上就不被视为传闻。

🔍 逻辑推演
1.
陈述人是谁？
被告 (The Defendant)。她是本案的当事人。
2.
谁在提供证据？
检方（通过FBI调查员的证词）。检方是被告的“对方当事人” (Opposing Party)。
3.
结论：
被告对自己不利的陈述（试图贿赂/交换条件），只要是由检方提出的，就是可采纳的。不需要寻找其他复杂的传闻例外。
⚠️ 常见陷阱 (Distractor Analysis)

为什么选项 B (和解谈判) 是错误的？

很多考生会误以为这是“认罪协商 (Plea Negotiation)”。根据 FRE 410，认罪协商中的陈述确实通常不可采纳，但本题有两个关键点使其不适用：

  1. 对象错误：FRE 410 保护的是与检察官 (Prosecuting Attorney) 的谈判。FBI 探员是执法人员，通常没有权力进行认罪协商，除非有明确授权（本题未提及）。
  2. 性质错误：被告试图用“猛料”换取调查员“不再操心”，这更像是贿赂或妨碍司法的企图，而非善意的法律和解谈判。
💡 考试技巧 (MBE Tips)

在处理 MBE 证据法题目时，请遵循以下思维导图：

  • 看到庭外陈述 (Out-of-court statement)？ → 怀疑是传闻。
  • 陈述人是被告/当事人吗？ → 检查 801(d)(2)。
  • 如果是当事人陈述且被对方使用 → 直接选“可采纳” (Admissible as Non-hearsay)。
  • 不要被“这是否属于公共记录”或“是否属于反对利益声明”等其他选项干扰，801(d)(2) 是最直接的路径。
© MBE 备考助手 | 依据 Federal Rules of Evidence 解析

questions.question:
A plaintiff has sued a defendant for personal injuries the plaintiff suffered when she was bitten as she was trying to feed a rat that was part of the defendant's caged-rat experiment at a science fair. At trial, the plaintiff offers evidence that immediately after the incident the defendant said to her, "I'd like to give you this $100 bill because I feel so bad about this."
Is the defendant's statement admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is not relevant to the issue of liability.
choices.b: No, because it was an offer of compromise.
choices.c: Yes, as a present sense impression.
choices.d: Yes, as the statement of a party-opponent.

data.questionStem:
Q87009

A plaintiff has sued a defendant for personal injuries the plaintiff suffered when she was bitten as she was trying to feed a rat that was part of the defendant's caged-rat experiment at a science fair. At trial, the plaintiff offers evidence that immediately after the incident the defendant said to her, "I'd like to give you this $100 bill because I feel so bad about this."

Is the defendant's statement admissible?

一名原告因人身伤害起诉了一名被告。该伤害是原告在一次科学展览会上试图喂养一只作为被告笼鼠实验一部分的老鼠时被咬伤所致。在庭审中，原告提供证据，证明事件发生后，被告立即对她说：“我想给你这100美元，因为我对此感到非常抱歉。”

被告的陈述是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because it is not relevant to the issue of liability.
否，因为它与责任问题不相关。

B. No, because it was an offer of compromise.
否，因为这是一个和解要约。

C. Yes, as a present sense impression.
是，作为当前感官印象。

D. Yes, as the statement of a party-opponent.
是，作为对方当事人的陈述。
data.explanation:
Nonhearsay statement by party-opponent


(FRE 801(d)) Out-of-court statement is nonhearsay if offered against opposing party AND:
  • made or adopted by opposing party
  • made by person authorized by opposing party to make statement on subject
  • made by opposing party's agent/employee on matter within scope of relationship

OR
  • made by opposing party's coconspirator during & in furtherance of conspiracy
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

An out-of-court statement offered for the truth of the matter asserted therein is generally inadmissible under the hearsay rule. But when such a statement is made by and offered against a party-opponent , it is excluded from the hearsay rule (ie, is nonhearsay). Therefore, the opposing party's statement is admissible as substantive evidence so long as it is relevant and not prohibited by another evidentiary rule - eg, the rule barring offers of compromise (raised here).

An offer of compromise (ie, a settlement offer) is inadmissible to prove the validity or amount of a disputed claim. But this rule only applies if there was an actual dispute regarding a party's liability or the value of a claim at the time the offer was made. Since there is no indication that the present dispute over the defendant's liability existed when the defendant offered the plaintiff $100, this rule does not apply (Choice B). Therefore, this party-opponent's statement is admissible.

(Choice A) Evidence is relevant if it has any tendency to make a material fact more or less probable. The defendant's offer and remorseful statement tend to prove that the defendant is at fault for the plaintiff's injuries. Therefore, the statement is relevant.

(Choice C) A present sense impression is a hearsay exception for out-of-court statements about an event made during or immediately after the declarant perceived it. But the defendant's statement here needs no such exception because it is a statement of a party-opponent (ie, nonhearsay).

Educational objective: A statement made by an opposing party is excluded from the rule against hearsay when offered against that party.

选项正确率统计：A选项 13%，B选项 35%，C选项 3%，D选项 47%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

对方当事人的非传闻陈述


(FRE 801(d)) 如果庭外陈述是为反驳对方当事人而提出，并且符合以下条件之一，则该陈述不属于传闻：
  • 由对方当事人作出或采纳
  • 由对方当事人授权就该事项作出陈述的人所作出
  • 由对方当事人的代理人/雇员在代理/雇佣关系范围内就相关事项所作出

或
  • 由对方当事人的共同合谋人在合谋期间为推进合谋而作出
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence)。

为证明其所述事项的真实性而提出的庭外陈述，根据传闻规则通常是不可采纳的。但是，当该陈述由对方当事人作出并用以反驳该当事人时，它被排除在传闻规则之外（即，属于非传闻证据）。因此，只要对方当事人的陈述具有相关性，且不为其他证据规则所禁止——例如，禁止和解要约的规则（本案中提出的）——该陈述即可作为实体证据采纳。

和解要约（即和解提议）不可采纳用以证明一项有争议的索赔的有效性或金额。但该规则仅适用于在要约作出之时，就一方当事人的责任或索赔价值存在实际争议的情况。由于没有迹象表明，在被告向原告提供100美元时，当前关于被告责任的争议已经存在，因此该规则不适用（选项B）。因此，此对方当事人的陈述是可采纳的。

（选项A）如果证据具有任何能使某一重要事实变得更可能或更不可能的倾向，则该证据具有相关性。被告的提议和带有悔意的陈述倾向于证明被告对原告的伤害负有责任。因此，该陈述是相关的。

（选项C）当前感官印象是传闻规则的一项例外，适用于陈述人在感知到某一事件之时或之后立即作出的关于该事件的庭外陈述。但本案中被告的陈述无需此项例外，因为它属于对方当事人的陈述（即，非传闻证据）。

教学目标：由对方当事人作出的陈述，在被用以反驳该当事人时，被排除在反传闻规则之外。

References

  • Fed. R. Evid. 801(d) (nonhearsay statements).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 408 (compromise offers and negotiations).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考题解析

Evidence / Hearsay
正确答案：D
Yes, as the statement of a party-opponent.
(是，作为对方当事人的陈述。)

本题考察的是证据法中关于传闻证据（Hearsay）的核心规则及其豁免情况，特别是如何区分“和解要约”与“当事人陈述”。

核心考点：对方当事人陈述 (FRE 801(d)(2)) 根据《联邦证据规则》(FRE)，如果一项庭外陈述是由对方当事人（Party-Opponent）作出的，并且被用来反对该当事人，那么该陈述在定义上不属于传闻（Non-hearsay）。

在本案中：
  • 陈述人：被告（Defendant）。
  • 提出者：原告（Plaintiff）。
  • 用途：用来证明被告有责任（反对被告）。
因此，这属于典型的“对方当事人陈述”，可以直接作为实体证据采纳。

为什么选项 B 是最大的陷阱？

许多考生会误选 B (Offer of Compromise)，因为被告提到了给钱（$100）。

MBE 破题关键：时间点与争议的存在。

根据 FRE 408（和解要约规则），要排除证据，必须满足前提：在陈述作出时，双方必须已经存在关于责任或金额的实际争议（Disputed Claim）。

题目明确指出被告是在事件发生后“立即”（immediately）说的这句话。此时：
  • 原告还没有提出索赔。
  • 双方还没有就责任发生争执。
  • 甚至连律师都还没介入。
既然没有“争议”，就不存在“和解”。因此，这只是一个自发的承认（Admission），不受 FRE 408 保护，可以被采纳。

其他选项解析

  • 选项 A (Relevance)：错误。相关性的门槛很低。被告道歉并给钱，倾向于表明他觉得自己有错（Consciousness of guilt），这显然与责任问题相关。
  • 选项 C (Present Sense Impression)：不准确。虽然这句话可能符合“当前感官印象”的定义（描述刚刚发生的事件），但在 MBE 考试中，如果一个陈述既符合传闻例外（Exception），又符合传闻豁免/非传闻（Exemption/Non-hearsay），通常优先选择后者（即选项 D），因为它是更直接的采纳理由。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip) 看到“我给你钱”或“对不起”，首先检查时间点：
1. 事故现场立即说：通常是 Party Admission，可采纳。
2. 收到律师函或起诉后说：通常是 Settlement Offer，不可采纳。

questions.question:
In an automobile collision case, the plaintiff introduced evidence that a bystander made an excited utterance that the defendant ran a red light. The defendant called a witness to testify that later the bystander, now deceased, told the witness that the defendant went through a yellow light.
Is the witness's testimony admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: No, because the bystander is not available to explain or deny the inconsistency.
choices.c: Yes, as impeachment and as substantive evidence of the color of the light.
choices.d: Yes, but only for the purpose of impeaching the bystander.

data.questionStem:
Q87058

In an automobile collision case, the plaintiff introduced evidence that a bystander made an excited utterance that the defendant ran a red light. The defendant called a witness to testify that later the bystander, now deceased, told the witness that the defendant went through a yellow light.

Is the witness's testimony admissible?

在一起汽车碰撞案件中，原告提出证据，证明一名旁观者曾作出激动陈述（excited utterance），称被告闯了红灯。被告传唤一名证人作证，称后来该旁观者（现已去世）告诉该证人，被告通过的是黄灯。

该证人的证词是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
否，因为该证词是传闻证据，且不属于任何例外情况。

B. No, because the bystander is not available to explain or deny the inconsistency.
否，因为该旁观者无法出庭解释或否认该不一致之处。

C. Yes, as impeachment and as substantive evidence of the color of the light.
是，可用于弹劾，并可作为交通灯颜色的实质性证据。

D. Yes, but only for the purpose of impeaching the bystander.
是，但仅可用于弹劾该旁观者。
data.explanation:
Impeachment with inconsistent statements


TypeUseMethods of introduction
Witness's prior inconsistent statement
(FRE 613)		Impeach witness's trial testimonyExamining witness about prior statement

Introducing extrinsic evidence if:
witness can address & opposing party can question witness about statement or justice so requires
Hearsay declarant's inconsistent statement
(FRE 806)		Impeach declarant's hearsay statementIntroducing extrinsic evidence regardless of:
when inconsistent statement occurred or whether declarant had opportunity to address statement
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence

Hearsay is an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein and is inadmissible unless it falls within a hearsay exception or exclusion. If the hearsay statement is admitted, the declarant's credibility may be attacked† with the same methods used to impeach a testifying witness - eg, an inconsistent statement. Such a statement may be used for impeachment regardless of whether:
  • it was made before or after the hearsay statement or
  • the declarant had an opportunity to explain or deny the inconsistency (Choice B).

However, the inconsistent statement may not be used as substantive evidence (ie, for its truth) unless it is also excepted or excluded from the hearsay rule.

Here, the bystander's hearsay statement - that the defendant ran a red light - was admitted as an excited utterance. Therefore, the defendant can offer testimony regarding the bystander's inconsistent statement - that the light was yellow - for the purpose of impeaching the bystander. But that statement is not admissible as substantive evidence of the light's color because it is not excepted or excluded from the hearsay rule (Choice C).

†Once attacked, evidence supporting the declarant's credibility may then be admitted.

(Choice A) The bystander's inconsistent statement is not hearsay since it is being used to impeach the bystander - not to prove the truth of the matter asserted (that the light was yellow).

Educational objective: A hearsay declarant's credibility may be attacked using any method allowed to impeach a testifying witness, including offering evidence of the declarant's inconsistent statement. But that statement may not be used as substantive evidence (ie, for its truth) unless it is also excepted or excluded from the hearsay rule.

选项正确率统计：A选项 16%，B选项 12%，C选项 11%，D选项 59%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

用前后不一致的陈述进行弹劾


类型用途引入方法
证人先前的不一致陈述
(FRE 613)		弹劾证人的庭审证词就先前陈述质询证人

在以下情况下可引入外来证据：
证人有机会说明，且对方当事人有机会就该陈述质询证人或司法公正要求如此
传闻证据陈述人的不一致陈述
(FRE 806)		弹劾陈述人的传闻陈述引入外来证据，无论：
不一致陈述作出的时间或陈述人是否有机会说明该陈述
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence)

传闻证据是指为证明其所述事项的真实性而提出的庭外陈述，并且是不可采纳的，除非其属于传闻证据规则的例外或排除情形。如果传闻陈述被采纳，则陈述人的可信度可被攻击†，其方法与弹劾出庭作证的证人相同——例如，使用前后不一致的陈述。此类陈述可用于弹劾，无论：
  • 其是在传闻陈述之前或之后作出 或
  • 陈述人是否有机会解释或否认该不一致之处 (选项 B)。

然而，该不一致陈述不得用作实质性证据（即，用于证明其真实性），除非它本身也属于传闻证据规则的例外或排除情形。

在本案中，旁观者的传闻陈述——即被告闯了红灯——作为激动陈述被采纳。因此，被告可以就旁观者的不一致陈述——即当时是黄灯——提供证词，以弹劾该旁观者。但该陈述不能作为证明交通灯颜色的实质性证据被采纳，因为它不属于传闻证据规则的例外或排除情形 (选项 C)。

†一旦其可信度被攻击，支持该陈述人可信度的证据便可被采纳。

(选项 A) 旁观者的不一致陈述不是传闻证据，因为它被用作弹劾该旁观者——而非用以证明其所陈述事项的真实性（即当时是黄灯）。

教学目的：传闻证据陈述人的可信度，可以使用任何允许用来弹劾出庭作证证人的方法进行攻击，包括提供该陈述人前后不一致的陈述作为证据。但该不一致陈述不得用作实质性证据（即，为证明其真实性），除非它本身也属于传闻证据规则的例外或排除情形。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 806 (attacking and supporting a declarant's credibility).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：传闻陈述人的弹劾

本题考察的核心是《联邦证据规则》第806条 (FRE 806)，即如何攻击不在庭上的传闻陈述人（Hearsay Declarant）的可信度。

⚖️ 核心规则 (FRE 806) 当一条传闻证据（Hearsay）被法庭采纳后，该陈述人的可信度可以被攻击，攻击方式与该陈述人亲自出庭作证时完全一致。
🔍 案情逻辑分析
  1. 陈述 A（红灯）：旁观者的"激动陈述" (Excited Utterance)。这是传闻，但符合例外，因此已被采纳。
  2. 陈述 B（黄灯）：旁观者后来的陈述。这与陈述 A 不一致。
  3. 被告的目的：引入陈述 B 来攻击陈述 A 的可信度。

为什么选 D？(法律推理)

1. 可用于弹劾 (Impeachment)：
根据 FRE 806，既然旁观者的第一句话（红灯）作为证据进入了法庭，被告就有权攻击这个旁观者的可信度。证明该旁观者后来讲了不一样的话（黄灯），是经典的"先前不一致陈述" (Prior Inconsistent Statement) 弹劾手段。因此，该证词是可以采纳的。

2. 不可作为实质性证据 (Not Substantive Evidence)：
虽然陈述 B 可以用来证明旁观者"说话前后矛盾"，从而降低其可信度，但陈述 B 本身也是传闻（庭外陈述，为了证明当时是黄灯）。
除非陈述 B 也符合某个传闻例外（题目未提及），否则它不能用来直接证明"当时确实是黄灯"。它只能用来证明"旁观者不可信"。

🚫 关键区别：FRE 613 vs. FRE 806

这是本题最大的陷阱（排除选项 B）：

  • 弹劾出庭证人 (FRE 613)：通常要求给证人解释不一致的机会。
  • 弹劾传闻陈述人 (FRE 806)：不需要给陈述人解释或否认的机会。

因此，即使旁观者已去世（无法解释），也不影响被告引入不一致陈述进行弹劾。

其他选项为何错误？

  • 选项 A： 错误。虽然它是传闻，但如果仅用于弹劾（不为了证明事实真相），则不被视为传闻排除规则下的不可采纳证据。
  • 选项 B： 错误。如上所述，FRE 806 明确规定，弹劾传闻陈述人时，无需该陈述人有解释或否认的机会。
  • 选项 C： 错误。它不能作为实质性证据 (Substantive Evidence)。因为"黄灯"这句话本身是普通的庭外陈述，没有符合任何传闻例外（如激动陈述、临终遗言等），所以不能用来证明灯真的是黄色的。
💡 考试技巧：
在 MBE 证据法题目中，当看到"不一致陈述" (Inconsistent Statement) 时，务必区分两个用途： 1. 弹劾 (Impeachment)： 几乎总是允许。 2. 实质性证据 (Substantive Truth)： 只有当该陈述本身符合传闻例外（或非传闻定义）时才允许。

questions.question:
A defendant has been charged with drug trafficking. Prior to trial, a woman who intended to testify against the defendant was savagely attacked and left comatose. At a pretrial hearing, the prosecution called the defendant's neighbor, who testified that the defendant said he was no longer worried about the woman testifying because he "took care of her." At trial, the prosecution has called a narcotics detective to testify to the woman's formal statement to the police, which detailed the defendant's role in a large-scale drug trafficking operation.
Is the detective's testimony admissible?

choices.a: No, because the testimony is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: No, because the testimony violates the confrontation clause.
choices.c: Yes, as a prior identification of the defendant.
choices.d: Yes, as a statement against a party who caused the declarant's unavailability.

data.questionStem:
Q87018

A defendant has been charged with drug trafficking. Prior to trial, a woman who intended to testify against the defendant was savagely attacked and left comatose. At a pretrial hearing, the prosecution called the defendant's neighbor, who testified that the defendant said he was no longer worried about the woman testifying because he "took care of her." At trial, the prosecution has called a narcotics detective to testify to the woman's formal statement to the police, which detailed the defendant's role in a large-scale drug trafficking operation.

Is the detective's testimony admissible?

一名被告被指控犯有贩毒罪。在审判前，一名原打算作证指控该被告的女性遭到野蛮袭击，陷入昏迷。在一次审前听证会上，控方传唤了被告的邻居，邻居作证称，被告说他不再担心那名女性作证了，因为他“已经把她处理掉了”。在审判中，控方传唤了一名缉毒警探，以就该女性向警方作出的正式陈述作证，该陈述详细说明了被告在一个大规模贩毒活动中的角色。

该警探的证言是否可以采纳？
options:
A. No, because the testimony is hearsay not within any exception.
不可以，因为该证言属于传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。

B. No, because the testimony violates the confrontation clause.
不可以，因为该证言违反了对质条款。

C. Yes, as a prior identification of the defendant.
可以，作为对被告的事先指认。

D. Yes, as a statement against a party who caused the declarant's unavailability.
可以，作为对导致陈述人无法作证的一方当事人不利的陈述。
data.explanation:
The rule against hearsay bars the admission of out-of-court statements offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein - eg, the woman's statement to the police implicating the defendant in drug trafficking. However, statements made by a declarant who is unavailable to testify as a witness may be excepted from this rule. One exception applies when an unavailable declarant's hearsay statement is offered against a party who:
  • wrongfully caused, or acquiesced in wrongfully causing, the declarant's unavailability and did so intending that result.
The party seeking to admit the hearsay statement under this exception must prove the above elements by a preponderance of the evidence.

Here, the defendant's neighbor testified at the pretrial hearing that the defendant said he was no longer worried about the woman testifying at trial because he "took care of her." This testimony established, by a preponderance of the evidence, that the defendant wrongfully caused the woman's unavailability as a witness and did so intending that result. Therefore, the detective's testimony as to the woman's statement is admissible under this hearsay exception (Choice A).

(Choice B) The Sixth Amendment confrontation clause bars the admission of testimonial statements made by an unavailable hearsay declarant unless the defendant has had the opportunity to cross-examine that declarant. However, this right is forfeited by wrongdoing when, as here, a criminal defendant wrongfully causes a declarant's unavailability with the intent to procure that result.

(Choice C) One hearsay exclusion (ie, nonhearsay) applies when a declarant testifies and is subject to cross-examination about a prior statement that identified someone the declarant had perceived earlier. But this exclusion does not apply here because the woman is unavailable to testify.

Educational objective: An unavailable declarant's statement offered against a party who (1) wrongfully caused, or acquiesced in wrongfully causing, the declarant's unavailability as a witness and (2) did so intending that result is excepted from the rule against hearsay.



选项正确率统计：A选项 12%，B选项 8%，C选项 4%，D选项 74%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

反传闻证据规则禁止采纳为证明其所述事项的真实性而提出的庭外陈述——例如，该女性向警方作出的、牵涉被告参与贩毒的陈述。然而，作为证人无法出庭作证的陈述人所作的陈述，可以作为该规则的例外。其中一种例外情况适用于，当无法作证的陈述人的传闻证据被用于指控符合以下条件的一方当事人时：
  • 该当事人不法地导致或默许不法地导致陈述人无法作证，并且其行为意图在于造成该结果。
寻求根据此例外采纳传闻证据的一方，必须以“优势证据”标准证明上述要素。

在本案中，被告的邻居在审前听证会上作证称，被告说他不再担心那名女性在审判中作证，因为他“已经把她处理掉了”。该证言以优势证据标准证明了，被告不法地导致该女性作为证人无法作证，并且其行为意图在于造成该结果。因此，该警探关于该女性陈述的证言，根据此传闻证据例外规则是可采纳的（选项A）。

（选项B） 《第六修正案》的对质条款禁止采纳无法作证的传闻陈述人所作的证言性陈述，除非被告曾有机会对该陈述人进行交叉询问。然而，当刑事被告，如本案情形，为达成目的而不法地导致陈述人无法作证时，该项权利因不法行为而被没收。

（选项C） 有一种传闻证据排除（即，非传闻证据）适用于当陈述人出庭作证，并就其先前指认其早前所感知之人的陈述接受交叉询问的情况。但此排除规则在此不适用，因为该女性无法出庭作证。

教学目标：一个无法作证的陈述人所作的、用于指控一方当事人的陈述，如果该当事人（1）不法地导致或默许不法地导致该陈述人作为证人无法作证，并且（2）其行为意图在于造成该结果，则该陈述属于反传闻证据规则的例外情况。

References

  • Fed. R. Evid. 804(b)(6) (statement against party who caused declarant's unavailability).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence & Hearsay Exceptions
核心考点：因不法行为导致的权利丧失 Forfeiture by Wrongdoing (FRE 804(b)(6))

如果一方当事人不法地导致（或默许导致）证人无法出庭，且其意图正是为了阻止该证人作证，则该当事人丧失对该证人陈述提出传闻证据（Hearsay）抗辩和对质条款（Confrontation Clause）抗辩的权利。
本题逻辑链分析
1
证人状态：受害者（Woman）昏迷，属于法律上的Unavailable（无法作证）。
2
被告行为与意图：被告对邻居说 "took care of her" 且表示不再担心她作证。这证明了被告实施了不法行为（Wrongdoing），且具有阻止其作证的特定意图 (Specific Intent)。
3
法律后果：根据 FRE 804(b)(6)，被告的行为触发了传闻证据规则的例外。因此，警探转述的受害者陈述可以采纳。
✓
结论：正确答案是 D。这是针对导致陈述人无法作证的一方当事人的陈述。
为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A (Hearsay): 错误。虽然这确实是传闻证据，但它符合 FRE 804(b)(6) 的例外情况，因此并非不可采纳。
选项 B (Confrontation Clause): 错误。虽然通常刑事被告有权与证人对质（Crawford v. Washington），但最高法院明确规定，如果被告通过不法行为阻止证人出庭，他就放弃 (Forfeited) 了这项宪法权利。你不能杀死证人然后抱怨无法对其进行交叉询问。
选项 C (Prior Identification): 错误。这是常见的干扰项。FRE 801(d)(1)(C) 关于“先前指认”的非传闻规则有一个严格前提：陈述人必须在庭审中作证并接受交叉询问。本案中受害者昏迷无法出庭，因此该规则不适用。
💡 MBE 提分技巧

在处理 Hearsay 问题时，如果看到类似“黑帮老大杀害证人”、“被告威胁证人导致其失踪”的情节，请立即联想 Forfeiture by Wrongdoing。

关键判别标准：
1. 证人无法出庭 (Unavailable)。
2. 被告参与了导致其无法出庭的行为。
3. 被告的目的是为了阻止其作证 (Intent to prevent testimony)。

A woman sued a man for damages for the death of her husband resulting from an automobile collision. At trial, the man calls the husband's doctor to testify that the day before his death, the husband, in great pain, said, "It was my own fault; there's nobody to blame but me."
Under which hearsay exception should the doctor's testimony be admitted?

choices.a: The dying declaration exception.
choices.b: The excited utterance exception.
choices.c: The statement against interest exception.
choices.d: The then-existing state of mind exception.

data.questionStem:
Q87014

A woman sued a man for damages for the death of her husband resulting from an automobile collision. At trial, the man calls the husband's doctor to testify that the day before his death, the husband, in great pain, said, "It was my own fault; there's nobody to blame but me."

Under which hearsay exception should the doctor's testimony be admitted?

一名女性因其丈夫在一场车祸中死亡而起诉一名男性，要求其赔偿损失。在庭审中，该男性传唤了丈夫的医生作证，称其丈夫在去世前一天，在极度痛苦中说道：‘这是我自己的错；除了我，谁也怪不着。’

根据哪一项传闻证据规则的例外，该医生的证词应被采纳？
options:
A. The dying declaration exception.
临终声明例外。

B. The excited utterance exception.
激动言辞例外。

C. The statement against interest exception.
不利于己方利益的陈述例外。

D. The then-existing state of mind exception.
当时存在的精神状态例外。
data.explanation:
Common hearsay exceptions


Declarant unavailable
  • Former testimony
  • Dying declaration
  • Statement against interest
  • Statement of personal or family history
  • Statement offered against party that wrongfully caused declarant's unavailability
Declarant's availability irrelevant
  • Present sense impression
  • Excited utterance
  • Mental state or physical condition
  • Medical diagnosis or treatment
  • Recorded recollection
  • Business or public records
  • Learned treatises, periodicals, or pamphlets
  • Judgment of previous conviction
  • Residual (catch-all) exception
The statement against interest exception to the rule against hearsay only applies when the declarant is unavailable as a witness. Additionally, the hearsay statement must be one that a reasonable person in the declarant's position would have made only if that person believed the statement to be true because it:
  • was contrary to the declarant's proprietary (ie, ownership) or pecuniary (ie, monetary) interest
  • tended to invalidate the declarant's claim against someone else or
  • exposed the declarant to civil or criminal liability.


Here, the husband is unavailable as a witness because he is deceased. And his hearsay statement is one that a reasonable person in his position would have made only if that person believed it to be true because - at a minimum - it exposed the husband to civil liability for the accident. Therefore, the statement is admissible under the statement against interest exception.

(Choice A) The dying declaration exception applies to statements that (1) were made while an unavailable declarant believed his/her death was imminent and (2) concerned the circumstances of that impending death. This exception does not apply here because, though the husband was in great pain, there is no indication that he believed his death was imminent.

(Choice B) The excited utterance exception applies to statements that (1) relate to a startling event or condition and (2) were made while the declarant was still under the stress of excitement caused by that event or condition - not seen here.

(Choice D) The then-existing state of mind exception applies to statements about the declarant's motive, intent, or plan - eg, a plot to sue over a car accident. But this exception does not apply to mere statements of memory or belief - eg, the husband's reflection on the car accident - unless they relate to the declarant's will (not seen here).

Educational objective: The statement against interest exception applies to hearsay statements that (1) are contrary to the unavailable declarant's proprietary or pecuniary interest, (2) tend to invalidate the declarant's claim against someone else, or (3) expose the declarant to civil or criminal liability.

选项正确率统计：A选项 18%，B选项 0%，C选项 66%（正确选项），D选项 15%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

常见的传闻证据规则例外


陈述人无法出庭作证
  • 先前证词
  • 临终声明
  • 不利于己方利益的陈述
  • 关于个人或家族史的陈述
  • 针对不当导致陈述人无法作证之一方所提出的陈述
陈述人是否能出庭作证无关紧要
  • 即时感官印象
  • 激动言辞
  • 精神状态或身体状况
  • 医疗诊断或治疗
  • 有记录的回忆
  • 商业或公共记录
  • 学术专著、期刊或小册子
  • 先前定罪的判决
  • 剩余（总括性）例外
传闻证据规则中的不利于己方利益的陈述例外仅在陈述人无法作为证人出庭时适用。此外，该传闻陈述必须是处于陈述人立场上的一个理性人只有在相信其为真实的情况下才会作出的，因为该陈述：
  • 违背了陈述人的所有权（即 ownership）或金钱（即 monetary）利益
  • 倾向于使陈述人对他人提起的诉求无效或
  • 使陈述人面临民事或刑事责任。


在本案中，丈夫因已故而无法作为证人出庭。并且，他的传闻陈述是处于其立场上的一个理性人只有在相信其为真实的情况下才会作出的，因为——至少——该陈述使丈夫面临事故的民事责任。因此，根据不利于己方利益的陈述例外，该陈述可以被采纳。

(Choice A) 临终声明例外适用于以下陈述：(1) 由一名无法出庭的陈述人在相信自己死亡迫近时作出，并且 (2) 该陈述关乎即将发生的死亡之情形。此例外在此处不适用，因为尽管丈夫处于剧痛之中，但没有迹象表明他相信自己死亡迫近。

(Choice B) 激动言辞例外适用于以下陈述：(1) 与一个惊人事件或状况有关，并且 (2) 是在陈述人仍处于该事件或状况所引起的激动压力下作出的——本案中未见此情形。

(Choice D) 当时存在的精神状态例外适用于关于陈述人动机、意图或计划的陈述——例如，就车祸提起诉讼的策划。但此例外不适用于纯粹关于记忆或信念的陈述——例如，丈夫对车祸的反思——除非这些陈述与陈述人的遗嘱有关（本案中未见此情形）。

教学目标：不利于己方利益的陈述例外适用于满足以下条件的传闻陈述：(1) 违背无法出庭的陈述人的所有权或金钱利益，(2) 倾向于使陈述人对他人提起的诉求无效，或 (3) 使陈述人面临民事或刑事责任。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 804 (hearsay exceptions for unavailable declarants).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence / Hearsay Exceptions
✅ 正确答案：C
不利于己方利益的陈述例外
(The statement against interest exception)
⚖️ 法律规则解析

根据 FRE 804(b)(3)，一项陈述若要符合“不利于己方利益的陈述”例外，必须满足两个核心条件：

  1. 陈述人不可获得 (Declarant is Unavailable)： 陈述人必须无法出庭作证（如死亡、享有特权、拒绝作证等）。
  2. 违背利益 (Against Interest)： 在陈述作出时，该内容必须严重违背陈述人的金钱利益 (pecuniary interest)、财产利益 (proprietary interest)，或使其面临民事/刑事责任 (civil/criminal liability)，以至于一个理性的人除非确信其为真，否则不会说出这番话。
🔍 案情逻辑分析

在本案中，逻辑链条非常清晰：

  • 条件一满足： 丈夫已经去世，因此他在法律上属于“不可获得” (Unavailable)。
  • 条件二满足： 丈夫说“这是我自己的错 (It was my own fault)”。承认自己在车祸中有过错，直接使其面临民事赔偿责任 (Civil Liability)，并且会使他（或其遗产代表）针对被告的索赔无效。

因此，这是一个教科书式的“不利于己方利益的陈述”。

⚠️ 易错点辨析 (The Trap)
为什么不选 A (临终声明)？

这是本题最大的干扰项。临终声明 (Dying Declaration) 要求陈述人必须主观上相信死亡迫在眉睫 (Belief of imminent death)。

虽然题目提到丈夫“极度痛苦 (in great pain)”且在“死前一天”，但没有任何事实表明丈夫当时知道自己快要死了。MBE 考试非常严谨，不能因为某人后来死了，就反推他当时知道自己会死。

为什么不选 B (激动言辞)？

激动言辞 (Excited Utterance) 要求陈述是在受到惊吓事件的压力下作出的。丈夫是在死前一天（事故发生后一段时间）作出的陈述，此时通常被认为已经恢复了反思能力，不再处于“激动压力 (Stress of excitement)”之下。

🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理 Hearsay Exceptions 时，首先判断陈述人是否出庭：

  • 如果陈述人Unavailable（如本题），优先考虑 FRE 804 组别的例外（如临终声明、不利于己方利益陈述）。
  • 区分 Party-Opponent Admission（当事人自认）和 Statement Against Interest：前者不需要陈述人不可获得，且必须是对方当事人；后者必须陈述人不可获得，且适用于任何陈述人。
Reference: Fed. R. Evid. 804(b)(3)

questions.question:
A plaintiff sued a ladder manufacturer for injuries he suffered to his neck and back when a rung of the ladder on which he was standing gave way. When the plaintiff's back and neck continued to be very sore more than two weeks after his fall, his treating physician had sent him to an orthopedist for an evaluation. Though the orthopedist did not treat the plaintiff, he diagnosed an acute cervical strain. At trial, the plaintiff has called the orthopedist to testify that, in response to the orthopedist's inquiry about how the plaintiff had injured his back, the plaintiff had told him, "I was standing near the top of a 15-foot ladder when I abruptly fell, landing hard on my back, after which the ladder toppled onto my neck."
Should the statement be admitted?

choices.a: No, because it relates to the inception or the cause of the injury rather than the plaintiff's physical condition.
choices.b: No, because it was not made to a treating physician.
choices.c: Yes, because it was made for the purpose of medical diagnosis or treatment.
choices.d: Yes, because the plaintiff is present and can be cross-examined about it.

Though the orthopedist did not treat the plaintiff, he diagnosed an acute cervical strain. At trial, the plaintiff has called the orthopedist to testify that, in response to the orthopedist's inquiry about how the plaintiff had injured his back, the plaintiff had told him, "I was standing near the top of a 15-foot ladder when I abruptly fell, landing hard on my back, after which the ladder toppled onto my neck."

Should the statement be admitted?

一名原告因其站立的梯子的一级横档断裂，导致其颈部和背部受伤，而起诉该梯子制造商。在摔倒后两周多，原告的背部和颈部仍然非常疼痛，他的主治医生遂将他送至一位骨科医生处进行评估。虽然该骨科医生并未治疗原告，但他诊断出原告患有急性颈部拉伤。在庭审中，原告传唤了该骨科医生作证，以证明当骨科医生询问原告背部如何受伤时，原告曾告诉他：“我当时正站在一个15英尺高的梯子顶部附近，突然摔了下来，背部重重着地，之后梯子倒在了我的脖子上。”

该陈述应否被采纳？
options:
A. No, because it relates to the inception or the cause of the injury rather than the plaintiff's physical condition.
不应采纳，因为它涉及伤害的起因或原因，而非原告的身体状况。

B. No, because it was not made to a treating physician.
不应采纳，因为它不是向主治医生作出的。

C. Yes, because it was made for the purpose of medical diagnosis or treatment.
应采纳，因为它是为医疗诊断或治疗目的而作出的。

D. Yes, because the plaintiff is present and can be cross-examined about it.
应采纳，因为原告在场，并可就此接受交叉盘问。
data.explanation:
Statement made for medical diagnosis or treatment


(FRE 803(4)) Hearsay exception for statement by declarant (available or not) that is: made for & reasonably pertinent to medical diagnosis or treatment and describes declarant's: medical history past or present symptoms or sensations or inception or general cause of symptoms
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence
Under the rule against hearsay, an out-of-court statement is presumed unreliable and is generally inadmissible when offered for the truth of the matter asserted therein. One exception to this rule applies to statements that are:

  • made for and reasonably pertinent to medical diagnosis or treatment and
  • describe the declarant's medical history, past or present symptoms, or the inception or general cause of those symptoms (Choice A).


There is no requirement that these statements be made to a physician, so statements to nurses, family members, ambulance drivers, etc. are admissible so long as they meet the above criteria (Choice B). Here, the plaintiff's statement to the orthopedist falls within this exception because the statement was pertinent to a medical diagnosis and described the inception or cause of his injuries. As a result, it should be admitted.

(Choice D) The plaintiff is present and can be cross-examined about the statement. And since a statement made for medical diagnosis or treatment is admissible regardless of the declarant's availability, this is not a basis for admitting the statement.

Educational objective: One exception to the hearsay rule applies to statements that are (1) made for and reasonably pertinent to medical diagnosis or treatment and (2) describe the declarant's medical history, past or present symptoms, or their inception or general cause.

选项正确率统计：A选项 16%，B选项 1%，C选项 77%（正确选项），D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

为医疗诊断或治疗目的作出的陈述


(FRE 803(4)) 传闻证据规则的例外，适用于陈述人（无论其是否可以出庭）所作的陈述，该陈述：为医疗诊断或治疗目的作出且与之合理相关，并且描述了陈述人的：病史；过去或现在的症状或感觉；或症状的起因或一般原因。
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence)
根据反对传闻证据的规则，庭外陈述在被用以证明其所断言事项的真实性时，被推定为不可靠，通常不予采纳。该规则的一项例外适用于符合以下条件的陈述：

  • 为医疗诊断或治疗目的作出且与之合理相关并且
  • 描述了陈述人的病史、过去或现在的症状，或这些症状的起因或一般原因 (选项A)。


该规则没有要求这些陈述必须向医生作出，因此向护士、家人、救护车司机等作出的陈述，只要满足上述标准，也是可以采纳的 (选项B)。在本案中，原告向骨科医生作出的陈述属于此例外情况，因为该陈述与医疗诊断相关，并描述了他受伤的起因或原因。因此，该陈述应被采纳。

(选项D) 原告确实在场，可以就该陈述接受交叉盘问。但由于为医疗诊断或治疗目的作出的陈述，无论陈述人是否可以出庭作证，都是可以采纳的，因此这不能作为采纳该陈述的依据。

教学目的：传闻证据规则的一项例外适用于以下陈述：(1) 为医疗诊断或治疗目的作出且与之合理相关，以及 (2) 描述了陈述人的病史、过去或现在的症状，或其起因或一般原因。

References

  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(4) (hearsay exception - statement made for medical diagnosis or treatment).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

证据法 (Evidence) - 传闻例外

正确答案

本题的正确选项是 C。

理由：该陈述是为医疗诊断或治疗目的而作出的 (Made for medical diagnosis or treatment)。

核心考点：FRE 803(4)

本题考查《联邦证据规则》第803(4)条关于“为医疗诊断或治疗而作出的陈述” (Statement Made for Medical Diagnosis or Treatment) 的传闻例外。

规则要件：
只要满足以下两个条件，传闻证据即可被采纳：
  1. 陈述是为了医疗诊断或治疗 (Medical diagnosis or treatment) 而作出的；且
  2. 陈述描述了病史、过去或现在的症状、疼痛、感觉，或症状的起因/一般原因 (Inception or general cause)。

关键逻辑：法律假定人们在寻求医疗帮助时不会撒谎，因为准确的描述关乎自身的治疗效果，因此这类陈述具有内在的可靠性。

案情深度解析

在本案中，原告向骨科医生描述了受伤的过程：“站在梯子上...突然摔下...梯子倒在脖子上”。

  • 相关性 (Pertinent): 医生需要了解受伤的机制（如从多高摔下、是否有重物撞击）来判断伤情的严重程度（如脊椎受压情况）。因此，这些关于“起因” (Cause) 的描述与诊断合理相关。
  • 诊断 vs. 治疗: 题目中提到医生是为了“评估” (Evaluation) 而非直接治疗。根据FRE 803(4)，仅为诊断目的（甚至是为了作证而进行的诊断）所作的陈述也是可以采纳的。

因此，该陈述符合传闻例外，应当被采纳。

为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A (错误)：
虽然传闻规则通常排除关于“过错” (Fault) 的陈述，但明确允许关于“起因” (Cause) 的陈述。
区分点：“梯子坏了导致我摔倒”（起因，可采纳） vs. “制造商疏忽导致梯子坏了”（归责，通常不可采纳）。本题中原告描述的是物理过程，属于起因。
选项 B (错误)：
规则不要求陈述必须向“主治医生” (Treating Physician) 作出。向咨询医生、护士、甚至救护车人员作出的陈述，只要目的是为了寻求诊断或治疗，均符合例外。
选项 D (错误)：
这是一个常见的干扰项。虽然原告在场并可接受交叉盘问，但这本身并不是采纳传闻证据的主要理由（除非涉及先前不一致陈述等特定情况）。本题依据的是803(4)例外，该例外无论陈述人是否在场 (Availability of declarant is immaterial) 均适用。

🎓 MBE 备考锦囊

遇到涉及医生作证的题目时，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 目的：病人说这话是为了看病（或诊断）吗？如果是，进入下一步。
  2. 内容：这话对医生判断病情有用吗？
    • 描述“怎么伤的” (Mechanism of injury) ➡️ ✅ 可采纳
    • 指责“谁的错” (Assignment of fault) ➡️ ❌ 不可采纳

例子：“被车撞了”是医疗相关（需判断内伤）；“被红灯闯行的车撞了”中，“闯红灯”部分通常不被采纳，因为这对治疗骨折没有帮助。

questions.question:
A cyclist sued a defendant corporation for injuries sustained when she was hit by a truck owned by the defendant and driven by its employee, who was making deliveries for the defendant. The day after the accident, the employee visited the cyclist in the hospital and said, "I'm sorry for what I did."
At trial, the employee has testified that he exercised due care.
Why is the cyclist's testimony relating what the defendant's employee said at the hospital admissible to prove negligence?

choices.a: It is a prior inconsistent statement.
choices.b: It is a statement against interest.
choices.c: It is a statement by a party-opponent's agent.
choices.d: It is a statement of then-existing state of mind.

data.questionStem:
Q87042

A cyclist sued a defendant corporation for injuries sustained when she was hit by a truck owned by the defendant and driven by its employee, who was making deliveries for the defendant. The day after the accident, the employee visited the cyclist in the hospital and said, "I'm sorry for what I did."

At trial, the employee has testified that he exercised due care.

Why is the cyclist's testimony relating what the defendant's employee said at the hospital admissible to prove negligence?

一名自行车骑行者因被被告公司所有、其雇员驾驶的卡车撞伤而起诉该公司。事发时，该雇员正在为被告公司送货。

事故发生后的第二天，该雇员到医院探望骑行者并说：“我为我的所作所为感到抱歉。”

在审判中，该雇员作证称他已尽到了应有的注意义务。

为什么骑行者关于被告雇员在医院所说的话的证言，可以被采纳用以证明过失？
options:
A. It is a prior inconsistent statement.
这是一个先前不一致的陈述。

B. It is a statement against interest.
这是一个与自身利益相悖的陈述。

C. It is a statement by a party-opponent's agent.
这是由对方当事人的代理人所作的陈述。

D. It is a statement of then-existing state of mind.
这是一个关于当时心智状态的陈述。
data.explanation:
Nonhearsay statement by party-opponent


(FRE 801(d)) Out-of-court statement is nonhearsay if offered against opposing party AND:
  • made or adopted by opposing party
  • made by person authorized by opposing party to make statement on subject
  • made by opposing party's agent/employee on matter within scope of relationship
OR
  • made by opposing party's coconspirator during & in furtherance of conspiracy
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Hearsay is an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein and is generally inadmissible. But such statements are excluded from this rule (ie, are nonhearsay) if they:
  • are offered against an opposing party
  • were made by that party's agent or employee and pertained to a matter within the scope of that relationship while it existed.


These statements are attributed to the opposing party and are admissible as substantive evidence at trial (eg, as proof of negligence).

Here, the employee's apology is being offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted - that he felt responsible for the accident. But it is nonhearsay because it is offered against the defendant, was made by its employee, and concerned an accident that occurred while the employee was making deliveries for the defendant in its truck. As a result, this statement by a party-opponent's agent is admissible to prove the corporation's negligence.

(Choice A) A witness's prior inconsistent statement is admissible to impeach the witness on a material matter. But it is only admissible to prove the truth asserted (ie, as substantive evidence) if the statement was made under oath at a trial, hearing, or other proceeding - which did not occur here.

(Choice B) A statement against interest is a hearsay exception for statements that are so contrary to the declarant's proprietary, pecuniary, or penal interest that a reasonable person in the declarant's position would only have said it if he/she believed it to be true. But since this exception only applies if the declarant is unavailable as a witness, it is inapplicable here.

(Choice D) Statements regarding the declarant's then-existing state of mind - not later statements of memory, belief, or reflection (eg, "I'm sorry for what I did") - are excepted from the hearsay rule. Therefore, the employee's apology is not admissible under this exception.

Educational objective: Statements that are (1) offered against an opposing party, (2) made by that party's agent or employee, and (3) pertinent to a matter within the scope of the agency or employment are excluded from the hearsay rule.

选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 16%，C选项 72%（正确选项），D选项 6%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

对方当事人的非传闻陈述


(FRE 801(d)) 如果庭外陈述被用作对对方当事人不利的证据，并且符合以下条件之一，则不属于传闻证据：
  • 由对方当事人作出或采纳
  • 由对方当事人授权就该事项作出陈述的人所作
  • 由对方当事人的代理人/雇员在代理/雇佣关系范围内就相关事项所作
或者
  • 由对方当事人的共谋者在共谋期间且为了推进共谋而作出
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence（《联邦证据规则》）。

传闻证据是指在庭外作出的、用以证明其所述事项真实性的陈述，通常不被采纳。但如果此类陈述符合以下条件，则被排除在该规则之外（即，不属于传闻证据）：
  • 被用作对对方当事人不利的证据
  • 由该当事人的代理人或雇员作出，并且与该代理/雇佣关系存续期间关系范围内的事项有关。


这些陈述被归于对方当事人名下，并且在审判中可作为实质性证据被采纳（例如，作为过失的证明）。

在本案中，该雇员的道歉被用以证明其所述事项的真实性——即他为该事故感到负责。但它不属于传闻证据，因为它是被用作对被告不利的证据，由其雇员作出，并且涉及该雇员为被告驾驶其卡车送货时发生的事故。因此，这个由对方当事人的代理人作出的陈述可以被采纳，以证明该公司的过失。

（选项A） 证人先前的矛盾陈述可以被采纳，用以就某一重要事项弹劾该证人。但只有在该陈述是在审判、听证或其他程序中经宣誓作出时，才能被采纳用以证明所述事项的真实性（即作为实质性证据）——本案中并未发生这种情况。

（选项B） 与自身利益相悖的陈述是一项传闻证据的例外，适用于那些与陈述人的财产、金钱或刑事利益严重相悖，以至于一个处于陈述人位置的理性人只有在相信其为真实的情况下才会作出的陈述。但由于此例外仅在陈述人无法作为证人出庭时适用，因此在本案中不适用。

（选项D） 关于陈述人当时心智状态的陈述——而非事后关于记忆、信念或反思的陈述（例如，“我为我的所作所为感到抱歉”）——属于传闻证据规则的例外。因此，该雇员的道歉不能根据此例外被采纳。

教学要点：（1）被用作对对方当事人不利的证据，（2）由该当事人的代理人或雇员作出，且（3）与代理或雇佣关系范围内的事项相关的陈述，被排除在传闻证据规则之外。

References

  • Fed. R. Evid. 801(d)(2) (opposing party's statement).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence / Hearsay
正确答案：C

It is a statement by a party-opponent's agent.
（这是由对方当事人的代理人所作的陈述。）

⚖️ 核心法律规则 (The Rule)

本题考察的是 FRE 801(d)(2)(D)：对方当事人的陈述 (Opposing Party's Statement)。

在联邦证据规则下，如果一个陈述符合以下条件，它被定义为非传闻 (Non-Hearsay)，可以直接作为实质性证据 (Substantive Evidence) 采纳：

  • 针对对方当事人提出 (Offered against an opposing party)；且
  • 由该当事人的代理人或雇员作出 (Made by the party's agent or employee)；且
  • 涉及代理或雇佣关系范围内的事项 (On a matter within the scope of that relationship)；且
  • 在关系存续期间作出 (While it existed)。
🔍 案情分析 (Application)

1. 身份关系： 司机是被告公司（Corporation）的雇员（Employee）。

2. 范围 (Scope)： 事故发生在司机为公司送货期间，驾驶也是其工作职责。因此，关于事故的陈述属于“雇佣关系范围内的事项”。

3. 针对性： 原告（骑行者）将此证据用于针对被告（公司）。

结论： 尽管这是庭外陈述，但根据 FRE 801(d)(2)(D)，它被视为非传闻。因此，它可以用来证明陈述内容的真实性（即证明过失）。

🚫 为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A：先前不一致陈述 (Prior Inconsistent Statement)

这是一个常见的陷阱。虽然司机的庭外道歉与庭上证词不一致，但根据 FRE 801(d)(1)(A)，只有当先前陈述是在宣誓程序 (under penalty of perjury) 中作出的，才能作为实质性证据。本案中道歉发生在医院，非宣誓场合，因此若仅按此规则，只能用于弹劾 (Impeachment)，不能直接证明过失。而选项 C 的规则允许其证明过失。

选项 B：违反利益的陈述 (Statement Against Interest)

这是传闻证据的例外 (Exception)，适用规则 FRE 804(b)(3)。该规则的一个硬性前提是陈述人必须不可出庭 (Unavailable)。本案中，司机已经出庭作证，因此不适用此例外。

选项 D：当时的心智状态 (Then-existing State of Mind)

FRE 803(3) 通常用于证明意图、情感或身体感觉，但不包括“对记忆或信念的陈述” (statement of memory or belief) 用以证明所记忆的事实。道歉是对过去行为的反思，而非当下的心智状态本身作为争议点。

💡 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理传闻证据题目时，请遵循以下思维顺序：

  1. 是不是传闻？ (庭外陈述 + 证明内容真实性)
  2. 是不是“非传闻” (Exemption/Non-Hearsay)？ 优先检查 Admission (对方当事人陈述)。如果是，直接可采。
  3. 是不是“传闻例外” (Exception)？ 如果不是 Admission，再检查是否符合 803 (无视证人是否在场) 或 804 (证人必须缺席) 的例外。

切记： 只要是对方当事人（或其代理人）说的话，且对该当事人不利，通常都是 Admissible Non-Hearsay。

questions.question:
A decedent's estate sued a jewelry store claiming that one of the jewelry store's security guards wrongfully shot and killed the decedent when the decedent fled after being accused of shoplifting. The guard was convicted of manslaughter for killing the decedent. At his criminal trial, the guard, who was no longer working for the jewelry store, testified that the jewelry store's security director had instructed him to stop shoplifters "at all costs." Because the guard's criminal conviction is on appeal, he refuses to testify at the civil trial. The decedent's estate now offers an authenticated transcript of the guard's criminal trial testimony concerning the instruction of the jewelry store's security director.
Is the transcript of the guard's criminal trial testimony about the security director's instruction admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: Yes, although hearsay, as former testimony.
choices.c: Yes, as a statement of an agent of a party-opponent.
choices.d: Yes, because the instruction from the security director is not hearsay.

data.questionStem:
Q87038

A decedent's estate sued a jewelry store claiming that one of the jewelry store's security guards wrongfully shot and killed the decedent when the decedent fled after being accused of shoplifting. The guard was convicted of manslaughter for killing the decedent. At his criminal trial, the guard, who was no longer working for the jewelry store, testified that the jewelry store's security director had instructed him to stop shoplifters "at all costs." Because the guard's criminal conviction is on appeal, he refuses to testify at the civil trial. The decedent's estate now offers an authenticated transcript of the guard's criminal trial testimony concerning the instruction of the jewelry store's security director.

Is the transcript of the guard's criminal trial testimony about the security director's instruction admissible?

一名死者的遗产管理人起诉了一家珠宝店，声称该珠宝店的一名保安在死者被指控商店盗窃后逃跑时，不正当地将其枪杀。该保安因杀害死者而被判犯有非预谋杀人罪(manslaughter)。在其刑事审判中，该保安（当时已不在该珠宝店工作）作证称，珠宝店的安保主管曾指示他“不惜一切代价”阻止商店窃贼。由于该保安的刑事定罪正在上诉中，他拒绝在民事审判中作证。死者的遗产管理人现提供一份经认证的、该保安在刑事审判中关于珠宝店安保主管指示的证词誊本。

该保安在刑事审判中关于安保主管指示的证词誊本是否可采纳为证据？
options:
A. No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
不可采纳，因为它是传闻证据，且不属于任何例外情况。

B. Yes, although hearsay, as former testimony.
可采纳，虽然是传闻证据，但可作为先前的证词。

C. Yes, as a statement of an agent of a party-opponent.
可采纳，可作为对方当事人的代理人陈述。

D. Yes, because the instruction from the security director is not hearsay.
可采纳，因为安保主管的指示不构成传闻证据。
data.explanation:
Hearsay is an out-of-court statement (eg, the security director's instruction) offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein (eg, that the guard was to stop shoplifters at all costs). When a hearsay statement is contained in another hearsay statement (eg, the guard's criminal trial testimony), both statements are inadmissible unless both fall within an exclusion or exception to the hearsay rule.

One hearsay exclusion applies to statements made by an opposing party's agent or employee that (1) concern a matter within the scope of the agency/employment relationship and (2) are offered against the opposing party. The security director's statement falls within this exclusion because it was made while he was acting in the course of his employment with the jewelry store and is being offered against the store. But this statement is only admissible if the guard's criminal trial testimony is also excluded or excepted from hearsay (Choices C & D).

This raises the hearsay exception for former testimony of an unavailable declarant (eg, one who refuses to testify) that:
  • was given at a trial, hearing, or deposition in the current or any prior proceeding and
  • is offered against a party who had - or, for civil cases, whose predecessor in interest had - an opportunity and similar motive to develop the testimony by examination.
Here, the guard is unavailable because he has refused to testify at the current civil trial. However, his former testimony does not fall under this hearsay exception because the jewelry store - the party against whom the testimony is offered - did not have the opportunity to question the guard at the criminal trial (Choice B). And since this testimony is hearsay not within any exclusion or other exception, the transcript of the guard's testimony about the security director's instruction is inadmissible.

Educational objective: When one hearsay statement is contained in another hearsay statement, both statements are inadmissible unless both fall within an exclusion or exception to the hearsay rule.



选项正确率统计：A选项 17%（正确选项），B选项 45%，C选项 28%，D选项 8%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

传闻证据（Hearsay）是指在庭外作出的陈述（例如，安保主管的指示），并被用于证明其所主张事项的真实性（例如，保安被要求不惜一切代价阻止商店窃贼）。当一份传闻证据陈述被包含在另一份传闻证据陈述中（例如，保安的刑事审判证词），这两份陈述都不可采纳，除非两者都符合传闻证据规则的排除或例外规定。

有一项传闻证据排除规则适用于对方当事人的代理人或雇员所作的陈述，该陈述(1)涉及代理/雇佣关系范围内的事项，并且(2)被用于指证该对方当事人。安保主管的陈述属于此排除规则的范畴，因为这是他在为珠宝店工作期间作出的，并且被用来指证该珠宝店。但只有当保安的刑事审判证词本身也符合传闻证据的排除或例外规定时，该陈述才可被采纳(选项 C & D)。

这就引出了针对无法到庭的陈述人（例如，拒绝作证者）的先前证词的传闻证据例外规定，该规定要求证词：
  • 是在当前或任何先前的程序中的审判、听证会或取证中作出，并且
  • 被用于指证一个曾有——或者在民事案件中，其权益前手曾有——机会和相似动机通过诘问来展开该证词的当事人。
在本案中，该保安因拒绝在当前民事审判中作证而无法到庭。然而，他先前的证词不符合此传闻证据的例外规定，因为珠宝店——即该证词所要指证的当事人——在刑事审判中没有机会诘问该保安(选项 B)。由于该证词是传闻证据，且不符合任何排除或其他的例外规定，因此，该保安关于安保主管指示的证词誊本是不可采纳的。

教学目的：当一份传闻证据陈述被包含在另一份传闻证据陈述中时，这两份陈述都不可采纳，除非两者都符合传闻证据规则的排除或例外规定。

References

  • Fed. R. Evid. 805 (hearsay within hearsay).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 801(d)(2) (hearsay exclusion - opposing party's statement).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 804(b)(1) (hearsay exception - former testimony).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence Law: Hearsay within Hearsay
正确答案：A (不可采纳)

这道题是考察证据法中非常经典的“双重传闻” (Hearsay within Hearsay) 问题。要解决这个问题，我们需要像剥洋葱一样分析证据的结构。

核心规则：FRE 805 当传闻证据包含在另一个传闻证据中时，只有当每一层传闻都符合传闻例外或排除规则时，该证据才可采纳。

1. 证据结构分析

死者遗产管理人试图引入的是一份刑事审判的证词誊本 (Transcript)。这其中包含了两个层面的陈述：

第一层（外层）：誊本/保安的证词

陈述人：保安 (Guard)
内容："主管告诉我……"
性质：庭外陈述，用于证明主管确实说了那些话。

第二层（内层）：主管的指示

陈述人：安保主管 (Security Director)
内容："不惜一切代价阻止窃贼"
性质：庭外陈述，用于证明该指令的内容（暗示过失/责任）。

2. 逐层法律分析

✅ 分析内层（主管的指示）：

这部分是可以采纳的。因为主管是珠宝店的雇员，该陈述是在雇佣关系存续期间作出的，且关乎雇佣范围。根据 FRE 801(d)(2)(D)，这属于对方当事人的代理人陈述 (Vicarious Admission)，在联邦证据规则下被定义为“非传闻” (Not Hearsay)。

如果保安今天站在法庭上亲自复述这句话，是可以采纳的。

❌ 分析外层（保安的刑事证词誊本）：

这是问题的关键。保安现在拒绝作证，所以誊本本身就是传闻（Hearsay）。要让誊本进场，必须符合先前证词例外 (Former Testimony Exception, FRE 804(b)(1))。

该例外要求：

  • 陈述人不可获得 (Unavailable) —— 符合（保安拒绝作证）。
  • 证词是在之前的听证或审判中作出的 —— 符合（刑事审判）。
  • 关键点：证据被用来针对的一方（珠宝店），必须在之前的审判中有机会 (Opportunity) 和相似的动机 (Similar Motive) 去质询 (Cross-examine) 该证人。

致命缺陷：

在保安的刑事审判中，当事人是“政府 vs. 保安”。珠宝店 (Jewelry Store) 并不是刑事案件的当事人。珠宝店在刑事审判中没有律师在场，也没有机会去盘问保安。因此，不能将保安在刑事法庭的证词用来针对未曾参与该案的珠宝店。

3. 为什么其他选项错误？

  • 选项 B (Former Testimony)： 错误。如上所述，虽然它是先前证词，但因为针对的当事人（珠宝店）在之前的诉讼中没有质询机会，所以不符合例外条件。
  • 选项 C (Agent Statement)： 错误。这只解决了“内层”传闻（主管的话），没有解决“外层”传闻（保安的誊本）。双重传闻必须两层都通关。
  • 选项 D (Not Hearsay)： 错误。同样只关注了主管的指示（可能被视为非传闻或非用来证明事实真相），但忽略了誊本本身是传闻的问题。
MBE 解题技巧： 看到“誊本”、“报告”引用某人说的话，立即警惕“双重传闻”。必须检查每一层连接是否都有法律依据。只要有一层断裂，整个证据链即不可采纳。

questions.question:
A woman sued a neighbor for shooting her husband from ambush. The woman offers to testify that, the day before her husband was killed, he described to her a chance meeting with the neighbor on the street in which the neighbor said, "I'm going to blow your head off one of these days."
Is the woman's testimony concerning her husband's statement admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: No, because it is improper evidence of a prior bad act.
choices.c: Yes, because the neighbor's statement is that of a party-opponent.
choices.d: Yes, to show the neighbor's state of mind.

data.questionStem:
Q87057

A woman sued a neighbor for shooting her husband from ambush. The woman offers to testify that, the day before her husband was killed, he described to her a chance meeting with the neighbor on the street in which the neighbor said, "I'm going to blow your head off one of these days."

Is the woman's testimony concerning her husband's statement admissible?

一名女性因其邻居伏击枪杀其丈夫而起诉该邻居。该女性提议作证称，在其丈夫被杀的前一天，丈夫向她描述了在街上与该邻居偶遇的情形，其中邻居说：“总有一天我要打爆你的头。”

该女性关于其丈夫陈述的证词是否可以被采纳？
options:
A. No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
不可以，因为该证词属于传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。

B. No, because it is improper evidence of a prior bad act.
不可以，因为这是关于先前不当行为的不当证据。

C. Yes, because the neighbor's statement is that of a party-opponent.
可以，因为邻居的陈述属于对方当事人的陈述。

D. Yes, to show the neighbor's state of mind.
可以，用以证明邻居的精神状态。
data.explanation:
The rule against hearsay bars the admission of an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein. When such a statement (eg, the neighbor's threat) is contained within another (eg, the husband's description of the encounter), neither statement is admissible unless both are excluded or excepted from the rule against hearsay.

One hearsay exclusion applies to statements by a party-opponent that are offered against that party. Since the neighbor is a party to this lawsuit and his statement is being offered against him, that statement is excluded from hearsay (ie, constitutes nonhearsay). But since the husband's statement describing his chance meeting with the neighbor does not fall within any hearsay exclusion or exception,† the woman's testimony about both statements is inadmissible (Choice C).

†The hearsay exception for statements offered against a party that wrongfully caused the declarant's unavailability does not apply here because the neighbor did not shoot the husband with the intent to prevent him from testifying.

(Choice B) Evidence of a prior bad act cannot be used to prove a person's propensity to behave in a certain manner. But here, the neighbor's statement was offered to prove that he killed the husband - not that the neighbor was prone to violence. Therefore, this rule is inapplicable.

(Choice D) The hearsay exception for statements of a declarant's then-existing state of mind is unnecessary because the neighbor's statement is nonhearsay. And even if this exception applied, the neighbor's statement would remain inadmissible because it is contained within the husband's inadmissible hearsay statement.

Educational objective: When an out-of-court statement that is offered for the truth of the matter asserted therein is contained within another, neither statement is admissible unless both are excepted or excluded from the rule against hearsay.



选项正确率统计：A选项 22%（正确选项），B选项 0%，C选项 50%，D选项 26%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

反传闻证据规则禁止采纳为证明其内容为真而提出的庭外陈述。当此类陈述（例如，邻居的威胁）包含在另一陈述中（例如，丈夫对相遇的描述）时，除非两者均被排除于反传闻证据规则之外或作为其例外情况，否则两个陈述均不可采纳。

一种传闻证据的排除情形适用于对方当事人的陈述，即该陈述被用作不利于该当事人的证据。由于邻居是本案诉讼的当事人，且其陈述被用作不利于他的证据，因此该陈述被排除在传闻证据之外（即，构成非传闻证据）。但由于丈夫描述他与邻居偶遇的陈述不符合任何传闻证据的排除或例外情况†，因此该女性关于这两项陈述的证词是不可采纳的(选项 C)。

†针对因一方当事人的不法行为导致陈述人无法出庭作证而提出的陈述，此处的传闻证据例外规则不适用，因为邻居枪杀丈夫并非意图阻止其作证。

(选项 B) 先前不当行为的证据不能被用来证明一个人有以某种特定方式行事的倾向性。但在本案中，邻居的陈述被用来证明他杀害了丈夫——而不是证明邻居有暴力倾向。因此，该规则不适用。

(选项 D) 关于陈述人当时存在的精神状态的传闻证据例外规则是不必要的，因为邻居的陈述是非传闻证据。并且，即使此例外适用，邻居的陈述仍然不可采纳，因为它包含在丈夫的不可采纳的传闻陈述之中。

教学目的：当一个为证明其内容为真而提出的庭外陈述包含在另一个庭外陈述中时，除非两个陈述都作为反传闻证据规则的例外或被排除，否则两个陈述均不可采纳。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 805 (hearsay within hearsay).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence Law: Hearsay within Hearsay
核心考点：多重传闻 (Hearsay within Hearsay)

根据 FRE 805，当传闻证据包含在另一传闻证据中时，只有当每一层陈述都符合传闻例外或被排除在传闻定义之外时，该证据才可采纳。

证据链条分析
第 1 层 (内层)
邻居对丈夫说："I'm going to blow your head off..."
可采纳 (Admissible)
理由：对方当事人陈述 (Opposing Party's Statement)
↓
第 2 层 (外层)
丈夫对妻子(证人)说："昨天我遇到了邻居..."
不可采纳 (Inadmissible)
理由：普通传闻，无例外适用 (Hearsay with no exception)
↓
法庭 (Court)
妻子试图转述丈夫的话
结果：证据被排除
深度解析

本题的正确答案是 A。这是一个典型的“双重传闻”问题。要让妻子在法庭上复述丈夫的话（而丈夫又是复述邻居的话），证据链的每一个环节都必须打通。

  • 内层（邻居 -> 丈夫）： 邻居是本案被告，他的威胁性言论被原告引用，属于对方当事人陈述 (Statement by a Party-Opponent)，根据 FRE 801(d)(2)，这在法律上被定义为“非传闻” (Non-hearsay)，是可以采纳的。
  • 外层（丈夫 -> 妻子）： 这是问题的关键。丈夫在庭外向妻子描述过去发生的事件，目的是为了证明该事件（邻居威胁他）确实发生过。这就是典型的传闻 (Hearsay)。

为什么外层没有例外适用？
丈夫是在事发“第二天” (the day before he was killed) 描述的，这排除了：
❌ 现时感官印象 (Present Sense Impression): 需要边看边说或刚看完立刻说。
❌ 激动言词 (Excited Utterance): 没有证据表明丈夫在描述时仍处于受威胁的压力/激动之下。

⚠️ 常见陷阱 (Choice C & D)
  • 选项 C 错误：它只看到了内层（邻居的话）是可采纳的，忽略了外层（丈夫的话）是不可采纳的传闻。
  • 选项 D 错误：即使邻居的话显示了其精神状态 (State of Mind)，这仍然被包裹在丈夫不可采纳的传闻陈述中。
MBE 解题技巧：
遇到 "A told B what C said" 的结构，务必画出链条。只要链条中任何一环断裂（是传闻且无例外），整个证据即不可采纳。

questions.question:
A defendant is charged with aggravated assault. The physical evidence at trial has shown that the victim was hit with a lead pipe in the back of the head and on the forearms and left in an alley. The medical examiner has testified that the injuries to the victim's forearms appear to have been defensive wounds. The victim has testified that he cannot remember who attacked him with the lead pipe. He would further testify that he remembers only that a passerby found him in the alley, and that he told the passerby that the defendant had hit him with the lead pipe; he then lost consciousness.
The defendant objects to this proposed testimony, arguing that it is hearsay and that the victim had no personal knowledge of the identity of the perpetrator.
Is the victim's testimony concerning his previous statement to the passerby admissible?

choices.a: No, because the prosecutor has failed to show that it is more likely than not that the victim had personal knowledge of the perpetrator's identity.
choices.b: No, because the victim has no memory of the attack itself and therefore cannot be effectively cross-examined.
choices.c: Yes, because it is the victim's own out-of-court statement.
choices.d: Yes, because the victim is subject to cross-examination and there is sufficient showing of personal knowledge.

data.questionStem:
Q87028

A defendant is charged with aggravated assault. The physical evidence at trial has shown that the victim was hit with a lead pipe in the back of the head and on the forearms and left in an alley. The medical examiner has testified that the injuries to the victim's forearms appear to have been defensive wounds. The victim has testified that he cannot remember who attacked him with the lead pipe. He would further testify that he remembers only that a passerby found him in the alley, and that he told the passerby that the defendant had hit him with the lead pipe; he then lost consciousness.

The defendant objects to this proposed testimony, arguing that it is hearsay and that the victim had no personal knowledge of the identity of the perpetrator.

Is the victim's testimony concerning his previous statement to the passerby admissible?

一名被告被控严重攻击罪（aggravated assault）。庭审中的物证显示，受害人被人用铅管击中后脑和前臂，并被遗弃在一条小巷里。法医作证称，受害人前臂的伤口似乎是防御性伤口。受害人作证称，他不记得是谁用铅管袭击了他。他将进一步作证称，他只记得一名路人在小巷里发现了他，并且他告诉该路人被告用铅管打了他；之后他便失去了知觉。

被告对这项拟议的证词提出异议，主张其为传闻证据（hearsay），且受害人对行凶者的身份没有亲身认知（personal knowledge）。

受害人关于其先前对路人所作陈述的证词是否可以采纳？
options:
A. No, because the prosecutor has failed to show that it is more likely than not that the victim had personal knowledge of the perpetrator's identity.
不可以，因为检察官未能证明受害人有大于百分之五十的可能（more likely than not）亲身认知行凶者的身份。

B. No, because the victim has no memory of the attack itself and therefore cannot be effectively cross-examined.
不可以，因为受害人对攻击本身没有记忆，因此无法被有效进行交叉诘问（cross-examined）。

C. Yes, because it is the victim's own out-of-court statement.
可以，因为这是受害人自己的庭外陈述（out-of-court statement）。

D. Yes, because the victim is subject to cross-examination and there is sufficient showing of personal knowledge.
可以，因为受害人可以接受交叉诘问，并且有足够的证据显示其具有亲身认知。
data.explanation:
Nonhearsay statements (FRE 801(d))


Out-of-court statement admissible if witness subject to cross-examination & prior statement:
Statement by declarant-witness
  • is inconsistent with current testimony & was made under penalty of perjury
  • is consistent with current testimony & offered to (1) rebut charge of fabrication/improper influence or (2) rehabilitate witness
  • or identifies person witness perceived earlier
Out-of-court statement admissible if offered against opposing party & statement was:
Statement by party-opponent
  • made or adopted by party
  • made by person authorized by party
  • made by party's agent/employee on matter within scope of relationship
  • or made by party's coconspirator during & in furtherance of conspiracy
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

The rule against hearsay generally bars the admission of out-of-court statements offered for the truth of the matter asserted therein. But certain statements are excluded from this rule and considered nonhearsay. This includes statements that are made by a declarant who testifies and is subject to cross-examination and identify a person as someone the declarant perceived earlier.

To be admissible, these prior statements of identification must be based on the declarant-witness's personal knowledge. This requirement is met if a reasonable juror could find that the witness was speaking about his/her firsthand observation or experience - a standard that is significantly easier to satisfy than "more likely than not" (Choice A).

Here, the victim's proposed testimony seeks to identify the defendant as someone the victim had previously perceived and identified as his attacker. Since the victim can be cross-examined about his statement, it is nonhearsay. Additionally, the victim's prior statement of identification was based on personal knowledge because evidence of defensive wounds is sufficient to persuade a reasonable juror that the victim saw his attacker firsthand. Therefore, the victim's testimony concerning this statement is admissible.

(Choice B) In United States v. Owens, the Supreme Court admitted an out-of-court statement identifying a declarant-witness's attacker even though the declarant could not remember the attack at trial. The Court reasoned that the confrontation clause only guarantees a defendant an opportunity for effective cross-examination. This guarantee is met when the defendant can challenge the witness's credibility (eg, bias, lack of memory).

(Choice C) The fact the victim made the out-of-court statement identifying the defendant as his attacker is insufficient on its own to admit that statement.

Educational objective: An out-of-court statement that identifies a person as someone the declarant perceived earlier is nonhearsay if the declarant testifies at trial and is subject to cross-examination about the prior identification.

选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 12%，C选项 11%，D选项 69%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

非传闻证据陈述 (FRE 801(d))


庭外陈述在证人接受交叉诘问且先前陈述满足以下条件时可被采纳：
由陈述人-证人作出的陈述
  • 与当前证词不一致，且是在伪证罪处罚的宣誓下作出的
  • 与当前证词一致，且用于（1）反驳关于捏造/不正当影响的指控，或（2）恢复证人可信度
  • 或者，指认证人早些时候感知到的人
庭外陈述在用于对抗对方当事人且该陈述满足以下条件时可被采纳：
由对方当事人作出的陈述
  • 由该当事人作出或采纳
  • 由该当事人授权的人作出
  • 由该当事人的代理人/雇员就其关系范围内的事务所作
  • 或者，由该当事人的共谋者在共谋期间且为了推进共谋而作出
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》（Federal Rule of Evidence）。

传闻证据规则通常禁止采纳为证明其所主张事项的真实性而提出的庭外陈述。但某些陈述被该规则排除在外，并被视为非传闻证据。这包括由出庭作证并接受交叉诘问的陈述人所作出的，并且是指认某人为陈述人早些时候所感知到的人的陈述。

为使其可被采纳，这些先前的指认陈述必须基于陈述人-证人的亲身认知。如果一个理性的陪审员能够认定该证人是在讲述其第一手观察或经历，则此要求即被满足——这个标准比“大于百分之五十的可能性”（选项A）要容易满足得多。

在本案中，受害人拟议的证词旨在指认被告为受害人先前感知到并指认为其攻击者的人。由于受害人可以就其陈述接受交叉诘问，因此该陈述为非传闻证据。此外，受害人先前的指认陈述是基于亲身认知，因为防御性伤口的证据足以说服一个理性的陪审员，相信受害人亲眼看到了他的攻击者。因此，受害人关于此陈述的证词是可采纳的。

（选项B）在 United States v. Owens 案中，最高法院采纳了一份指认作出陈述的证人的攻击者的庭外陈述，尽管该证人在庭审中已不记得攻击的经过。法院的理由是，对质条款（confrontation clause）只保证被告有有效进行交叉诘问的机会。当被告可以质疑证人的可信度（例如，偏见、记忆缺失）时，这项保证即被满足。

（选项C）受害人作出了指认被告为其攻击者的庭外陈述这一事实本身，并不足以使其陈述被采纳。

教学目的：如果陈述人在庭审中作证，并就先前的指认接受交叉诘问，那么指认某人为陈述人早些时候所感知到的人的庭外陈述，即为非传闻证据。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 801(d)(1)(C) (prior statement of identification).

Fed. R. Evid. 602 (lay witness personal knowledge).
