MBE 考点解析：商业记录传闻例外

本题考察的是证据法中的核心考点：商业记录传闻例外 (Business Records Exception)。正确答案是 C。

在联邦证据规则 (Federal Rules of Evidence, FRE) 下，医疗记录通常被视为商业记录，因此可以作为传闻证据规则的例外被采纳。

⚖️ 法律规则：FRE 803(6)

根据 FRE 803(6)，一份记录（包括备忘录、报告、数据汇编等）如果满足以下条件，则不被视为不可采纳的传闻证据：

  • 时间性 (Timing)： 在事件发生时或临近之时制作；
  • 知识来源 (Knowledge)： 由具有亲身认知的人制作，或基于具有亲身认知的人提供的信息制作；
  • 常规性 (Regular Practice)： 制作该记录是该机构日常商业活动 (Regularly Conducted Activity) 的一部分。

特别注意：该规则明确包含了“意见” (Opinions) 和 “诊断” (Diagnoses)。

🔍 本案分析

让我们将规则应用到题目中的事实：

  1. 记录内容： 包含了医生的诊断（"C4和C5椎骨骨折"）。FRE 803(6) 明确允许记录中包含诊断意见。
  2. 制作过程： 实习医生 (Intern) 在医生查房时“立即” (Immediately) 记录，满足时间性要求。
  3. 知识链条： 医生检查了X光片（具有亲身认知），并将信息传达给实习医生记录。这符合“基于具有亲身认知的人提供的信息”这一要求。
  4. 基础奠定 (Foundation)： 记录保管员 (Custodian) 已经在法庭上作证，确认该记录是在医院日常业务过程中制作和保存的。

因此，该记录完全符合商业记录例外的所有要素，可以被采纳。

🚫 为什么其他选项是错误的？

选项 A 错误 关于专家资格 (Expert Competence)
这是最强的干扰项。如果医生是作为证人出庭作证，确实需要奠定专家基础 (FRE 702)。但这里引入的是商业记录本身。只要满足 FRE 803(6) 的要求，记录中的诊断即被推定为可信，无需在引入记录时额外证明医生的专家资格。
选项 B 错误 关于基础数据 (Underlying Data)
专家意见所依据的事实或数据（如本案中的X光片）不需要必须作为证据提交。即使在专家作证时 (FRE 703)，只要是该领域专家合理依赖的数据即可。对于商业记录而言，只要记录本身符合规定，其依据的原始材料无需同时呈堂。
选项 D 错误 当时存在的身体状况 (Then-existing Physical Condition)
这是 FRE 803(3) 例外。这个例外通常适用于陈述人 (Declarant) 描述自己当下的感受（如病人喊“我背好痛”）。它不适用于医生对病人状况的诊断或观察。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 证据法题目中，看到“医院记录” (Hospital Records) 时，首先联想 FRE 803(6) 商业记录例外。

切记：虽然医疗记录包含“专家意见”，但引入记录时使用的是传闻例外规则，而不是专家证人规则。不要被“没有奠定专家基础”这类选项迷惑。

questions.question:
Several defendants, senior executives of a corporation, were charged with securities fraud.
The government called as a witness another executive of the corporation, who had not been charged and who had been given immunity from prosecution, to authenticate handwritten notes that she had made after meetings of the corporation's management team at which the alleged fraud was discussed. The witness testified that she had prepared the notes on her own initiative to help her remember what had happened at the meetings. After this testimony, the government offered the notes into evidence to establish what had happened at the meetings.
Should the witness's notes be admitted?

choices.a: No, because the notes are hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: No, because the witness's immunity agreement with the government makes her notes untrustworthy and thus substantially more prejudicial than probative.
choices.c: Yes, because they are business records.
choices.d: Yes, because they are past recollections recorded.

data.questionStem:
Q87006

Several defendants, senior executives of a corporation, were charged with securities fraud.

The government called as a witness another executive of the corporation, who had not been charged and who had been given immunity from prosecution, to authenticate handwritten notes that she had made after meetings of the corporation's management team at which the alleged fraud was discussed. The witness testified that she had prepared the notes on her own initiative to help her remember what had happened at the meetings. After this testimony, the government offered the notes into evidence to establish what had happened at the meetings.

Should the witness's notes be admitted?

几名被告，他们是一家公司的高管，被控证券欺诈罪。

政府传唤了该公司的另一名高管作为证人，该高管未被起诉并获得了检控豁免，以鉴定她在公司管理团队讨论被指控的欺诈行为的会议后所做的手写笔记。证人作证称，她主动准备这些笔记是为了帮助自己记住会议上发生的事情。在该证词之后，政府将这些笔记作为证据提交，以证明会议上发生的事情。

证人的笔记应被采纳为证据吗？
options:
A. No, because the notes are hearsay not within any exception.
不应采纳，因为这些笔记是传闻证据，且不属于任何例外规则的范畴。

B. No, because the witness's immunity agreement with the government makes her notes untrustworthy and thus substantially more prejudicial than probative.
不应采纳，因为证人与政府的豁免协议使其笔记不可信，因此其偏见性影响实质上超过其证明价值。

C. Yes, because they are business records.
应予采纳，因为它们是商业记录。

D. Yes, because they are past recollections recorded.
应予采纳，因为它们是已记录的过去记忆。
data.explanation:
An out-of-court statement (eg, writing) offered for the truth of the matter asserted therein is hearsay and generally inadmissible. However, business records are excepted from the rule against hearsay if those records were:
  • made at or near the time of the recorded event (or act, condition, opinion, diagnosis)
  • made by or based on information from someone with personal knowledge of that event and
  • made and kept as a regular practice (eg, routine meeting minutes) in the course of regularly conducted activities of the business.
But an individual's personal notes (even those made in a business setting) are not the organization's regularly kept business records (Choice C). And when offered for the truth asserted, such personal notes are inadmissible hearsay unless another hearsay exception applies (not seen here).

(Choice B) The witness's immunity from prosecution had no effect on the trustworthiness of her notes because she wrote them prior to the immunity agreement. Therefore, the notes are not substantially more prejudicial than probative, and this is not a basis for excluding them.

(Choice D) The past recollection recorded (ie, recorded recollection) hearsay exception applies to records that
  • (1) concern a matter a witness once knew but cannot recall at trial,
  • (2) were made or adopted by the witness when the matter was fresh in his/her mind, and
  • (3) accurately reflect the witness's knowledge at that time.
But here, the witness has not claimed that she has forgotten what happened at the meetings. And even if she had, she could only read the notes into evidence since only opposing parties could offer them as an exhibit.

Educational objective: Business records are excepted from hearsay if they were
  • (1) made at or near the time of the recorded event,
  • (2) made by or based on information from someone with personal knowledge, and
  • (3) made and kept as a regular practice in the course of regular activities of the business.




选项正确率统计：A选项 49%（正确选项），B选项 5%，C选项 8%，D选项 36%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在庭外做出的陈述（例如，书面文件），为证明其内容所述事项的真实性而提供，属于传闻证据，通常不予采纳。但是，商业记录是传闻证据规则的例外，如果这些记录符合以下条件：
  • 在所记录的事件（或行为、状况、意见、诊断）发生当时或临近当时制作；
  • 由对该事件有亲身认知的人制作，或基于其提供的信息制作；并且
  • 在日常商业活动过程中，作为一种常规惯例（例如，例行会议纪要）而制作和保存。
但个人的私人笔记（即使是在业务环境中制作）并非机构定期保存的商业记录（选项C）。当为证明其所述内容的真实性而提供时，此类个人笔记是不可采纳的传闻证据，除非有其他传闻证据的例外规则适用（本案中未见）。

（选项B） 证人获得的检控豁免对其笔记的可信度没有影响，因为她是在达成豁免协议之前写的这些笔记。因此，这些笔记的偏见性影响并未实质上超过其证明价值，这不构成排除它们的理由。

（选项D） 已记录的过去记忆（即，过往记忆记录）的传闻证据例外规则适用于满足以下条件的记录：
  • （1）涉及证人曾经知晓但在审判时无法回忆的事项；
  • （2）由证人在该事项仍记忆犹新时制作或采纳；并且
  • （3）准确反映了证人当时的认知。
但在本案中，证人并未声称她已经忘记了会议上发生的事情。而且，即使她忘记了，她也只能将笔记宣读作为证据，因为只有对方当事人才能将它们作为证物提交。

教学目标：商业记录是传闻证据的例外，如果它们符合以下条件：
  • （1）在所记录的事件发生当时或临近当时制作；
  • （2）由对该事件有亲身认知的人制作，或基于其提供的信息制作；并且
  • （3）在日常商业活动过程中，作为一种常规惯例而制作和保存。


References

Fed. R. Evid. 803(6) (hearsay exception - records of a regularly conducted activity).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

证据法：传闻证据与商业记录
正确答案：A 不应采纳。因为这些笔记属于传闻证据（Hearsay），且不符合任何传闻例外（Hearsay Exception）。
核心法律逻辑

本题考察的是传闻证据规则（Hearsay Rule）及其例外，特别是商业记录（Business Records）与个人笔记（Personal Notes）的区别。

1. 为什么是传闻证据？

根据《联邦证据规则》（FRE 801），传闻是指：

  • 庭外陈述（Out-of-court statement）；
  • 由陈述者（Declarant）做出；
  • 被提供用于证明其内容所述事项的真实性（Offered for the Truth of the Matter Asserted）。

本案中，证人的笔记是在庭外写的，政府提交它是为了证明“会议上发生了什么”，因此属于典型的传闻证据。除非有例外，否则不可采纳。

2. 为什么不是“商业记录”？
(Business Records Exception, FRE 803(6))

这是本题最大的干扰项（选项C）。要成为商业记录，必须满足以下关键要素：

  • 常规惯例（Regular Practice）：制作该记录必须是该机构的常规做法。
  • 职责义务（Duty）：记录者通常有义务为公司保存这些记录。

本案关键点：题目明确指出证人是“主动”（on her own initiative）做笔记以“帮助自己记忆”。这属于私人备忘录，而非公司要求保存的正式会议纪要。因此，它不具备商业记录所要求的系统性可信度。

为什么其他选项错误？
选项 B 错误

偏见性（Prejudice）： 豁免协议（Immunity Agreement）确实可能影响证人的可信度（Weight），但这通常是交叉询问的话题，并不直接导致证据因“不可信”而被排除（Admissibility）。此外，笔记是在豁免协议之前写的，协议并未影响笔记的制作。

选项 D 错误

过往记忆记录（Recorded Recollection, FRE 803(5)）： 此例外要求证人现在已经想不起来了（Insufficient recollection）。本案中证人并未声称遗忘。
更重要的是：即使符合此例外，记录也只能被宣读（Read into evidence），而不能作为证物（Exhibit）提交给陪审团（除非由对方当事人提出）。题目中政府试图将笔记本身作为证据提交，这在程序上也是错误的。

💡 MBE 破题技巧

看到“日记”、“私人笔记”或“为了帮助记忆而写”的字眼时，要警惕！

这通常是为了排除商业记录例外（Business Records Exception）。商业记录强调的是“机构的常规性”（Regularity of the organization），而不仅仅是是在工作场所写的。

questions.question:
A defendant is on trial for the robbery of an armored bank truck. A man and his wife witnessed the robber flee from the armored truck. The man testified that the robber removed his mask and exposed his face as he fled. The man further testified that he recognized the defendant as the robber. The defendant now seeks to introduce the grand jury testimony of the man's wife, who has refused to testify at trial despite a court order requiring her to do so.
During her grand jury testimony, the wife affirmatively stated that the robber never removed his mask or exposed his face. Despite evidence to the contrary, the prosecution did not press the wife on this matter, as it had more than enough evidence linking the defendant to the robbery to secure an indictment.
If the court does not admit the wife's grand jury testimony, what is the most likely explanation?

choices.a: Grand jury testimony is specifically excluded from the definition of former testimony.
choices.b: The prosecution lacked the motive to develop the wife's testimony at the grand jury proceeding.
choices.c: The wife is available to testify at trial.
choices.d: The wife is unavailable to testify at trial.

questions.question:
A defendant, the mayor of a city, ran an illegal gambling business with his ruthless business partner. The defendant was charged with dishonest and fraudulent dealings in violation of a federal statute and conspiracy to obstruct law enforcement. At trial, the prosecutor called a witness, a secretary working at the police department. The witness intends to testify that an investigating officer told her that he was afraid to arrest the mayor's business partner because certain officers had been punished for arresting members of the business partner's operation in the past.
Is the witness's testimony admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: No, because the statement was not made while under the stress of a startling event.
choices.c: Yes, as a statement by the officer of his then-existing emotional condition.
choices.d: Yes, provided that the officer is unavailable to testify.

data.questionStem:
Q87021

A defendant, the mayor of a city, ran an illegal gambling business with his ruthless business partner. The defendant was charged with dishonest and fraudulent dealings in violation of a federal statute and conspiracy to obstruct law enforcement. At trial, the prosecutor called a witness, a secretary working at the police department. The witness intends to testify that an investigating officer told her that he was afraid to arrest the mayor's business partner because certain officers had been punished for arresting members of the business partner's operation in the past.

Is the witness's testimony admissible?

一名被告，某市市长，与其心狠手辣的商业伙伴共同经营非法赌博业务。该被告被指控违反联邦法规从事不诚实和欺诈性交易，并合谋妨碍执法。庭审时，检察官传唤了一名在警察局工作的秘书作为证人。该证人准备作证称，一名调查警官告诉她，他不敢逮捕市长的商业伙伴，因为过去曾有警官因逮捕该商业伙伴团伙的成员而受到惩罚。

该证人的证言是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
否，因为该证言属于传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。

B. No, because the statement was not made while under the stress of a startling event.
否，因为该陈述并非在惊吓事件的压力下作出。

C. Yes, as a statement by the officer of his then-existing emotional condition.
是，因为这是警官关于其当时心绪状况的陈述。

D. Yes, provided that the officer is unavailable to testify.
是，前提是该警官无法出庭作证。
data.explanation:
Then-existing state of mind hearsay exception (FRE 803(3))


Type of statementExamplesAdmissibility
State of mindMotive, intent, planAdmissible as substantive evidence
Emotional or physical conditionFear, pain, bodily healthAdmissible as substantive evidence
Memory or beliefReflection on prior event or belief about matterInadmissible unless related to declarant's will
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

The rule against hearsay prohibits the admission of a statement made outside the present proceeding that is offered for the truth of the matter asserted therein unless an exception or exclusion applies. One hearsay exception permits admission of a statement concerning the declarant's then-existing state of mind (eg, motive, intent, plan) OR emotional/physical condition (eg, mental feeling, pain, bodily health).

Here, the witness seeks to testify that an officer said that he was afraid to arrest the mayor's business partner because certain officers had been punished for arresting members of the business partner's operation in the past. This out-of-court statement is hearsay since it is offered for its truth - to prove that the officer was afraid of being punished if he arrested the business partner. But since the statement concerns the officer's then-existing emotional condition - his fear of punishment - it is excepted from hearsay and is therefore admissible (Choice A).

(Choice B) An excited utterance is a hearsay exception for a statement that relates to, and was made while under the stress of, a startling event or condition (eg, had the officer blurted out the statement after witnessing a punishment). But though the officer's statement was not made under the stress of excitement, it is still admissible as a then-existing emotional condition.

(Choice D) Some hearsay exceptions only apply if the declarant is unavailable to testify. But the exception for a then-existing emotional condition is not one of those exceptions. Therefore, the witness's statement would be admissible under this exception regardless of whether the officer is available.

Educational objective: Statements regarding a declarant's then-existing state of mind (eg, motive, intent, plan) or emotional/physical condition (eg, mental feeling, pain, bodily health) are excepted from the rule against hearsay.

选项正确率统计：A选项 45%，B选项 0%，C选项 47%（正确选项），D选项 6%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当时存在的精神状态的传闻证据例外 (FRE 803(3))


陈述类型示例可采性
精神状态动机、意图、计划可作为实体证据采纳
心绪或身体状况恐惧、疼痛、身体健康可作为实体证据采纳
记忆或信念对过往事件的回忆或对事项的信念不可采纳，除非与陈述人遗嘱相关
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence)。

反传闻证据规则禁止采纳在当前程序之外作出、为证明其所主张事项的真实性而提出的陈述，除非有例外或排除情况适用。其中一项传闻证据例外允许采纳关于陈述人当时存在的精神状态（例如，动机、意图、计划）或心绪/身体状况（例如，精神感受、疼痛、身体健康）的陈述。

在本案中，证人试图作证称，一名警官说他害怕逮捕市长的商业伙伴，因为过去曾有警官因逮捕该商业伙伴团伙的成员而受到惩罚。这份庭外陈述是传闻证据，因为它是为其真实性而被提出的——即为了证明该警官害怕如果逮捕该商业伙伴会受到惩罚。但由于该陈述涉及警官当时的心绪状况——他对惩罚的恐惧——因此它属于传闻证据的例外情况，故而是可采纳的（选项A）。

（选项B）激动性话语是一项传闻证据例外，适用于与惊吓事件或状况相关、且在该事件或状况的压力下作出的陈述（例如，如果警官在目睹一次惩罚后脱口而出该陈述）。但是，尽管该警官的陈述并非在激动压力下作出，它仍然可作为当时存在的心绪状况而被采纳。

（选项D）某些传闻证据例外仅在陈述人无法出庭作证时适用。但关于当时存在的心绪状况的例外不在此列。因此，无论该警官是否能够出庭，该证人的陈述在此例外下均可采纳。

教学目的：关于陈述人当时存在的精神状态（例如，动机、意图、计划）或心绪/身体状况（例如，精神感受、疼痛、身体健康）的陈述，是反传闻证据规则的例外情况。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 803(3) (hearsay exception for a declarant's then existing emotional condition).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：传闻证据例外
正确答案：C
⚖️ 核心法律规则
Federal Rule of Evidence (FRE) 803(3)
当时存在的精神、情感或身体状况 (Then-Existing Mental, Emotional, or Physical Condition)

即使陈述人可以出庭，关于其当时存在的精神状态（如动机、意图、计划）或情感、感觉、身体状况（如精神感受、疼痛、身体健康）的陈述，不被视为不可采纳的传闻证据。

本题考察的是传闻证据规则（Hearsay Rule）的一个重要例外：情感状况 (Emotional Condition)。

🔍 深度解析
1. 识别传闻证据 (Hearsay)
警官在庭外说的话（"我不敢逮捕..."），被证人在庭上转述，目的是为了证明警官当时确实感到害怕。这符合传闻证据的定义。
2. 寻找例外 (Exception)
警官说 "I was afraid"（我很害怕）。
  • 这是一个直接描述陈述人当时 (Then-existing) 内心感受的陈述。
  • "害怕" (Fear) 属于 Emotional Condition。
  • 因此，它符合 FRE 803(3) 例外，可以作为实质证据 (Substantive Evidence) 采纳。
3. 证据的相关性
本案涉及“合谋妨碍执法” (Conspiracy to obstruct law enforcement)。证明警官因为害怕报复而不敢执法，直接证明了该犯罪组织的威慑力和妨碍执法的效果。
🚫 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A (错误)： 认为没有例外适用。如上所述，FRE 803(3) 明确适用。
选项 B (错误)： 提到了“惊吓事件的压力” (Stress of a startling event)，这是指 激动性言语 (Excited Utterance, FRE 803(2))。虽然本案不符合激动性言语（因为没有突发的惊吓事件），但这并不妨碍它符合“精神/情感状态”的例外。一个陈述只要符合任意一个例外即可采纳。
选项 D (错误)： 这是一个常见的 MBE 陷阱。
关键区别：
  • FRE 803 例外（包括本题的精神状态）：无论陈述人是否在场 (Availability Immaterial) 均适用。
  • FRE 804 例外（如临终遗言、针对自身利益的陈述）：必须要求陈述人无法出庭 (Unavailable)。
因此，警官是否能出庭不影响该证据的可采性。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧

看到涉及 "I feel...", "I intend to...", "I plan to...", "I am afraid..." 的庭外陈述时：

  1. 首先判断是否为了证明该状态的真实性（通常是的）。
  2. 确认该状态是当时存在的 (Then-existing)，而不是对过去的回忆（"I was afraid last year" 通常不行，除非是为了证明遗嘱问题，但 "I am afraid now" 可以）。
  3. 记住 FRE 803(3) 不需要证人“失踪”或“死亡”即可使用。

A plaintiff sued his insurance company for the proceeds of a casualty insurance policy covering his 60-foot yacht, claiming that the yacht was destroyed by an accidental fire. The company has denied liability, claiming that the plaintiff hired his friend to set the fire. In the hospital the day after the fire, the friend, who had been badly burned in the fire, said to his wife, in the presence of an attending nurse, "I was paid to set the fire." Two weeks later, the friend died of an infection resulting from the burns.
At trial, the insurance company calls the wife to testify to the friend's statement.
Is the wife's testimony admissible over the plaintiff's objection?

choices.a: No, because the marital privilege survives the communicating spouse's death.
choices.b: No, because the statement was made after the conspiracy ended.
choices.c: Yes, because it is a statement against interest.
choices.d: Yes, because it is a statement by a coconspirator.

At trial, the insurance company calls the wife to testify to the friend's statement.

Is the wife's testimony admissible over the plaintiff's objection?

一名原告起诉其保险公司，要求支付为其60英尺游艇投保的意外保险单赔偿金，声称该游艇因一场意外火灾被毁。保险公司拒绝承担责任，声称是原告雇佣其朋友纵火。火灾发生第二天，在医院里，那位在火灾中被严重烧伤的朋友，当着一名值班护士的面，对他的妻子说：“有人付钱让我放火。”两周后，该朋友因烧伤引起的感染死亡。

在庭审中，保险公司传唤该妻子就其朋友的陈述作证。

即使原告提出反对，妻子的证言是否可以被采纳？
options:
A. No, because the marital privilege survives the communicating spouse's death.
不可以，因为夫妻特免权在作出交流的配偶死亡后仍然有效。

B. No, because the statement was made after the conspiracy ended.
不可以，因为该陈述是在共谋结束后作出的。

C. Yes, because it is a statement against interest.
可以，因为这是一个不利于己方利益的陈述。

D. Yes, because it is a statement by a coconspirator.
可以，因为这是共谋者的陈述。
data.explanation:
Statement against interest


(FRE 804(b)(3)) Hearsay statement that reasonable person in unavailable declarant's position would only make if true because it:
  • is contrary to declarant's proprietary or pecuniary interest
  • tends to invalidate declarant's claim against someone else or
  • exposes declarant to civil or criminal liability
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

The rule against hearsay generally bars the admission of an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein. But there is an exception for a statement against interest - ie, a statement that a reasonable person in the declarant's position would only have made if he/she believed it to be true because it:
  • is contrary to the declarant's proprietary or pecuniary interest
  • tends to invalidate the declarant's claim against someone else or
  • exposes the declarant to civil or criminal liability.


For this exception to apply, however, the declarant must be unavailable as a witness (eg, deceased).

Here, the friend's out-of-court statement ("I was paid to set the fire") is hearsay since it is being offered for its truth. But a reasonable person in the friend's position would only have said this if it were true since the statement exposed the friend to criminal liability for arson. And since the friend is unavailable to testify (deceased), the wife's testimony as to the friend's statement is admissible under the statement against interest hearsay exception.

(Choice A) Spousal communications are generally privileged if they are made during a valid marriage and reasonably intended to be confidential. This marital privilege survives the communicating spouse's death. But here, confidentiality was not intended since the friend's statement to his wife was made in the nurse's presence.

(Choices B & D) An out-of-court statement made by an opposing party's coconspirator during and in furtherance of the conspiracy is admissible nonhearsay (ie, is excluded from the hearsay rule) when offered against that party. This exclusion does not apply to the friend's statement, which was made after the conspiracy had ended. But the statement is still admissible as a statement against interest.

Educational objective: A statement against interest is a hearsay exception for statements that are so contrary to the declarant's proprietary, pecuniary, or penal interest that a reasonable person in the declarant's position would only have said it if he/she believed it to be true. But this exception only applies if the declarant is unavailable as a witness.

选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 3%，C选项 73%（正确选项），D选项 13%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

不利于己方利益的陈述


(FRE 804(b)(3)) 一项传闻陈述，处于无法出庭的陈述人地位的理性人，只有在相信其为真实的情况下才会作出，因为该陈述：
  • 与陈述人的所有权利益或金钱利益相悖
  • 倾向于使陈述人对他人的主张无效 或
  • 使陈述人面临民事或刑事责任
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence)。

传闻证据规则通常禁止采纳为证明其所主张事项的真实性而提出的庭外陈述。但对于不利于己方利益的陈述存在一个例外——即，处于陈述人地位的理性人，只有在相信其为真实的情况下才会作出的陈述，因为该陈述：
  • 与陈述人的所有权利益或金钱利益相悖
  • 倾向于使陈述人对他人的主张无效 或
  • 使陈述人面临民事或刑事责任。


然而，要适用此例外，陈述人必须无法作为证人出庭（例如，已故）。

在本案中，朋友的庭外陈述（“有人付钱让我放火”）属于传闻证据，因为它是为证明其内容真实性而提出的。但处于该朋友地位的理性人，只有在相信其为真实的情况下才会作出此陈述，因为该陈述使其面临纵火罪的刑事责任。并且由于该朋友无法作证（已故），因此根据传闻证据规则中“不利于己方利益的陈述”的例外规定，妻子就其朋友陈述所作的证言是可采纳的。

(选项A) 夫妻间的交流如果在有效婚姻存续期间作出，并且有合理的保密意图，通常享有特免权。这项夫妻特免权在作出交流的配偶死亡后仍然有效。但在本案中，并无保密意图，因为朋友对其妻子的陈述是在护士在场的情况下作出的。

(选项B和D) 对方当事人的共谋者在共谋期间为推进共谋而作出的庭外陈述，在被用于指证该当事人时，是可采纳的非传闻证据（即被传闻证据规则排除）。此排除规则不适用于朋友的陈述，因为该陈述是在共谋结束之后作出的。但该陈述作为一项不利于己方利益的陈述，仍然可以被采纳。

教学目的：不利于己方利益的陈述是传闻证据的一项例外，适用于那些与陈述人的所有权、金钱或刑事处罚利益严重相悖，以至于处于陈述人地位的理性人只有在相信其为真实的情况下才会作出的陈述。但此例外仅在陈述人无法作为证人出庭时适用。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 804(b)(3) (hearsay exception - statement against interest).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence / Hearsay Exceptions
核心考点：不利于己方利益的陈述 Statement Against Interest (FRE 804(b)(3))

这是一项传闻证据的例外。如果陈述人在庭审时无法出庭 (Unavailable)，且该陈述在作出时严重违背其金钱、财产或刑事利益 (Penal Interest)，以至于理性人只有在相信其为真实时才会作出，则该陈述可采纳。

本案逻辑链条
1
传闻性质 (Hearsay):
朋友的陈述“有人付钱让我放火”是庭外陈述，且被用于证明“他确实放火了”这一事实真相。
2
陈述人无法出庭 (Unavailability):
朋友已经因烧伤感染死亡，符合 FRE 804 对“无法出庭”的要求。这是适用该例外的先决条件。
3
违背刑事利益 (Against Penal Interest):
承认自己受雇纵火（Arson），直接将自己暴露在严重的刑事责任之下。理性人通常不会为了撒谎而承认重罪。

结论：符合例外，可以采纳 (Admissible)。

为什么其他选项是错的？
❌ 夫妻特免权 (Marital Communications Privilege)
虽然该特免权在配偶死后仍然有效，但它仅保护旨在保密 (Intended to be confidential) 的交流。

关键破题点： 朋友是在护士 (Nurse) 在场的情况下说的。第三方的在场破坏了保密性，因此特免权不适用。
❌ 共谋者陈述 (Co-conspirator Statement)
共谋者陈述属于“非传闻” (Non-hearsay)，但必须是在共谋期间 (During) 且为了推进 (In furtherance of) 共谋而作出的。

关键破题点： 朋友是在火灾发生后、躺在医院里说的。此时“纵火”的共谋已经结束，且该陈述只是事后承认，并非为了推进共谋。
💡 MBE 提分技巧

区分 Statement Against Interest 和 Admission by Party-Opponent：

  • Statement Against Interest: 适用于任何人（包括非当事人），但必须要求陈述人无法出庭 (Unavailable)。
  • Admission: 仅适用于对方当事人 (Party-Opponent) 的陈述，不需要考虑是否无法出庭。
本题中，朋友不是诉讼当事人（原告是游艇主人，被告是保险公司），所以只能走 Statement Against Interest 这条路。

questions.question:
A defendant has been charged in federal court with tax evasion. The prosecution alleges that the defendant took money from his closely held corporation and gifted it to his ex-girlfriend in order to avoid paying taxes on the money. At trial, the defendant testified that he merely transferred the money to his ex-girlfriend to hold in trust for the corporation. The defendant further testified that, after their relationship ended and she claimed ownership of the money, he successfully sued the ex-girlfriend for return of the money. The defendant now seeks to introduce an authenticated copy of the state court civil judgment obtained against the ex-girlfriend three years ago to show that the money was not a gift to the ex-girlfriend and belonged to the corporation. The prosecution objected to admission of the state court judgment.
Should the court admit the state court judgment?

choices.a: No, because the copy of the state court judgment violates the "best evidence" rule.
choices.b: No, because the judgment is hearsay not within an exception.
choices.c: Yes, because the judgment was issued in a civil, not criminal, case.
choices.d: Yes, under the hearsay exception for statements affecting an interest in property.

Q87035

A defendant has been charged in federal court with tax evasion. The prosecution alleges that the defendant took money from his closely held corporation and gifted it to his ex-girlfriend in order to avoid paying taxes on the money. At trial, the defendant testified that he merely transferred the money to his ex-girlfriend to hold in trust for the corporation. The defendant further testified that, after their relationship ended and she claimed ownership of the money, he successfully sued the ex-girlfriend for return of the money. The defendant now seeks to introduce an authenticated copy of the state court civil judgment obtained against the ex-girlfriend three years ago to show that the money was not a gift to the ex-girlfriend and belonged to the corporation. The prosecution objected to admission of the state court judgment.

Should the court admit the state court judgment?

一名被告在联邦法院被指控逃税。检方指控称，该被告从其封闭式控股公司取走一笔钱，并将其赠与其前女友，以逃避该笔款项的税款。在审判中，被告作证称，他只是将该笔钱款转移给其前女友，以便为公司代为持有，形成信托关系。被告进一步作证称，在他们关系结束后，女方声称拥有该笔钱款，他成功起诉了前女友并要求其返还该笔钱款。被告现在试图引入三年前对前女友作出的州法院民事判决的经认证副本，以证明该笔钱款并非给前女友的赠与，而是属于该公司。检方反对采纳该州法院判决。

法院是否应采纳该州法院判决？
options:
A. No, because the copy of the state court judgment violates the "best evidence" rule.
不应采纳，因为该州法院判决的副本违反了“最佳证据”规则。

B. No, because the judgment is hearsay not within an exception.
不应采纳，因为该判决是传闻证据，且不属于例外情况。

C. Yes, because the judgment is relevant to the issue of tax evasion.
应予采纳，因为该判决与逃税问题具有相关性。

D. Yes, under the hearsay exception for statements affecting an interest in property.
应予采纳，根据影响财产权益的陈述的传闻证据例外规则。
data.explanation:
Hearsay exceptions for records & statements affecting property interest

(FRE 803(14) - (15))
Record of document that purports to affect property interest is admissible if:
Records		record admitted to prove content of original recorded document, along with signing & delivery by each purported signee record kept in public office and statute authorizes recording such documents in that office
Statement in document that purports to affect property interest is admissible if:
Statements		matter stated was relevant to document's purpose and later dealings with property do not contradict truth of statement or purport of document
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

The rule against hearsay bars the admission of out-of-court statements (here, the state court judgment) offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein (that the money belonged to the corporation) (Choice B). However, certain statements are excluded or excepted from this rule. For example, statements in documents that purport to affect a property interest are excepted from hearsay if:
  • the matter stated was relevant to the document's purpose and
  • later dealings with the property do not contradict the truth of the statement or the purport of the document.
Here, the state court judgment purported to affect the corporation's interest in property (money) and contained statements that were relevant to the judgment's purpose (establishing ownership of the money). Additionally, there is no indication that the money was later dealt with in a manner that was inconsistent with the judgment. Therefore, the court should admit the judgment under this hearsay exception.

(Choice A) The "best evidence" rule generally requires that an original - or a reliable duplicate - be produced to prove the contents of a writing, recording, or photograph. Therefore, the admission of an authenticated copy of the state court judgment would not violate this rule.

(Choice C) The judgment is relevant because it tends to make the fact that the defendant transferred the money to his ex-girlfriend to be held in trust - not to evade taxes - more probable. However, relevant evidence is not automatically admissible and can be excluded on other grounds (eg, hearsay). Therefore, the judgment is admissible because it falls within a hearsay exception.

Educational objective: Statements in documents that purport to affect a property interest are excepted from hearsay if (1) the matter stated was relevant to the document's purpose and (2) later dealings with the property do not contradict the truth of the statement or the purport of the document.

选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 0%，C选项 0%，D选项 100%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

影响财产权益的记录和陈述的传闻证据例外

(FRE 803(14) - (15))
旨在影响财产权益的文件记录，在以下情况下可被采纳：
记录		为证明原始记录文件的内容、以及每位声称签署人的签署和交付而采纳的记录；该记录保存在公共机构，并且有法规授权在该机构记录此类文件。
旨在影响财产权益的文件中的陈述，在以下情况下可被采纳：
陈述		所陈述事项与文件目的相关，并且后续的财产交易与该陈述的真实性或文件主旨不相矛盾。
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence。

反传闻证据规则禁止采纳为证明所主张事项的真实性而提出的庭外陈述（此处指州法院的判决）（即证明该笔钱款属于公司）（选项B）。然而，某些陈述被排除在该规则之外或属于该规则的例外情况。例如，旨在影响财产权益的文件中的陈述，在以下情况下属于传闻证据的例外：
  • 所陈述事项与文件目的具有相关性，并且
  • 后续的财产交易与该陈述的真实性或文件的主旨不相矛盾。
在本案中，该州法院判决旨在影响公司对财产（钱款）的权益，并且包含了与判决目的（确立钱款所有权）相关的陈述。此外，没有迹象表明该笔钱款的后续处理方式与该判决不符。因此，法院应根据此传闻证据例外规则采纳该判决。

（选项A）“最佳证据”规则通常要求，为证明书面文件、录音或照片的内容，必须出示原件或可靠的副本。因此，采纳经认证的州法院判决副本并不违反此规则。

（选项C）该判决具有相关性，因为它使被告将钱款转移给前女友是为了信托持有——而非逃税——这一事实更具可能性。然而，具有相关性的证据并非自动可以采纳，它可能因其他理由（如传闻证据）而被排除。因此，该判决之所以可被采纳，是因为它符合一项传闻证据例外规则。

教学目标：旨在影响财产权益的文件中的陈述，如果(1)所陈述事项与文件目的相关，且(2)后续的财产交易与该陈述的真实性或文件主旨不相矛盾，则属于传闻证据的例外情况。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 803(15) (hearsay exception for statements in documents affecting a property interest).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay Exceptions

本题考察的是证据法中一个较冷门但非常具体的传闻证据例外：影响财产权益的文件中的陈述。

⚖️ 核心规则：FRE 803(15)

Statements in Documents That Affect an Interest in Property

旨在建立或影响财产权益的文件（如地契、遗嘱、判决书）中的陈述，如果满足以下条件，可作为传闻证据的例外被采纳：

  1. 该陈述与文件的目的相关 (Relevant to the document's purpose)；且
  2. 后续对该财产的处理与该陈述不矛盾 (Later dealings are consistent)。
1证据定性

被告试图引入一份州法院民事判决书 (State Court Judgment)。这是一份“庭外陈述” (Out-of-court statement)，目的是为了证明判决书里的内容是真的（即钱属于公司，不属于前女友）。因此，它属于传闻证据 (Hearsay)。

2寻找例外

通常，民事判决书在刑事案件中作为证据是被排除的。但是，本案的判决书确立了财产（钱款）的所有权。

根据 FRE 803(15)，这份文件旨在影响财产权益，且关于“钱属于公司”的陈述与该文件的核心目的直接相关。同时，被告成功起诉并拿回了钱，说明后续处理与该文件一致。

3排除干扰项
  • 最佳证据规则 (Best Evidence Rule): 选项A错误。规则仅要求提供原件或可靠副本。经认证的副本 (Authenticated copy) 完全符合要求 (FRE 1003)。
  • 相关性 (Relevance): 选项C错误。虽然证据必须相关，但“相关”不能自动克服“传闻”的阻碍。必须找到传闻例外。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

看到“地契 (Deed)”、“遗嘱 (Will)”或“确立产权的判决 (Judgment determining title)”被用来证明财产归属时，立即联想 FRE 803(15)。

注意区分：如果是用来证明某人有罪的“前科判决”，那是 FRE 803(22)；但如果是用来证明财产权益归属的文件，适用 FRE 803(15)。

A plaintiff sued a defendant for an assault that occurred in State A. To support his defense that he was in State B on the date of the assault, the defendant identifies and seeks to introduce a letter he wrote to his sister a week before the assault in which he stated that he would see her in State B on that date.
Is the defendant's letter admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is a statement of belief to prove the fact believed.
choices.b: No, because it lacks sufficient probative value.
choices.c: Yes, as a prior consistent statement to support the defendant's credibility as a witness.
choices.d: Yes, within the state of mind exception to the hearsay rule.

data.questionStem:
Q87001

A plaintiff sued a defendant for an assault that occurred in State A. To support his defense that he was in State B on the date of the assault, the defendant identifies and seeks to introduce a letter he wrote to his sister a week before the assault in which he stated that he would see her in State B on that date.

Is the defendant's letter admissible?

一名原告因被告在A州实施的一项攻击罪而起诉该被告。为支持其在攻击罪发生之日身在B州的辩护，被告指认并试图引入一封他在攻击罪发生前一周写给其妹妹的信，信中称他将于案发当日在B州与妹妹见面。

被告的这封信可采纳吗？
options:
A. No, because it is a statement of belief to prove the fact believed.
否，因为它是一份用以证明所信事实的信念陈述。

B. No, because it lacks sufficient probative value.
否，因为它缺乏足够的证明价值。

C. Yes, as a prior consistent statement to support the defendant's credibility as a witness.
是，可作为一份先前一致陈述，用以支持被告作为证人的可信度。

D. Yes, within the state of mind exception to the hearsay rule.
是，属于传闻证据规则中关于当时心智状态的例外情形。
data.explanation:
Then-existing state of mind


(FRE 803(3)) Hearsay exception for statements of declarant's (available or not) then-existing:
  • state of mind (eg, motive, intent, plan)
  • emotional, sensory, or physical condition (eg, mental state, pain, bodily health)
BUT NOT
memory of past events or belief unless related to validity or terms of declarant's will
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Hearsay is an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein. Such statements are inadmissible unless they are excluded or excepted from the rule against hearsay. One hearsay exception is for statements of a declarant's then-existing state of mind - eg, motive, intent, or plan - which can be admitted as substantive proof that the declarant later acted in accordance with that state of mind.

Here, the defendant's letter is hearsay because it was written before the assault (out-of-court statement) and is being offered to show that the defendant planned to see his sister in State B on the date of the assault in State A (asserted truth). But since the letter concerns the defendant's plan , it falls under the then-existing state of mind exception to the hearsay rule. Therefore, the letter is admissible to prove that the defendant acted in accordance with that plan and was in State B on the date of the assault.

(Choice A) Although statements of the declarant's memory or belief typically fall outside the then-existing state of mind exception to the hearsay rule, statements of the declarant's then-existing plan do not (as seen here).

(Choice B) Probative value is the degree to which evidence makes a material fact more or less likely. Here, the defendant's letter is sufficiently probative because it makes it far more likely that he was in State B on the day of the assault.

(Choice C) A prior statement that is consistent with the witness's current testimony is admissible if the witness is subject to cross-examination and the statement is offered to (1) rebut a charge of fabrication or improper influence or (2) rehabilitate the witness. But here, there is no indication that the defendant's credibility was impeached.

Educational objective: Statements of a declarant's then-existing state of mind (eg, motive, intent, plan) are excepted from the rule against hearsay and are admissible as substantive proof that the declarant later acted in accordance with that state of mind.

选项正确率统计：A选项 7%，B选项 6%，C选项 10%，D选项 75%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当时的既存心智状态


(FRE 803(3)) 传闻证据例外，适用于陈述人（无论其是否可以作证）当时的既存：
  • 心智状态（例如，动机、意图、计划）
  • 情绪、感官或身体状况（例如，精神状态、疼痛、身体健康）
但不包括
对过往事件的记忆或信念，除非与陈述人遗嘱的效力或条款有关
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence)。

传闻证据是在庭外作出的、为证明其所主张事项之真实性而提出的陈述。此类陈述不可采纳，除非它们被排除在反传闻证据规则之外或属于该规则的例外情形。其中一个传闻证据例外是关于陈述人当时的既存心智状态的陈述——例如，动机、意图或计划——这种陈述可被采纳为实质性证据，以证明陈述人后来按照该心智状态行事。

在本案中，被告的信件属于传闻证据，因为它是在攻击罪发生前写就的（庭外陈述），且被用以证明被告计划在A州攻击罪发生之日于B州见其妹妹（所主张的事实）。但由于该信件涉及被告的计划，它属于传闻证据规则中关于当时既存心智状态的例外情形。因此，该信件可以被采纳，以证明被告按照该计划行事，并在攻击罪发生之日身在B州。

(选项 A) 尽管陈述人关于记忆或信念的陈述通常不属于传闻证据规则中关于当时既存心智状态的例外，但陈述人关于当时既存计划的陈述则不在此列（如本案所示）。

(选项 B) 证明价值是指证据使某一重要事实变得更可能或更不可能的程度。在本案中，被告的信件具有足够的证明价值，因为它极大地增加了他在攻击罪发生之日身在B州的可能性。

(选项 C) 与证人当前证词一致的先前陈述，如果该证人需接受交叉询问，且该陈述是为了（1）反驳关于捏造事实或不正当影响的指控，或（2）修复证人可信度而提出的，则可以采纳。但在本案中，没有迹象表明被告的可信度遭到了弹劾。

教学目标：陈述人关于其当时既存心智状态（例如，动机、意图、计划）的陈述，属于反传闻证据规则的例外，并可被采纳为实质性证据，以证明陈述人之后按照该心智状态行事。

References

  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(3) (hearsay exception - declarant's then-existing state of mind).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence Law (证据法)
D
正确答案：Yes, within the state of mind exception.

本题考察的是传闻证据规则（Hearsay Rule）中的一个核心例外：当时既存的心智状态（Then-Existing State of Mind）。

核心法条：FRE 803(3)

根据《联邦证据规则》803(3)，陈述人关于其当时既存的心智状态（如动机、意图或计划）的陈述，属于传闻证据的例外，可以采纳。

关键应用：这种陈述可以用来证明陈述人随后按照该意图或计划行事（acted in conformity with the plan）。

1. 识别传闻 (Identify Hearsay) 被告的信是在庭外（Out-of-court）写的，现在被告试图将其引入庭审，目的是为了证明信中所主张内容的真实性（即他确实计划去B州，并推论他实际上去了B州）。因此，这属于传闻（Hearsay）。
2. 应用 "Hillmon Doctrine" 这是美国证据法中著名的 Hillmon Doctrine（源自案例 Mutual Life Insurance Co. v. Hillmon）。

规则允许引入一个人表达“我要去某地”或“我打算做某事”的陈述，作为间接证据来推断该人后来确实去了该地或做了该事。
3. 结合本案 被告在信中说“我将在B州见你”（Statement of future intent/plan）。这封信可以被采纳，用来证明被告在案发当日确实执行了该计划，身在B州，从而支持他的不在场证明（Alibi）。

为什么其他选项是错误的？

  • 选项 A (Statement of belief): 错误。FRE 803(3) 明确排除了“对过去事实的记忆或信念”（statement of memory or belief to prove the fact remembered）。但本题是被告陈述未来的计划（Forward-looking），而不是回忆过去（Backward-looking），因此不属于被排除的“信念陈述”。
  • 选项 B (Probative value): 错误。证据的相关性（Relevance）门槛很低。一封写于案发前的信表明他计划去B州，这对于证明他不在A州具有极高的证明价值（Probative value）。
  • 选项 C (Prior consistent statement): 错误。虽然这是被告之前的陈述，但“先前一致陈述”通常只有在证人被指控“近期捏造”（Recent fabrication）或受到“不正当影响”时才可采纳（FRE 801(d)(1)(B)）。题目中没有提到原告攻击被告撒谎或捏造证词，因此不能以此理由引入。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 在处理 State of Mind (803(3)) 考题时，请牢记区分两个方向：
1. 向前看 (Forward-looking)： “我打算下周去纽约。” → 可采纳，证明他后来去了纽约。
2. 向后看 (Backward-looking)： “我认为我昨天锁门了。” → 不可采纳，这是对过去事实的记忆（除非涉及遗嘱案件）。

questions.question:
A defendant, a nurse at a nursing home, is charged with murdering a resident at the home by adding an allegedly lethal substance to the resident's food. At trial, to prove that the substance added to the resident's food could result in death, the prosecutor, without first calling any witnesses, offers to read into evidence several pages from a standard medical treatise that supports the prosecution's claim that the substance the defendant added to the food is lethal.
Is the evidence offered admissible?

choices.a: No, because the treatise excerpts were not offered during the examination of a qualified expert.
choices.b: No, because the treatise itself must be introduced as an exhibit.
choices.c: Yes, although hearsay, under the learned treatise exception to the hearsay rule.
choices.d: Yes, because the lethal nature of the substance is relevant to the defendant's state of mind and intent.

data.questionStem:
Q87820 A defendant, a nurse at a nursing home, is charged with murdering a resident at the home by adding an allegedly lethal substance to the resident's food. At trial, to prove that the substance added to the resident's food could result in death, the prosecutor, without first calling any witnesses, offers to read into evidence several pages from a standard medical treatise that supports the prosecution's claim that the substance the defendant added to the food is lethal.

Is the evidence offered admissible? 一名被告是养老院的护士，其被指控通过在一名住户的食物中添加一种据称致命的物质来谋杀该住户。在审判中，为了证明添加到住户食物中的物质可能导致死亡，检察官在未首先传唤任何证人的情况下，提议将一本标准医学专著中的几页内容宣读为证据，该专著支持了控方关于被告添加到食物中的物质是致命的主张。

所提供的证据是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because the treatise excerpts were not offered during the examination of a qualified expert.
不可采纳，因为该专著节选并非在对合格专家进行询问时提出。

B. No, because the treatise itself must be introduced as an exhibit.
不可采纳，因为该专著本身必须作为物证提交。

C. Yes, although hearsay, under the learned treatise exception to the hearsay rule.
可采纳，虽然是传闻证据，但符合传闻证据规则中的学术专著例外。

D. Yes, because the lethal nature of the substance is relevant to the defendant's state of mind and intent.
可采纳，因为该物质的致命性与被告的心理状态和意图相关。
data.explanation:
Learned treatise hearsay exception

(FRE 803(18))

Statement in publication admissible if:

statement called to attention of, or relied upon by, expert during examination and publication established as reliable authority by any party's expert or judicial notice

FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Hearsay is an out-of-court statement (eg, the treatise excerpts) offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein (eg, the substance added to the victim's food is lethal) and is generally inadmissible. But under the learned treatise exception to the hearsay rule, a party may read statements in a publication into evidence if:

the statement is called to the attention of, or relied upon by, an expert witness during examination and

the publication is established as a reliable authority by any party's expert or judicial notice.

Here, the excerpts were taken from a standard medical treatise, which could probably be established as a reliable authority. But since they were not offered during the examination of a qualified expert, the learned treatise exception does not apply. Therefore, the excerpts are inadmissible hearsay and the prosecutor cannot read them into evidence (Choice C).

(Choice B) A statement that is admitted under the learned treatise exception may be read into evidence, but neither the statement nor the publication itself may be introduced as an exhibit.

(Choice D) Although the lethal nature of the substance is relevant to the defendant's state of mind and intent, the statements in the treatise are still inadmissible hearsay absent an exception (none of which apply here).

Educational objective: Under the learned treatise exception to the rule against hearsay, a statement in a publication may be read into evidence if (1) the statement is called to the attention of, or relied upon by, an expert witness during examination and (2) the publication is established as a reliable authority by any party's expert or judicial notice.

学术专著传闻证据例外

(《联邦证据规则》第803(18)条)

出版物中的陈述在以下情况下可采纳：



在询问期间，该陈述被提请专家注意或被专家所依赖并且

该出版物经由任一方的专家或司法认知确认为可靠权威。



FRE =《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence)。

传闻证据是指在庭外作出的陈述（例如，专著节选），用于证明其所主张事项的真实性（例如，添加到受害者食物中的物质是致命的），通常不可采纳。但根据传闻证据规则的学术专著例外，一方当事人可以将出版物中的陈述宣读为证据，前提是：



  • 在询问期间，该陈述被提请专家证人注意或被其所依赖并且
  • 该出版物经由任一方的专家或司法认知确认为可靠权威。


本案中，节选内容来自一本标准的医学专著，该专著很可能被确认为可靠权威。但由于这些节选并非在对合格专家进行询问时提出，因此学术专著例外不适用。因此，这些节选是不可采纳的传闻证据，检察官不能将其宣读为证据（选项C）。



(选项B) 根据学术专著例外被采纳的陈述可以被宣读为证据，但陈述本身或出版物本身均不得作为物证提交。



(选项D) 尽管该物质的致命性与被告的心理状态和意图相关，但在没有例外情况（本案中无一适用）的情形下，该专著中的陈述仍然是不可采纳的传闻证据。



教学目的：

根据反传闻证据规则的学术专著例外，出版物中的陈述可以被宣读为证据，前提是 (1) 在询问期间，该陈述被提请专家证人注意或被其所依赖，并且 (2) 该出版物经由任一方的专家或司法认知确认为可靠权威。



References
Fed. R. Evid. 803 (exceptions to the rule against hearsay).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence Law · 证据法
核心规则：学术专著例外
Learned Treatise Exception (FRE 803(18))
学术专著属于传闻证据 (Hearsay)，原则上不可采纳。但若满足以下两个条件，可作为例外被采纳：
  1. 专家依赖 (Expert Reliance): 必须在专家证人 (Expert Witness) 作证期间提出，且该专家依赖此专著或被提请注意此专著。
  2. 权威性 (Reliability): 必须被确认为可靠的权威来源 (Reliable Authority)。
案情关键点分析

本题中，检察官试图朗读医学专著来证明物质的致命性。关键的致命伤在于：
"without first calling any witnesses"
（未首先传唤任何证人）。

这意味着没有专家证人在场为该证据“背书”或“奠定基础” (Lay the foundation)。

选项深度解析
正确答案 A 不可采纳，因为未在专家询问期间提出。

法律依据： 根据 FRE 803(18)，学术专著不能“独立”作为证据出现。它必须依附于一位专家证人。如果没有专家在证人席上接受询问 (Examination)，专著的内容就是纯粹的不可采纳的传闻证据。
陷阱选项 B 关于“作为物证提交” (Introduce as an exhibit)

这是一个常见的 MBE 考点陷阱。规则明确规定：学术专著的内容可以朗读给陪审团听 (Read into evidence)，但书本本身不得作为物证 (Exhibit) 提交给陪审团带入研议室。选项 B 正好说反了。
错误选项 C 关于“符合例外”

虽然该书可能是“可靠权威”，但只满足了规则的一半要求。缺少了“专家证人介入”这一程序性前提，例外条款不适用。
错误选项 D 关于“相关性” (Relevance)

相关性 (Relevance) 是证据可采纳的必要条件，但不是充分条件。即使证据高度相关，如果它违反了传闻证据规则 (Hearsay Rule) 且无例外适用，依然不可采纳。
MBE 实战技巧
在处理 Learned Treatise 考题时，请记住口诀：
"No Expert, No Book"
(无专家，无专著)
  • 专著必须由专家引入。
  • 专著只能读，不能给（不能作为 Exhibit）。

questions.question:
A consumer has sued the manufacturer of a microwave oven for burn injuries allegedly caused by the manufacturer's negligent failure to warn purchasers of the dangers of heating foods in certain types of containers.
The consumer has offered into evidence three letters, all received by the manufacturer before the oven was shipped to the consumer, in which customers had complained of serious burns under circumstances similar to those in the consumer's case. The manufacturer has objected to the letters on the grounds of hearsay and, in the alternative, has asked for a limiting instruction directing that the letters be considered not for the truth of the assertions contained in them but only regarding the issue of notice.
How should the court respond?

choices.a: The court should overrule the objection and deny the request for a limiting instruction.
choices.b: The court should overrule the objection and give the limiting instruction.
choices.c: The court should overrule the objection but allow only that the letters be read to the jury, not received as exhibits.
choices.d: The court should sustain the objection and treat the request for a limiting instruction as moot.

data.questionStem:
Q87039

A consumer has sued the manufacturer of a microwave oven for burn injuries allegedly caused by the manufacturer's negligent failure to warn purchasers of the dangers of heating foods in certain types of containers.

The consumer has offered into evidence three letters, all received by the manufacturer before the oven was shipped to the consumer, in which customers had complained of serious burns under circumstances similar to those in the consumer's case. The manufacturer has objected to the letters on the grounds of hearsay and, in the alternative, has asked for a limiting instruction directing that the letters be considered not for the truth of the assertions contained in them but only regarding the issue of notice.

How should the court respond?

一名消费者起诉了一家微波炉制造商，指控其因过失未能警告购买者在某些类型的容器中加热食物的危险，从而导致了消费者的烧伤。

该消费者提交了三封信件作为证据，这些信件均是在涉案微波炉运送给该消费者之前由制造商收到的，信中客户投诉了在与该消费者案件情况类似的情形下遭受了严重烧伤。制造商以传闻证据为由对这些信件提出异议，并作为替代方案，请求法院作出限制性指示，要求陪审团不应将这些信件用于证明其所含主张的真实性，而仅能用于考量“通知”这一争议点。

法院应如何裁决？
options:
A. The court should overrule the objection and deny the request for a limiting instruction.
法院应驳回异议并拒绝作出限制性指示的请求。

B. The court should overrule the objection and give the limiting instruction.
法院应驳回异议并作出限制性指示。

C. The court should overrule the objection but allow only that the letters be read to the jury, not received as exhibits.
法院应驳回异议，但只允许向陪审团宣读信件，而不将其作为呈堂证物接收。

D. The court should sustain the objection and treat the request for a limiting instruction as moot.
法院应采纳异议，并将作出限制性指示的请求视为无实际意义。
data.explanation:
An out-of-court statement is only hearsay if it is offered for the truth of the matter asserted therein. Therefore, an out-of-court statement offered for some other relevant purpose is not barred by the hearsay rule. However, upon a timely request by the opposing party, the court must:
  • limit the admissibility of that statement to its nonhearsay purpose and
  • instruct the jury accordingly - eg, "the evidence may be considered not for the truth of the assertions contained in them but only regarding the issue of notice."

Here, the consumer has offered three letters (out-of-court statements) in which customers complained of serious burns under circumstances like those in this negligent failure to warn case. Since the purpose of these letters is to show that the manufacturer had notice of the purported injuries - not to prove that it actually caused them (truth of the matter asserted) - the letters are not hearsay. Therefore, the manufacturer's hearsay objection should be overruled (Choice D). But the court must give the limiting instruction requested by the manufacturer (Choice A).

(Choice C) If the letters are admissible for a nonhearsay purpose, there is no rule limiting how they may be admitted - eg, through testimony, as exhibits.

Educational objective: The hearsay rule does not apply to out-of-court statements offered for some relevant purpose other than proving the truth of the matter asserted therein. But the court, upon timely request, must limit the statement to its nonhearsay use and instruct the jury accordingly.



选项正确率统计：A选项 10%，B选项 72%（正确选项），C选项 6%，D选项 10%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

一项庭外陈述只有在为证明其所主张事项的真实性而提出时，才构成传闻证据。因此，为某些其他相关目的而提出的庭外陈述，不受传闻证据规则的禁止。然而，应对方当事人的及时请求，法院必须：
  • 将该陈述的可采性限制于其非传闻目的并且
  • 相应地指示陪审团——例如，“该证据不得被采信为证明其内容所含主张的真实性，而仅能用于考量‘通知’这一争议点。”

在本案中，消费者提交了三封信件（庭外陈述），信中客户在该“过失未能警告”案的类似情况下投诉了严重烧伤。由于提交这些信件的目的是为了证明制造商已收到关于所声称伤害的通知——而不是为了证明其确实造成了这些伤害（即所主张事项的真实性）——因此这些信件不构成传闻证据。因此，制造商的传闻证据异议应被驳回（选项D错误）。但法院必须应制造商的请求作出限制性指示（选项A错误）。

（选项C）如果信件因非传闻目的而可采纳，则没有规则限制其被采纳的方式——例如，通过证言或作为呈堂证物。

教学目标：传闻证据规则不适用于为证明所主张事项真实性以外的其他相关目的而提出的庭外陈述。但法院应对方当事人的及时请求，必须将该陈述的使用限制于其非传闻目的，并相应地指示陪审团。

References

  • Fed. R. Evid. 801(c) (definition of hearsay).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 105 (limiting use of evidence to its admissible purposes).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay & Notice

核心法律规则

传闻证据规则 (Hearsay Rule)

根据 Federal Rules of Evidence (FRE) 801(c)，传闻证据是指：

  • 庭外陈述 (Out-of-court statement)；
  • 被提出用于证明所主张事项的真实性 (Truth of the matter asserted)。
关键例外：非传闻目的 (Non-Hearsay Purpose)
如果陈述不是为了证明内容的真实性，而是为了证明该陈述对听者产生的影响（如通知/知情 Notice），则它不是传闻证据。

本案逻辑分析

1. 证据的性质：
消费者提供的三封信件属于庭外陈述。
2. 证据的目的 (Purpose)：
这是一个过失未能警告 (Negligent failure to warn) 的案件。原告需要证明制造商知道存在危险但未发出警告。

原告引入这些信件，是为了证明制造商在发货前收到了投诉 (Notice)，从而知晓潜在危险。原告不是用这些信件来证明之前的客户真的被烧伤了（真实性），而是证明制造商“听说过”这件事。
3. 结论：
因为用于证明“通知 (Notice)”，所以这些信件不是传闻证据 (Not Hearsay)，可以被采纳 (Admissible)。

限制性指示 (Limiting Instruction)

FRE 105

当证据对某个目的（如 Notice）是可采纳的，但对另一个目的（如证明烧伤事实 Truth）是不可采纳时，如果一方当事人提出请求，法院必须 (Must)：

  1. 接纳该证据；
  2. 向陪审团作出限制性指示，告知他们只能将该证据用于允许的目的。

为什么选 B？

选项 B 正确：法院应驳回异议并作出限制性指示。

  • 驳回异议 (Overrule objection)：因为信件用于证明 Notice，不是传闻，所以证据可采。
  • 作出指示 (Give instruction)：制造商提出了替代请求。根据 FRE 105，法院有义务指示陪审团：“你们看这些信只是为了判断制造商是否知情，而不是判断信里写的烧伤事故是否真的发生过。”
正确答案：B

其他选项为何错误

  • 选项 A： 错误。虽然证据可采，但法院不能拒绝当事人提出的限制性指示请求（FRE 105 的强制性）。
  • 选项 C： 错误。如果文件证据是可采的，通常可以作为呈堂证物 (Exhibit) 提交给陪审团查看，没有规则限制只能“读”而不“收”。
  • 选项 D： 错误。证据是可采的，因此不应采纳 (Sustain) 传闻异议。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

在涉及产品责任 (Product Liability) 或 过失 (Negligence) 的题目中，如果出现“之前的投诉信”或“之前的事故报告”，请立即联想：

Notice (知情/通知) = Not Hearsay

只要不是为了证明之前事故的细节真实性，而是为了证明被告“知道有这回事”，它就不是传闻证据。

questions.question:
A woman sued a landlord for injuries received when she fell down a stairway in the landlord's apartment building. The woman, a guest in the building, alleged that she caught the heel of her shoe in a tear in the stair carpet. The woman calls a tenant at the apartment building to testify that the tenant's roommate had said to the tenant a week before the woman's fall: "When I paid the rent this morning, I told the landlord he had better fix that torn carpet."
Is the roommate's statement, as reported by the tenant, admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: Yes, to prove that the carpet was defective.
choices.c: Yes, to prove that the landlord had notice of the defect.
choices.d: Yes, to prove both that the carpet was defective and that the landlord had notice of the defect.

data.questionStem:
Q87015

A woman sued a landlord for injuries received when she fell down a stairway in the landlord's apartment building. The woman, a guest in the building, alleged that she caught the heel of her shoe in a tear in the stair carpet. The woman calls a tenant at the apartment building to testify that the tenant's roommate had said to the tenant a week before the woman's fall: "When I paid the rent this morning, I told the landlord he had better fix that torn carpet."

Is the roommate's statement, as reported by the tenant, admissible?

一名女性因在房东的公寓楼楼梯上摔倒受伤而起诉房东。该女性是楼内的一名访客，她声称自己的鞋跟被楼梯地毯的破损处绊住了。该女性传唤公寓楼的一名租客作证，证明在该女性摔倒前一周，该租客的室友曾对租客说：“我今天早上付房租的时候，告诉房东他最好把那块破了的地毯修一下。”

由租客转述的室友的陈述，是否可以采纳为证据？
options:
A. No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
不可以，因为该陈述是传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。

B. Yes, to prove that the carpet was defective.
可以，用以证明地毯存在缺陷。

C. Yes, to prove that the landlord had notice of the defect.
可以，用以证明房东已接到关于该缺陷的通知。

D. Yes, to prove both that the carpet was defective and that the landlord had notice of the defect.
可以，用以同时证明地毯存在缺陷以及房东已接到关于该缺陷的通知。
data.explanation:
The rule against hearsay bars the admission of an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein. When such a statement is contained within another (ie, double hearsay), neither statement is admissible unless both are excluded or excepted from the hearsay rule.

Here, the roommate's statement to the landlord that he "had better fix that torn carpet" is inadmissible hearsay if it is offered for the truth of the matter asserted - ie, that the carpet was defective. That is because the statement does not fall within a hearsay exclusion or exception (Choice B). However, the statement is not hearsay if it is offered for a different purpose - eg, to show that the landlord had notice of the defect.

Even if the roommate's statement to the landlord is not hearsay, it is only admissible if the roommate's statement to the tenant is also admissible. That statement is inadmissible hearsay because it is being used solely to prove the truth of the matter asserted - ie, that the roommate had told the landlord about the defect - and is not excluded or excepted from hearsay. Therefore, both statements as reported by the tenant are inadmissible (Choices C & D).

Educational objective: When a hearsay statement is contained within another, neither statement is admissible unless both are excluded or excepted from the rule against hearsay.





选项正确率统计：A选项 26%（正确选项），B选项 2%，C选项 59%，D选项 12%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

反传闻证据规则禁止采纳庭外陈述以证明其所述事项的真实性。当一份陈述包含在另一份陈述之中（即双重传闻证据），除非两份陈述都属于传闻证据规则的排除或例外情况，否则任何一份陈述都不可采纳。

在此案中，如果室友对房东所说的“最好把那块破了的地毯修一下”的陈述是为了证明其所述事项的真实性（即地毯存在缺陷），那么该陈述是不可采纳的传闻证据。这是因为该陈述不符合传闻证据的排除或例外情况（选项 B）。然而，如果该陈述是为了其他目的（例如，为了证明房东已接到关于该缺陷的通知），那么它就不构成传闻证据。

即使室友对房东的陈述不构成传闻证据，也只有在室友对租客的陈述同样可采纳的情况下，该陈述才可采纳。后一份陈述（即室友对租客的陈述）是不可采纳的传闻证据，因为它仅被用于证明其所述事项的真实性（即室友已将缺陷告知房东），且不属于传闻证据的排除或例外情况。因此，由租客转述的两份陈述均不可采纳（选项 C 和 D）。

教学目的：当一份传闻证据陈述包含在另一份陈述中时，除非两份陈述都属于反传闻证据规则的排除或例外情况，否则任何一份陈述都不可采纳。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 801 (definition of hearsay).

Fed. R. Evid. 805 (hearsay within hearsay).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay within Hearsay
正确答案：A
不可采纳，因为这是传闻证据且不符合任何例外。
(No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.)
核心考点：双重传闻 (Double Hearsay)

本题考查的是 Federal Rule of Evidence (FRE) 805。当一个传闻陈述包含在另一个传闻陈述中时（即“传闻中的传闻”），只有当每一层陈述都符合传闻证据规则的例外或豁免时，整个陈述才可采纳。

Rule: Hearsay within hearsay is not excluded by the rule against hearsay if each part of the combined statements conforms with an exception to the rule.
证据链条分析 (The Chain of Evidence)

我们需要像剥洋葱一样分析这个证据链。只要有一层断裂（不可采纳），整个证据就无效。

🗣️
内层 (Layer 2):
室友(Roommate) → 房东(Landlord)
"最好把地毯修一下"
可能通过
分析：如果用来证明房东有知情 (Notice)，这不算传闻 (Not Hearsay)，因为不是为了证明地毯坏了，而是证明房东听到了警告。
👂
外层 (Layer 1):
室友(Roommate) → 租客(Tenant)
"我告诉过房东了..."
断裂 (FAIL)
分析：这是致命伤。室友在庭外对租客说的话，是用来证明“室友确实跟房东说过话”这一事实的真实性 (Truth of the matter asserted)。

这里没有适用的例外：
  • 不是 Excited Utterance (无激动情绪)
  • 不是 Present Sense Impression (时间间隔太久，"this morning" vs 说话时)
陷阱排除

选项 B (证明缺陷) 错误：
即使没有外层传闻的问题，如果目的是证明“地毯坏了”(Truth)，内层陈述本身就是传闻，且无例外。

选项 C & D (证明通知) 错误：
这是最强的干扰项。虽然内层陈述可以用来证明 Notice (非传闻用途)，但外层陈述（室友告诉租客这件事）仍然是纯粹的传闻。因为租客没有亲耳听到室友对房东说话，租客只是听室友“转述”了这件事。

💡 MBE 技巧 (Exam Tip):
看到 "A testifies that B said that C said..." 这种结构时，立即警惕 Double Hearsay。
不要只盯着最里面的那句话（是否构成 Notice），要检查传递信息的每一步。如果中间传话的人（本题中的室友对租客）没有传闻例外，整个证据链就断了。
© MBE Evidence Study Guide
Based on NCBE Standards

questions.question:
A patient sued a hospital for medical negligence, claiming that a nurse employed by the hospital failed to administer critical medication prescribed by the patient's treating physician during the patient's hospitalization.
At trial, to prove the nurse's failure to administer the prescribed medication, the patient has called the medical records librarian, who has authenticated the hospital's record of the patient's treatment, which contains no entry showing that the medication in question was administered.
Is the hospital record admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: No, because the nurse's testimony would be the best evidence of her actions in treating the patient.
choices.c: Yes, because, although hearsay, it is a statement against interest by agents of the hospital.
choices.d: Yes, because it is within the hearsay exception covering the absence of entries in business records.

data.questionStem:
Q87032

A patient sued a hospital for medical negligence, claiming that a nurse employed by the hospital failed to administer critical medication prescribed by the patient's treating physician during the patient's hospitalization.

At trial, to prove the nurse's failure to administer the prescribed medication, the patient has called the medical records librarian, who has authenticated the hospital's record of the patient's treatment, which contains no entry showing that the medication in question was administered.

Is the hospital record admissible?

一名病人因医疗过失起诉了一家医院，声称该医院雇佣的一名护士在病人住院期间，未能为其施用主治医生开具的关键药物。

在庭审中，为证明护士未能施用处方药物，病人传唤了病历档案管理员，该管理员认证了医院的病人治疗记录，该记录中没有任何条目显示涉案药物已被施用。

该医院记录是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
否，因为它是传闻证据，且不属于任何例外情况。

B. No, because the nurse's testimony would be the best evidence of her actions in treating the patient.
否，因为护士关于其治疗病人行为的证言才是最佳证据。

C. Yes, because, although hearsay, it is a statement against interest by agents of the hospital.
是，因为虽然是传闻证据，但它是由医院代理人作出的不利于己方利益的陈述。

D. Yes, because it is within the hearsay exception covering the absence of entries in business records.
是，因为它属于传闻证据例外中涵盖商业记录条目缺失的情况。
data.explanation:
Business records hearsay exception


Existing record
(FRE 803(6))		Admissible as substantive evidence if:
  • made at or near time of recorded event (or act, opinion, condition, diagnosis)
  • made by or based on information from someone with personal knowledge and
  • made & kept as regular practice in course of regularly conducted business activities
Absence of record
(FRE 803(7))		Admissible as substantive evidence if:
  • evidence is offered to prove matter did not occur or exist
  • record was regularly kept for that kind of matter and
  • opponent does not establish a lack of trustworthiness
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence

An out-of-court statement (eg, hospital record) offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein is generally inadmissible under the rule against hearsay. However, evidence that a matter is not included in a business record is excepted from the hearsay rule and may be offered as substantive evidence if: the evidence is offered to prove that a matter did not occur or exist, a record was regularly kept for a matter of that kind, and the opponent does not establish a lack of trustworthiness for the source of that information.

Here, the authenticated hospital record is hearsay, but it falls within the hearsay exception covering the absence of entries in business records. That is because the missing entry in that record is being used to prove that the administration of medication - a matter that would regularly be recorded by the hospital - did not occur. And since there is no indication that the record is untrustworthy, it is admissible (Choice A).

(Choice B) The best evidence rule requires that an original (or reliable duplicate) of a writing, recording, or photograph be produced to prove its contents. But this rule does not mandate the use of live testimony over a document.

(Choice C) The statement against interest hearsay exception applies to a statement that goes against the declarant's pecuniary, proprietary, or penal interest AND is made by a declarant who is unavailable as a witness. Since there is no indication that the nurse is unavailable, this exception does not apply here.

Educational objective: The hearsay exception for the absence of entries in business records applies when (1) evidence is offered to prove that a matter did not occur or exist, (2) a record was regularly kept for a matter of that kind, and (3) the opponent does not establish a lack of trustworthiness.

选项正确率统计：A选项 4%，B选项 1%，C选项 4%，D选项 90%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

商业记录的传闻证据例外


现有记录
(FRE 803(6))		在以下情况下可作为实体证据采纳：
  • 在记录的事件（或行为、意见、状况、诊断）发生时或临近发生时制作
  • 由具备亲身认知的人员制作，或基于其提供的信息制作并且
  • 在正常进行的商业活动过程中，作为常规惯例制作和保存
记录的缺失
(FRE 803(7))		在以下情况下可作为实体证据采纳：
  • 证据被提供用以证明某事项未曾发生或存在
  • 对于该类事项，有定期保存记录的惯例并且
  • 反对一方未能证明该记录缺乏可信性
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence)

庭外陈述（例如，医院记录）在被用于证明其所述事项的真实性时，根据反传闻证据规则，通常是不可采纳的。然而，证明某一事项未被包含在商业记录中的证据，是传闻证据规则的例外，并且在以下情况下可以作为实体证据提供：该证据被提供用以证明某一事项未曾发生或存在，对于该类事项，有定期保存记录的惯例，并且反对一方未能证明该信息来源缺乏可信性。

在本案中，经认证的医院记录是传闻证据，但它属于涵盖商业记录中条目缺失的传闻证据例外。这是因为该记录中缺失的条目被用以证明施用药物的行为（一项医院通常会记录的事项）未曾发生。并且，由于没有迹象表明该记录不可信，因此它是可采纳的 (选项A)。

（选项B）最佳证据规则要求必须出示书面文件、录音或照片的原件（或可靠的副本）以证明其内容。但该规则并未强制要求使用现场证言来替代文件。

（选项C）不利于己方利益陈述的传闻证据例外适用于违背陈述人金钱、财产或刑事利益的陈述，并且该陈述是由一名无法作为证人出庭的陈述人作出的。由于没有迹象表明护士无法出庭，此例外不适用于本案。

教学目的：商业记录中条目缺失的传闻证据例外适用于以下情况：（1）证据被提供用以证明某一事项未曾发生或存在，（2）对于该类事项，有定期保存记录的惯例，以及（3）反对一方未能证明其缺乏可信性。

References

  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(6) (business records hearsay exception).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(7) (absence of business records hearsay exception).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay Exceptions
正确答案：D

本题考察的是《联邦证据规则》（Federal Rules of Evidence, FRE）中关于商业记录（Business Records）的一个特定分支：记录的缺失（Absence of Entry）。

核心法条：FRE 803(7) 商业记录中条目的缺失 (Absence of a Record of a Regularly Conducted Activity)

如果满足以下条件，关于某事项未被记录在商业记录中的证据可被采纳，用于证明该事项未发生或不存在：
  1. 该类事项通常会被记录；
  2. 该记录由具备相关知识的人员在正常商业活动中制作和保存；
  3. 反对一方未能证明该信息来源或情况缺乏可信度。

深度解析

1. 为什么这是传闻证据（Hearsay）？
虽然这里展示的是“没有记录”，但本质上是在利用这份文件的内容（或内容的缺失）来证明事实真相（即护士没有给药）。通常，庭外陈述（Out-of-court statement）用于证明事实真相属于传闻证据。
2. 为什么选项 D 正确？
医院的病历记录属于典型的商业记录（Business Records, FRE 803(6)）。医院有常规惯例（Regular practice）记录病人服用的药物。

逻辑在于：如果护士给了药，按照医院的常规，她应该会记录下来。既然记录中没有这一条目，且没有证据显示记录不可信，那么根据 FRE 803(7)，这种“沉默”或“缺失”可以作为证据，证明给药这一行为没有发生。

干扰项排除

选项 A 错误：
虽然它是传闻证据，但它明确属于 FRE 803(7) 的例外情况，因此是可采纳的（Admissible）。
选项 B 错误（常见陷阱）：
这是对最佳证据规则（Best Evidence Rule）的误用。最佳证据规则仅要求在证明文件内容时必须提供原件。它并不强迫当事人必须通过证人证言来证明行为，也不意味着活人证言优于文件记录。文件和证言都是允许的证据形式。
选项 C 错误：
不利于己方利益的陈述（Statement Against Interest, FRE 804(b)(3)）这一例外有一个严格的前提条件：陈述人必须无法出庭（Unavailable）。题目中没有提到护士无法出庭，因此该例外不适用。
💡 MBE 备考锦囊
  • 看到“没有记录”时：立即联想 FRE 803(7)。如果一个企业/机构通常会记录某事，而记录里没有，这就是证明该事未发生的有力证据。
  • 区分 803 和 804：
    • FRE 803（如商业记录、现时印象感言）：不要求证人无法出庭。
    • FRE 804（如不利于己方利益陈述、临终遗言）：必须要求证人无法出庭（Unavailable）。
  • 警惕“最佳证据规则”：这个规则在 MBE 选项中经常作为干扰项出现。记住它只适用于证明“文件的内容”（contents of a writing），而不是用来证明事件本身的发生。

questions.question:
A defendant was charged with aggravated assault. At trial, the victim testified that the defendant beat her savagely, but she was not asked about anything said during the incident. The prosecutor then called a witness to testify that when the beating stopped, the victim screamed: "I'm dying—don't let [the defendant] get away with it!"
Is the testimony of the witness concerning the victim's statement admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: No, because the victim was not asked about the statement.
choices.c: Yes, as a statement under belief of imminent death, even though the victim did not die.
choices.d: Yes, as an excited utterance.

data.questionStem:
Q87049

A defendant was charged with aggravated assault. At trial, the victim testified that the defendant beat her savagely, but she was not asked about anything said during the incident. The prosecutor then called a witness to testify that when the beating stopped, the victim screamed: "I'm dying - don't let [the defendant] get away with it!"

Is the testimony of the witness concerning the victim's statement admissible?

一名被告被指控犯有严重伤害罪。在庭审中，受害人作证称被告曾野蛮地殴打她，但她并未被问及事件期间所说的任何话。随后，检察官传唤一名证人作证称，当殴打停止时，受害人尖叫道：“我要死了——别让[被告]逍遥法外！”

该证人关于受害人陈述的证言是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
否，因为该陈述是传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。

B. No, because the victim was not asked about the statement.
否，因为受害人未被问及该陈述。

C. Yes, as a statement under belief of imminent death, even though the victim did not die.
是，因为这属于临终遗言，即使受害人并未死亡。

D. Yes, as an excited utterance.
是，因为这属于激情陈述。
data.explanation:
Common hearsay exceptions


Declarant unavailableDeclarant's availability irrelevant
Former testimonyPresent sense impression
Dying declarationExcited utterance
Statement against interestMental state or physical condition
Statement of personal or family historyMedical diagnosis or treatment
Statement offered against party that wrongfully caused declarant's unavailabilityRecorded recollection
Business or public records
Learned treatises, periodicals, or pamphlets
Judgment of previous conviction
Residual (catch-all) exception
Under the rule against hearsay , an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein is generally inadmissible. But one exception to this rule applies to excited utterances - ie, statements:

relating to a startling event or condition and made while the declarant was under the stress of excitement caused by that event or condition.

Such statements are admissible - regardless of the declarant's availability as a witness at trial - because it is unlikely that these spontaneous statements would be fabricated.

Here, the victim's out-of-court statement ("I'm dying - don't let [the defendant] get away with it!") is hearsay because it is being offered to prove that the defendant was her attacker. But since the statement related to the defendant's savage assault of the victim and was made while she was excited by that startling event, the statement is admissible as an excited utterance (Choice A).

(Choice B) There is no requirement that a declarant be asked about his/her hearsay statement while testifying for that statement to be admissible.

(Choice C) A dying declaration is a statement (1) made while the declarant believed his/her death was imminent (2) concerning the cause or circumstances of that impending death. These statements are only excepted from the hearsay rule in civil cases and prosecutions for criminal homicide - not aggravated assault. And though the declarant need not be dead for this exception to apply, he/she must be unavailable (not seen here).

Educational objective: An excited utterance is a statement relating to a startling event or condition that is made while the declarant is under the stress of excitement caused by that event or condition. This type of statement is excepted from the hearsay rule regardless of the declarant's availability.

选项正确率统计：A选项 11%，B选项 5%，C选项 25%，D选项 57%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

常见的传闻证据例外


陈述人无法出庭陈述人是否出庭无关紧要
先前证言即时感官印象
临终遗言激情陈述
不利于己方利益的陈述精神状态或身体状况
关于个人或家族史的陈述医疗诊断或治疗
针对因不法行为导致陈述人无法出庭的一方所提出的陈述已记录的回忆
商业或公共记录
学术论著、期刊或小册子
先前定罪的判决
剩余（总括性）例外
根据反传闻证据规则，为证明其所主张事项的真实性而提出的庭外陈述通常不予采纳。但此规则的一个例外适用于激情陈述——即符合以下条件的陈述：

与某一惊人事件或状况相关，且陈述人在该事件或状况引起的激动压力下作出。

此类陈述可予采纳——无论陈述人在庭审中是否可以作为证人出庭——因为这些自发性陈述不太可能是捏造的。

在本案中，受害人的庭外陈述（“我要死了——别让[被告]逍遥法外！”）是传闻证据，因为它是为了证明被告是攻击她的人。但由于该陈述与被告对受害人的野蛮攻击有关，并且是在她因该惊人事件而情绪激动时作出的，因此该陈述作为激情陈述可予采纳（选项D）。

（选项B）法律并未要求陈述人在作证时必须被问及其传闻陈述，该陈述才可被采纳。

（选项C）临终遗言是指（1）陈述人在相信自己死亡迫在眉睫时作出的，（2）关于导致其即将死亡的原因或情况的陈述。这类陈述仅在民事案件和刑事杀人罪的起诉中可作为传闻规则的例外——但不包括严重伤害罪。并且，尽管适用此例外时陈述人不必已经死亡，但他/她必须无法出庭（本案情况并非如此）。

教学目标：激情陈述是与某一惊人事件或状况相关的陈述，且是在陈述人处于该事件或状况所引起的激动压力下作出的。无论陈述人是否可以出庭，此类陈述均属于传闻规则的例外情况。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 803(2) (hearsay exception for excited utterances).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 证据法考点解析

Hearsay Exceptions: Excited Utterance

✅ 正确答案：D 是，因为这属于激情陈述 (Excited Utterance)。

本题的核心在于识别传闻证据规则（Hearsay Rule）的例外情况。虽然受害人的庭外陈述通常属于传闻，但在特定条件下可以被采纳。

⚖️ 法律规则：激情陈述 (FRE 803(2))

定义：关于某一惊人事件或状况的陈述，且是在陈述人处于该事件引起的激动压力 (Stress of Excitement) 之下作出的。

🔍
本案应用：
1. 惊人事件：受害人刚刚遭受了“野蛮殴打” (Savagely beaten)。
2. 激动压力：受害人是在“殴打停止时”立即“尖叫” (Screamed) 出这句话的。这表明她仍处于事件的压力和冲击之下，没有时间进行反思或捏造。
📌
关键点： 对于 FRE 803 类例外，陈述人是否出庭 (Availability) 无关紧要。即使受害人已经出庭作证，该庭外陈述依然可采。
⚠️ 常见陷阱：选项 C (临终遗言)

很多考生看到“I'm dying”（我要死了）就会误选 Dying Declaration。这是 MBE 的经典干扰项。

为什么选项 C 是错误的？

  • 案件类型不符：临终遗言例外 (FRE 804(b)(2)) 仅适用于民事案件或刑事杀人 (Homicide) 案件。本案是“严重伤害” (Aggravated Assault)，受害人并未死亡，不是杀人案。
  • 陈述人必须无法出庭：临终遗言属于 FRE 804 例外，要求陈述人 Unavailable。本案中受害人正在庭上作证，显然是 Available 的。
📊 考场速记：803 vs 804
特征 激情陈述
(Excited Utterance)		 临终遗言
(Dying Declaration)
规则来源 FRE 803(2) FRE 804(b)(2)
陈述人状态 是否出庭均可 必须无法出庭 (Unavailable)
适用案件 所有案件 仅民事或杀人案
核心要素 压力/激动 (Stress) 相信死期将至 (Belief of death)
其他选项解析：
❌ 选项 A： 错误。虽然是传闻，但符合激情陈述的例外。
❌ 选项 B： 错误。法律不要求证人在庭上必须先被问及该庭外陈述，才能通过其他证人引入该陈述（这与弹劾规则混淆了，但此处是作为实质证据引入）。

questions.question:
A defendant is on trial for robbing a bank in State A. She testified that she was in State B at the time of the robbery. The defendant calls her friend to testify that two days before the robbery the defendant told him that she was going to spend the next three days in State B.
Is the friend's testimony admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: No, because it is offered to establish an alibi by the defendant's own statement.
choices.c: Yes, because a statement of plans falls within the hearsay exception for then-existing state of mind.
choices.d: Yes, because the statement falls within the present sense impression exception to the hearsay rule.

data.questionStem:
Q87024

A defendant is on trial for robbing a bank in State A. She testified that she was in State B at the time of the robbery. The defendant calls her friend to testify that two days before the robbery the defendant told him that she was going to spend the next three days in State B.

Is the friend's testimony admissible?

一名被告人因在A州抢劫一家银行而受审。她作证称，抢劫发生时她在B州。该被告人传唤其朋友作证，称抢劫发生前两天，被告人告诉他，她计划在接下来的三天里待在B州。

该朋友的证言是否可被采纳？
options:
A. No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
否，因为该证言属于传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。

B. No, because it is offered to establish an alibi by the defendant's own statement.
否，因为该证言旨在通过被告人自己的陈述来建立不在场证明。

C. Yes, because a statement of plans falls within the hearsay exception for then-existing state of mind.
是，因为关于计划的陈述属于“当时存在的精神状态”的传闻证据例外。

D. Yes, because the statement falls within the present sense impression exception to the hearsay rule.
是，因为该陈述属于传闻证据规则中的“当时感觉印象”例外。
data.explanation:
Then-existing state of mind hearsay exception

(FRE 803(3))
Type of statementExamplesAdmissibility
State of mindMotive, intent, planAdmissible as substantive evidence
Emotional or physical conditionFear, pain, bodily healthAdmissible as substantive evidence
Memory or beliefReflection on prior event or belief about matterInadmissible unless related to declarant's will
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Hearsay is an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein and is generally inadmissible. But statements of the declarant's then-existing state of mind - eg, statements of motive, intent, or plan - are excepted from hearsay. And since they are excepted, these statements can be used as substantive evidence to prove that the declarant later acted in conformity with that state of mind.

Here, the defendant's out-of-court statement is hearsay since it is being offered for its truth - ie, that she was going to spend three days in State B. But since this is a statement about her plans, it falls within the hearsay exception for then-existing state of mind. Therefore, the friend's testimony as to this statement is admissible as proof that the defendant was in State B on the day of the robbery (Choice A).

(Choice B) There is no rule prohibiting the use of the defendant's own statement to establish an alibi - ie, a defense that places the defendant elsewhere when the charged offense was committed.

(Choice D) The present sense impression exception applies to hearsay statements that (1) describe an event or condition and (2) are made while or immediately after the declarant perceived it. This exception is inapplicable here because the defendant was describing her plans - not a perceived event or condition.

Educational objective: Statements concerning the declarant's then-existing state of mind (eg, statements of motive, intent, or plan) are excepted from the rule against hearsay.

选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 4%，C选项 82%（正确选项），D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当时存在的精神状态的传闻证据例外 (FRE 803(3))


陈述类型示例可采性
精神状态动机、意图、计划可作为实体证据采纳
心绪或身体状况恐惧、疼痛、身体健康可作为实体证据采纳
记忆或信念对过往事件的回忆或对事项的信念不可采纳，除非与陈述人遗嘱相关
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence)。

传闻证据是指为证明其陈述内容之真实性而提出的庭外陈述，通常不可采纳。但是，关于陈述人当时存在的精神状态的陈述——例如，关于动机、意图或计划的陈述——是传闻证据的例外。由于属于例外情况，这些陈述可以作为实质性证据，用以证明陈述人后来的行为与其精神状态相符。

在本案中，被告人的庭外陈述是传闻证据，因为它是为证明其真实性而提出的——即，她计划在B州待三天。但由于这是一个关于她计划的陈述，它属于“当时存在的精神状态”的传闻证据例外。因此，朋友关于此陈述的证言是可采纳的，可作为被告人在抢劫案发生当天身处B州的证据。(选项C)。

(选项B) 没有任何规则禁止使用被告人自己的陈述来建立不在场证明——即一种将被告人置于被指控罪行发生时其他地点的辩护理由。

(选项D) “当时感觉印象”例外适用于以下传闻证据陈述：(1) 描述一个事件或状况，且 (2) 是在陈述人感知到该事件或状况的同时或之后立即作出的。该例外在此不适用，因为被告人描述的是她的计划——而非一个被感知的事件或状况。

教学目标： 关于陈述人当时存在的精神状态的陈述（例如，关于动机、意图或计划的陈述）是禁止传闻证据规则的例外。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 803(3) (then-existing state of mind exception).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence Law / Hearsay
FRE 803(3)
核心考点：当时存在的精神状态
Then-Existing State of Mind Exception
根据《联邦证据规则》FRE 803(3)，关于陈述人当时存在的精神状态（如动机、意图或计划）的陈述，属于传闻证据规则的例外。
🧠 ➡️ 🗺️

Hillmon Doctrine (Hillmon 原则)
源自著名判例 Mutual Life Insurance Co. v. Hillmon。该原则确立了：一个人关于其未来意图或计划（Intent or Plan）的陈述，可以被采纳为证据，用来证明该人后来确实实施了该计划。

本题逻辑分析

1. 识别传闻 (Hearsay):
被告对朋友说“我计划去B州”。这是庭外陈述 (Out-of-court statement)，且被告希望以此证明她确实去了B州（证明陈述内容的真实性）。原则上这是传闻。

2. 应用例外 (Applying the Exception):
该陈述表明了被告当时的计划 (Plan)。根据 FRE 803(3)，这种关于“当时存在的精神状态”的陈述是可采纳的。

3. 证据效力:
法律允许陪审团根据“她计划去B州”这一陈述，推断“她后来确实去了B州”。这直接支持了她的不在场证明 (Alibi)。

✅ 正确答案：C
是，因为关于计划的陈述属于“当时存在的精神状态”的传闻证据例外。
Yes, because a statement of plans falls within the hearsay exception for then-existing state of mind.
陷阱选项排除
❌ 选项 A (Hearsay)
错误。虽然它是传闻，但它符合 FRE 803(3) 的例外，因此是可采纳的 (Admissible)。
❌ 选项 B (Self-serving Alibi)
错误。法律并不因为证据是“利己的” (Self-serving) 就自动排除它。只要符合传闻例外，被告自己的陈述也可以被采纳。
❌ 选项 D (Present Sense Impression)
错误。“当时感觉印象” (FRE 803(1)) 要求陈述是在感知某事件时或之后立即作出的（例如：“看！那辆车闯红灯了”）。本题中被告是在谈论未来的计划，而非描述眼前的感官体验。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
在 MBE 证据法题目中，如果看到陈述人说 "I intend to..." 或 "I am going to..."，并且该证据被用来证明陈述人后来确实做了这件事，请立即联想 State of Mind Exception (FRE 803(3))。
© MBE Study Guide | Based on NCBE Standards

questions.question:
A defendant was charged with robbery of a savings and loan branch after being arrested near the scene and found with marked bills. An hour after the robbery, the officer investigating the crime videotaped an interview with an eyewitness, in which the eyewitness described the crime and the robber. The officer then arranged for a lineup, at which the teller who was robbed identified the defendant as the robber. The officer later obtained computerized records of that day's deposits and withdrawals at the savings and loan, which allowed the calculation of how much cash was taken in the robbery.
A month later, the teller testified before a grand jury, which indicted the defendant. The teller and the eyewitness both died of unrelated causes shortly afterward. At trial, the defendant's attorney objects to evidence offered against the defendant on the basis that it violates the confrontation clause.
Which of the following, if properly authenticated, may be admitted against the defendant over this objection?

choices.a: A transcript of the teller's sworn grand jury testimony.
choices.b: The computerized records from the savings and loan.
choices.c: The officer's testimony that the teller picked the defendant out of the lineup as the robber.
choices.d: The videotape of the eyewitness's statement.

At trial, the defendant's attorney objects to evidence offered against the defendant on the basis that it violates the confrontation clause.

Which of the following, if properly authenticated, may be admitted against the defendant over this objection?

一名被告在案发现场附近被捕并被发现持有带标记的钞票后，被控抢劫一家储蓄和贷款分行。抢劫发生一小时后，调查该罪行的警官录制了对一名目击者的访谈录像，目击者在录像中描述了犯罪过程和抢劫犯。随后，该警官安排了一次列队辨认，被抢劫的出纳员在列队辨认中将被告指认为抢劫犯。该警官后来获取了储蓄和贷款分行当日存取款的计算机化记录，从而得以计算出抢劫案中被抢走的现金数额。

一个月后，该出纳员在大陪审团面前作证，大陪审团随即对被告提起公诉。此后不久，该出纳员和目击者均因无关原因死亡。在审判中，被告的律师以违反了对质条款 (confrontation clause) 为由，反对用于指控被告的证据。

在下列各项证据中，若经适当认证，哪一项可以不顾此反对意见而被采纳以对抗被告？
options:
A. A transcript of the teller's sworn grand jury testimony.
出纳员在大陪审团作出的宣誓证词的誊本。

B. The computerized records from the savings and loan.
来自储蓄和贷款分行的计算机化记录。

C. The officer's testimony that the teller picked the defendant out of the lineup as the robber.
警官关于出纳员在列队辨认中将被告指认为抢劫犯的证词。

D. The videotape of the eyewitness's statement.
目击者陈述的录像带。
data.explanation:
Testimonial v. Nontestimonial evidence


Testimonial
Evidence made primarily for purpose of criminal investigation or prosecution - eg:
  • Witness statements made after apprehension of suspect
  • Grand jury testimony
  • Lab results
  • Transcripts of prior testimony
  • Affidavits
Nontestimonial
Any other evidence - eg:
  • Witness statements made before apprehension of suspect
  • Statements made to assist police in ongoing emergency
  • 911 calls
  • Jail booking records
The Sixth Amendment confrontation clause secures a defendant's right to confront witnesses offering testimonial evidence against him/her in a criminal case. Evidence is testimonial in nature if it was made primarily for use in a criminal investigation or prosecution, and it is inadmissible unless :
  • the declarant is unavailable as a witness at trial and the defendant had a prior opportunity to cross-examine the declarant.


Here, the savings and loan's computerized records of deposits and withdrawals on the day of the robbery were made for ordinary business purposes. Therefore, they are not testimonial in nature and can be admitted over the defendant's objection.

In contrast, transcripts of sworn grand jury testimony, identifications at police lineups, and videotapes of eyewitness statements are made primarily for use in a criminal investigation or prosecution. Here, the witnesses who offered this testimonial evidence - the teller and eyewitness - have died and are unavailable for cross-examination. And since there is no indication that the defendant had a prior opportunity to cross-examine them, this evidence is inadmissible (Choices A, C & D).

Educational objective: The confrontation clause limits the admissibility of testimonial evidence - ie, evidence made primarily for use in a criminal investigation or prosecution - against a criminal defendant. Such evidence is inadmissible unless (1) the declarant is unavailable as a witness and (2) the defendant had a prior opportunity to cross-examine the declarant.

选项正确率统计：A选项 15%，B选项 69%（正确选项），C选项 7%，D选项 6%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

证言性质的证据与非证言性质的证据


证言性质的
主要为刑事调查或起诉目的而作出的证据 - 例如：
  • 嫌疑人被捕后作出的证人陈述
  • 大陪审团证词
  • 实验室结果
  • 先前证词的誊本
  • 宣誓书
非证言性质的
任何其他证据 - 例如：
  • 嫌疑人被捕前作出的证人陈述
  • 为协助警方处理持续紧急情况而作出的陈述
  • 911报警电话
  • 监狱收押记录
第六修正案 (Sixth Amendment) 的对质条款 (confrontation clause) 保障了被告在刑事案件中对质提供对他/她不利的证言性质证据的证人的权利。如果证据主要是为了在刑事调查或起诉中使用而作出的，那么该证据在性质上就属于证言性质的，并且该证据不可采纳，除非：
  • 陈述人在审判时无法作为证人出庭，并且被告曾有事先机会对陈述人进行交叉诘问。


在本案中，储蓄和贷款分行在抢劫当日的存取款计算机化记录是为日常业务目的而制作的。因此，它们在性质上不属于证言性质的证据，并且可以在被告反对的情况下被采纳。

相反，大陪审团宣誓证词的誊本、警方列队辨认中的指认、以及目击者陈述的录像带主要是为了在刑事调查或起诉中使用而作出的。在本案中，提供这些证言性质证据的证人——即出纳员和目击者——已经死亡，无法进行交叉诘问。并且由于没有迹象表明被告曾有事先机会对他们进行交叉诘问，这些证据是不可采纳的（选项 A、C 和 D）。

教学目标：对质条款 (confrontation clause) 限制了对刑事被告不利的证言性质证据（即主要为刑事调查或起诉目的而作出的证据）的可采纳性。此类证据不可采纳，除非 (1) 陈述人无法作为证人出庭，并且 (2) 被告曾有事先机会对陈述人进行交叉诘问。

References

Crawford v. Washington, 541 U.S. 36, 68 (2004) (defining testimonial hearsay).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence & Confrontation Clause

⚖️ 核心法律规则：Crawford v. Washington

根据美国宪法第六修正案的对质条款 (Confrontation Clause)，在刑事案件中，针对被告的证言性质 (Testimonial) 的传闻证据不可采纳，除非满足以下两个条件：

  1. 陈述人 (Declarant) 无法出庭 (Unavailable)；且
  2. 被告此前曾有机会对陈述人进行交叉诘问 (Cross-examine)。

✅ 正确答案：B

来自储蓄和贷款分行的计算机化记录。

Non-testimonial

解析逻辑：

对质条款仅排除“证言性质”的证据。商业记录 (Business Records) 通常被视为非证言性质 (Non-testimonial) 的证据。

这是因为银行制作存取款记录的主要目的是为了日常业务管理，而不是为了在未来的刑事诉讼中指控某人。即使警方后来获取了这些记录用于调查，也不会改变记录生成时的初衷。

因此，即使记录员无法出庭，这类非证言性质的证据也不受 Crawford 规则的限制，只要符合传闻证据的例外（如商业记录例外）并经适当认证，即可采纳。

❌ 为什么其他选项不可采纳？

题目中明确指出，出纳员和目击者均已死亡（Unavailable），且被告之前没有机会进行交叉诘问（Grand Jury 和警方访谈都是单方面的）。因此，任何证言性质的证据都必须被排除。

Testimonial A. 大陪审团证词 (Grand Jury Testimony)

这是最典型的证言性质证据。证人在大陪审团面前作证，明确是为了刑事起诉目的。被告在大陪审团程序中无权在场，更无权交叉诘问。

Testimonial C. 列队辨认指认 (Lineup Identification)

出纳员在警方安排的列队辨认中指认被告，这是为了协助警方调查和起诉。属于证言性质，且被告当时没有机会盘问出纳员。

Testimonial D. 警方录像访谈 (Videotaped Police Interview)

目击者在案发后一小时接受警方正式访谈，描述犯罪过程。这种向执法人员提供的陈述，目的是建立过去发生的事件记录以供起诉使用，属于核心的证言性质证据。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

判断证据是否违反 Confrontation Clause 的关键测试是：“主要目的测试” (Primary Purpose Test)。

  • 为了法庭/起诉？ (如：对警察的陈述、法庭证词、供述书) ➝ Testimonial ➝ 需对质。
  • 为了业务/紧急情况？ (如：911求救电话、医疗诊断记录、商业账簿) ➝ Non-testimonial ➝ 通常可采纳。
