In a medical malpractice suit by a plaintiff against his doctor, the plaintiff seeks to introduce a properly authenticated photocopy of his hospital chart. The chart contained a notation made by a medical resident that an aortic clamp had broken during the plaintiff's surgery. The resident made the notation in the regular course of practice, but he had no personal knowledge of the operation and cannot remember which of the operating physicians gave him the information.
Is the photocopy of the plaintiff's hospital chart admissible?

choices.a: No, as a violation of the best evidence rule.
choices.b: No, because it is hearsay within hearsay.
choices.c: Yes, as a record of regularly conducted activity.
choices.d: Yes, as recorded recollection.

data.questionStem:
Q87034

In a medical malpractice suit by a plaintiff against his doctor, the plaintiff seeks to introduce a properly authenticated photocopy of his hospital chart. The chart contained a notation made by a medical resident that an aortic clamp had broken during the plaintiff's surgery. The resident made the notation in the regular course of practice, but he had no personal knowledge of the operation and cannot remember which of the operating physicians gave him the information.

Is the photocopy of the plaintiff's hospital chart admissible?

在原告对其医生提起的医疗事故诉讼中，原告试图呈交一份其病历的、经适当认证的复印件。该病历包含了一名住院医生所作的记录，注明在原告的手术期间，一个主动脉夹已损坏。该住院医生是在常规执业过程中作此记录，但他对该手术没有亲身了解，也不记得是哪位主刀医生向他提供了该信息。

原告病历的复印件是否可采纳为证据？
options:
A. No, as a violation of the best evidence rule.
不可采纳，因为其违反了最佳证据规则。

B. No, because it is hearsay within hearsay.
不可采纳，因为这是传闻内含传闻。

C. Yes, as a record of regularly conducted activity.
可采纳，因为这是日常业务活动记录。

D. Yes, as recorded recollection.
可采纳，因为这是已记录的追忆。
data.explanation:
Business records hearsay exception


(FRE 803(6)) Business record admissible if it was:
  • made at or near time of recorded event (or act, opinion, condition, diagnosis)
  • made by or based on information from someone with personal knowledge and
  • made & kept as a regular practice in the course of regularly conducted business activities
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence

Under the hearsay rule, out-of-court statements (eg, notations in a hospital chart) are generally inadmissible when offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein (eg, clamp broke during surgery). However, one hearsay exception applies to business records that were:


  • made at or near the time of the recorded event (or act, condition, opinion, diagnosis)
  • made by or based on information from someone with personal knowledge of that event and
  • made and kept as a regular practice in the course of regularly conducted business activities.

Hospital charts are maintained as a regular practice in the regular course of hospital activities and are created near the time of the recorded event. And though the resident here did not have personal knowledge of the operation, the chart was based on information from someone who did - an operating physician. The chart is therefore admissible under the business records exception. And since duplicates are generally admissible to the same extent as original writings under the best evidence rule, a photocopy of the hospital chart is admissible (Choice A).


(Choice B) Hearsay within hearsay occurs when one hearsay statement is contained within another hearsay statement - eg, a patient claims her husband caused her injury and her physician notes that on her chart. When this occurs, both statements are inadmissible unless both are excepted or excluded from hearsay.


(Choice D) A recorded recollection is a hearsay exception for records that (1) contain information that a witness once knew but cannot recall well enough to testify, (2) were made or adopted by the witness when a matter was fresh in his/her mind, and (3) accurately reflect the witness's knowledge at the time the record was made. But this exception is inapplicable here because the chart is not being used to supplement a witness's testimony.


Educational objective: Business records are excepted from hearsay if they were (1) made near the time of the recorded event, (2) made by or based on information from one with personal knowledge, and (3) made and kept as a regular practice in the course of regular business activities.



选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 25%，C选项 62%（正确选项），D选项 10%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

业务记录传闻证据例外


(FRE 803(6)) 业务记录在以下情况下可采纳：
  • 在所记录的事件（或行为、意见、状况、诊断）发生之时或前后不久制作
  • 由具有亲身了解的人制作，或基于其提供的信息制作并且
  • 在日常业务活动过程中，作为常规惯例制作和保存
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence (《联邦证据规则》)

根据传闻证据规则，庭外陈述（例如，病历中的记录）在用以证明其所述事项的真实性（例如，手术中夹子损坏）时，通常是不可采纳的。然而，有一项传闻证据例外适用于符合以下条件的业务记录：


  • 在所记录的事件（或行为、状况、意见、诊断）发生之时或前后不久制作
  • 由对该事件有亲身了解的人制作，或基于其提供的信息制作并且
  • 在日常业务活动过程中，作为常规惯例制作和保存。

病历是在医院日常活动中作为常规惯例进行维护的，并且是在所记录事件发生前后不久创建的。尽管本案中的住院医生对该手术没有亲身了解，但该病历是基于确实了解情况的人——即一名主刀医生——所提供的信息。因此，该病历根据业务记录例外规则是可采纳的。并且，由于根据最佳证据规则，副本通常与原件在同等程度上可采纳，因此病历的复印件是可采纳的（选项A）。


（选项B）当一个传闻陈述包含在另一个传闻陈述中时，就构成了传闻内含传闻——例如，一名患者声称其丈夫导致了她的伤害，而她的医生将此记录在她的病历上。当这种情况发生时，两个陈述都不可采纳，除非两者都符合传闻证据的例外或排除规定。


（选项D）已记录的追忆是一项传闻证据例外，适用于符合以下条件的记录：(1) 包含了证人曾经知道但现在无法清晰回忆以至无法作证的信息；(2) 是证人在事情记忆犹新时制作或采纳的；以及 (3) 准确地反映了证人在制作该记录时的认知。但此例外在此处不适用，因为该病历并未被用作补充证人的证词。


教学目标：业务记录在以下情况下可作为传闻证据的例外：(1) 在所记录的事件发生前后不久制作；(2) 由具有亲身了解的人制作或基于其提供的信息制作；以及 (3) 在日常业务活动过程中作为常规惯例制作和保存。



References

  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(6) (records of a regularly conducted activity).


  • Fed. R. Evid. 1003 (admissibility of duplicates).

MBE 考点解析：证据法

Hearsay & Business Records
核心考点

业务记录例外 (Business Records Exception)

本题考察的是《联邦证据规则》第 803(6) 条：关于日常业务活动的记录 (Records of a Regularly Conducted Activity)。

法律规则 (FRE 803(6))：
一份记录如果满足以下条件，即属于传闻证据的例外，可以被采纳：
  • 在事件发生之时或附近制作 (at or near the time)；
  • 由具有亲身了解 (personal knowledge) 的人制作，或者基于该人提供的信息制作；
  • 作为日常业务活动的常规惯例而制作和保存 (regular practice)。

✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 C)

本题的关键难点在于：记录者（住院医生）没有亲眼看到手术过程。

为什么依然可采纳？

根据 FRE 803(6)，记录者本人不需要有亲身了解，只要信息的提供者（source of information）满足以下两点：

  1. 对事件有亲身了解（本案中的主刀医生看到了夹子断裂）；
  2. 有业务义务 (business duty) 报告该信息。

在本案中：

  • 信息源：主刀医生（有亲身了解，且有义务向负责记录的住院医汇报）。
  • 记录者：住院医生（在常规执业过程中记录）。

因此，即使住院医生不记得是哪位医生说的，只要该信息是在医院正常的业务流程中传递和记录的，它就符合业务记录例外，可以采纳。

❌ 干扰项排除

选项 A (最佳证据规则)：
错误。根据 FRE 1003，副本 (Duplicate/Photocopy) 通常与原件具有同等的可采纳性，除非对其真实性有真正的争议。本题中已说明是“经适当认证的复印件”，因此最佳证据规则不构成障碍。

选项 B (传闻内含传闻)：
错误。虽然这里确实涉及多层传递（医生 -> 住院医 -> 病历），但这并不导致不可采纳。当传闻链条中的每一环都属于业务记录例外的一部分（即都在履行业务职责）时，整个记录被视为单一的业务记录而被采纳。

选项 D (已记录的追忆)：
错误。Recorded Recollection (FRE 803(5)) 通常用于证人在庭上忘记了某些细节，需要阅读以前的记录来辅助作证。本题中原告是直接呈交病历作为证据，而非辅助证人作证，因此适用的是业务记录例外。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

在处理病历 (Hospital Charts) 或警察报告 (Police Reports) 的题目时，请注意区分：

  • 内部人员的陈述：医生对护士说、警察对警察说。如果都在履行职责，通常符合业务记录例外。
  • 外部人员的陈述：病人对医生说、目击者对警察说。外部人员没有“业务义务”报告准确信息，因此这部分陈述通常需要寻找独立的传闻例外（如“以治疗为目的的陈述”或“惊骇陈述”）。

本题中，信息流转完全发生在医疗团队内部（医生到住院医），因此单纯适用业务记录例外即可。

© MBE Evidence Study Guide

questions.question:
At a woman's trial for bank robbery, the prosecutor has called a private security guard for the bank who has testified, without objection, that while he was on a coffee break, the woman's brother rushed up to him and said, "Come quickly! My sister is robbing the bank!" The woman now seeks to call a witness to testify that the brother later told the witness, "I got my sister into trouble by telling a security guard that she was robbing the bank, but now I realize I was mistaken." The brother is unavailable to testify.
Is the witness's testimony admissible?

choices.a: No, because the brother will be afforded no opportunity to explain or deny the later statement.
choices.b: No, because the prosecutor will be afforded no opportunity to confront the brother.
choices.c: Yes, because it is substantive proof that the woman did not rob the bank.
choices.d: Yes, but only as an inconsistent statement to impeach the brother's credibility.

data.questionStem:
Q87050

At a woman's trial for bank robbery, the prosecutor has called a private security guard for the bank who has testified, without objection, that while he was on a coffee break, the woman's brother rushed up to him and said, "Come quickly! My sister is robbing the bank!" The woman now seeks to call a witness to testify that the brother later told the witness, "I got my sister into trouble by telling a security guard that she was robbing the bank, but now I realize I was mistaken." The brother is unavailable to testify.

Is the witness's testimony admissible?

在一起针对一名女子的银行抢劫案庭审中，检察官传唤了该银行的一名私人保安。该保安在无异议的情况下作证称，当他在喝咖啡休息时，该女子的哥哥冲到他面前说：“快来！我姐姐在抢银行！”现在，该女子试图传唤一名证人作证，证明哥哥后来告诉该证人：“我告诉保安说我姐姐在抢银行，让她惹上了麻烦，但我现在意识到我弄错了。”哥哥无法出庭作证。

该证人的证言是否可被采纳？
options:
A. No, because the brother will be afforded no opportunity to explain or deny the later statement.
否，因为哥哥将没有机会解释或否认其后来的陈述。

B. No, because the prosecutor will be afforded no opportunity to confront the brother.
否，因为检察官将没有机会与哥哥对质。

C. Yes, because it is substantive proof that the woman did not rob the bank.
是，因为这是证明该女子没有抢劫银行的实质性证据。

D. Yes, but only as an inconsistent statement to impeach the brother's credibility.
是，但仅作为一项前后矛盾的陈述，用以弹劾哥哥的可信度。
data.explanation:
When a hearsay statement is admitted under (1) any hearsay exception or (2) the hearsay exclusion for statements made by an opposing party's agent, employee, or coconspirator, the declarant may be impeached (and then rehabilitated) as though the declarant had testified as a witness. The same methods for impeaching a witness can therefore be used against the declarant. This includes a declarant's inconsistent statement that - unlike a witness's inconsistent statement - can be used for impeachment regardless of:
  • whether the inconsistent statement occurred prior to or after the hearsay statement
  • whether the declarant has an opportunity to explain or deny the inconsistent statement (Choice A).


Here, the brother's hearsay statement - "My sister is robbing the bank!" - was admitted into evidence presumably under the hearsay exception for excited utterances. As a result, his inconsistent statement to the witness - "I was mistaken" - is admissible to impeach his credibility. But since the brother's inconsistent statement constitutes hearsay, it cannot be used as substantive proof that the woman did not rob the bank unless it is also excepted or excluded from the hearsay rule (Choice C).

(Choice B) The Sixth Amendment confrontation clause gives criminal defendants - not prosecutors (as seen here) - the right to cross-examine opposing witnesses.

Educational objective: When certain hearsay is admitted into evidence, the declarant can be impeached as though he/she had testified as a witness. But the declarant's inconsistent statement - unlike a witness's one - can be used for impeachment even if:
  • it occurred after the hearsay statement
  • the declarant had no opportunity to explain or deny it.




选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 10%，C选项 7%，D选项 73%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当一份传闻证据陈述根据(1)任何传闻证据规则的例外或(2)针对对方当事人的代理人、雇员或共谋人所作陈述的传闻证据规则排除条款而被采纳时，该陈述人的可信度可被弹劾（之后可恢复其可信度），如同该陈述人作为证人出庭作证一样。因此，用于弹劾证人的同样方法也可用于针对该陈述人。这包括陈述人的前后矛盾陈述——与证人的前后矛盾陈述不同——可用于弹劾，无论：
  • 该前后矛盾的陈述是发生在该传闻证据陈述之前还是之后
  • 陈述人是否有机会解释或否认该前后矛盾的陈述（选项A）。


在本案中，哥哥的传闻证据陈述——“我姐姐在抢银行！”——被采纳为证据，推测是依据传闻证据规则中“激动言辞”的例外。因此，他对证人所作的前后矛盾陈述——“我弄错了”——可以被采纳以弹劾其可信度。但是，由于哥哥的前后矛盾陈述也构成传闻证据，除非它也符合传闻证据规则的例外或排除规定，否则不能用作证明该女子没有抢劫银行的实质性证据（选项C）。

（选项B）《Sixth Amendment》的对质条款赋予刑事被告人——而非本案中的检察官——交叉询问对方证人的权利。

教学目标：当某些传闻证据被采纳为证据时，其陈述人可被弹劾，如同他/她作为证人作证一样。但陈述人的前后矛盾陈述——与证人的不同——可用于弹劾，即使：
  • 它发生在传闻证据陈述之后
  • 陈述人没有机会解释或否认它。


References

Fed. R. Evid. 806 (attacking and supporting the declarant's credibility).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：传闻证据陈述人的弹劾

本题考查的是美国联邦证据规则（Federal Rules of Evidence, FRE）中关于如何攻击不在场陈述人（Hearsay Declarant）可信度的问题。

核心考点：FRE 806
Attacking and Supporting the Declarant's Credibility

1. 法律规则解析 (Legal Rule)

根据 FRE 806，当一份传闻证据（Hearsay）或特定的非传闻陈述（如共谋者陈述）被法庭采纳后，陈述人（Declarant）的可信度可以像在场证人一样受到攻击。

这意味着，如果陈述人作为证人出庭时可以被弹劾（Impeachment），那么即使他不在场，也可以用同样的方法弹劾他。

关键区别 (The Key Distinction)：

  • 普通证人 (FRE 613)： 通常要求在引入外部证据证明其前后陈述不一致之前，必须给证人一个解释或否认的机会（Opportunity to explain or deny）。
  • 传闻陈述人 (FRE 806)： 规则明确规定，不需要给陈述人解释或否认的机会。

2. 案情分析 (Application)

  • 陈述 1： 哥哥说“我姐姐在抢银行”。这是传闻证据，但已作为激动言辞（Excited Utterance）被采纳。
  • 陈述 2： 哥哥后来承认“我弄错了”。这是前后不一致的陈述（Inconsistent Statement）。
  • 现状： 哥哥无法出庭（Unavailable）。

根据 FRE 806，辩方可以引入陈述 2 来攻击陈述 1 的可信度，即使哥哥没有机会解释，也即使陈述 2 发生在陈述 1 之后。

3. 选项深度解析

✅ 选项 D 正确：
"Yes, but only as an inconsistent statement to impeach the brother's credibility."
这是 FRE 806 的直接应用。该证据可以用来证明哥哥说话前后矛盾，从而降低陪审团对其第一句指控的信任度。

❌ 选项 A 错误 (常见陷阱)：
"No, because the brother will be afforded no opportunity to explain..."
这是针对普通出庭证人（FRE 613）的要求。FRE 806 特别免除了对传闻陈述人的这一要求，因为陈述人通常不在庭上，无法进行解释。

❌ 选项 C 错误 (用途限制)：
"Yes, because it is substantive proof..."
虽然陈述 2 可以进入法庭，但它本身也是传闻证据（庭外陈述，为了证明“他确实弄错了/姐姐没抢银行”这一事实）。除非它符合某个传闻例外（如 Declaration Against Interest，但本题条件不足以确立），否则它只能用于弹劾（Impeachment），不能作为实质性证据（Substantive Proof）。

❌ 选项 B 错误：
Confrontation Clause (对质条款)
美国宪法第六修正案的对质权是赋予刑事被告人的权利，用来对抗检方证人。检察官（Prosecutor）不能主张对质权受损。

4. 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

MBE 黄金法则：
看到“传闻证据被采纳” + “陈述人不在场” + “有不一致的陈述”时，立即联想 FRE 806。记住：不需要给陈述人解释的机会（No foundation required）。

questions.question:
A defendant is on trial for murdering his girlfriend and her unborn child. Whether the girlfriend was pregnant at the time of the murder is at issue. The prosecution has called a witness to testify that the girlfriend told her, two days before the murder, "I'm pregnant with [the defendant's] child."
Is the witness's testimony admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: No, because there has been no showing that the defendant murdered the girlfriend to prevent her from testifying.
choices.c: Yes, as a statement by the girlfriend of her then-existing physical condition.
choices.d: Yes, because the girlfriend is unavailable to testify.

data.questionStem:
Q87026

A defendant is on trial for murdering his girlfriend and her unborn child. Whether the girlfriend was pregnant at the time of the murder is at issue. The prosecution has called a witness to testify that the girlfriend told her, two days before the murder, "I'm pregnant with [the defendant's] child."

Is the witness's testimony admissible?

一名被告因谋杀其女友及其未出生的孩子而受审。女友在谋杀发生时是否怀孕是本案的争议点。控方传唤了一名证人作证，该证人称，女友在谋杀发生前两天告诉她：“我怀了[被告]的孩子。”

该证人的证言是否可以采纳？
options:
A. No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
不可以，因为该证言属于传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。

B. No, because there has been no showing that the defendant murdered the girlfriend to prevent her from testifying.
不可以，因为没有证据表明被告谋杀女友是为了阻止她作证。

C. Yes, as a statement by the girlfriend of her then-existing physical condition.
可以，作为女友关于其当时存在的身体状况的陈述。

D. Yes, because the girlfriend is unavailable to testify.
可以，因为女友无法出庭作证。
data.explanation:
Then-existing state of mind hearsay exception


Type of statementExamplesAdmissibility
State of mindMotive, intent, planAdmissible as substantive evidence
Emotional or physical conditionFear, pain, bodily healthAdmissible as substantive evidence
Memory or beliefReflection on prior event or belief about matterInadmissible unless related to declarant's will
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

The rule against hearsay prohibits the admission of a statement made outside the present proceeding that is offered for the truth of the matter asserted therein. However, one exception to this rule permits admission of a statement concerning the declarant's then-existing state of mind (eg, motive, intent, plan) or emotional/physical condition (eg, mental feeling, pain, bodily health).†

Here, the witness seeks to testify that the girlfriend told her, "I'm pregnant with [the defendant's] child." This out-of-court statement is hearsay since it is offered to prove that the girlfriend was in fact pregnant when she made the statement. But since the statement concerns the girlfriend's then-existing physical condition (pregnancy), it is excepted from hearsay and is therefore admissible (Choice A).

†The declarant's statement concerning the then-existing condition can be used to prove the existence of that condition but not its cause.

(Choice B) A party who wrongfully caused a hearsay declarant's unavailability as a witness, and did so intending that result, cannot later exclude the declarant's statement from evidence. Here, there has been no showing that the defendant murdered his girlfriend to prevent her from testifying, so this exception is inapplicable. But the girlfriend's statement is still admissible as a statement of her then-existing physical condition.

(Choice D) Some hearsay exceptions only apply if the declarant is unavailable to testify; however, the hearsay exception for then-existing physical conditions is not one of those exceptions. Therefore, the girlfriend's statement would be admissible under this exception even if she had been available.

Educational objective: Statements regarding a declarant's then-existing state of mind (eg, motive, intent, plan) or emotional/physical condition (eg, mental feeling, pain, bodily health) are excepted from the rule against hearsay.

选项正确率统计：A选项 17%，B选项 1%，C选项 72%（正确选项），D选项 8%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当时存在的精神状态的传闻证据例外 (FRE 803(3))


陈述类型示例可采性
精神状态动机、意图、计划可作为实体证据采纳
心绪或身体状况恐惧、疼痛、身体健康可作为实体证据采纳
记忆或信念对过往事件的回忆或对事项的信念不可采纳，除非与陈述人遗嘱相关
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》。

反传闻证据规则禁止采纳在本次诉讼程序之外作出、为证明其所主张事项的真实性而提出的陈述。然而，该规则的一项例外允许采纳关于陈述人当时存在的精神状态（例如，动机、意图、计划）或情绪/身体状况（例如，精神感受、疼痛、身体健康）的陈述。†

在本案中，证人试图作证称女友告诉她：“我怀了[被告]的孩子。”这个庭外陈述属于传闻证据，因为它是为了证明女友在作出该陈述时确实怀孕。但是，由于该陈述涉及女友当时存在的身体状况（怀孕），因此它属于传闻证据的例外情况，故可以采纳（选项C）。

†关于当时存在状况的陈述可用于证明该状况的存在，但不能用以证明其原因。

（选项B）一方当事人如通过不法行为导致传闻陈述人无法作为证人出庭，且其行为意图在于此，则该方当事人事后不得将该陈述人的陈述排除于证据之外。在本案中，没有证据表明被告谋杀女友是为了阻止她作证，因此该例外不适用。但是，女友的陈述作为关于其当时存在的身体状况的陈述，仍然可以采纳。

（选项D）某些传闻证据例外仅在陈述人无法出庭作证时适用；然而，关于当时存在的身体状况的传闻证据例外不在此列。因此，即使女友能够出庭，她的陈述依据此项例外也同样可以被采纳。

教学目标：关于陈述人当时存在的精神状态（例如，动机、意图、计划）或情绪/身体状况（例如，精神感受、疼痛、身体健康）的陈述，属于反传闻证据规则的例外情况。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 803(3) (hearsay exception for a declarant's then-existing physical condition).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay Exceptions

核心考点：当时存在的身体状况
法律规则 (FRE 803(3)):
关于陈述人当时存在的精神、情绪或身体状况（Then-Existing Mental, Emotional, or Physical Condition）的陈述，属于传闻证据的例外，可以被采纳。

本题考察的是《联邦证据规则》第803(3)条。虽然“我怀孕了”是在庭外作出的陈述，且被用来证明其内容的真实性（即她确实怀孕了），这构成了传闻证据 (Hearsay)，但它符合传闻例外。

逻辑推理：

  • 陈述内容："I'm pregnant..."（我怀孕了）。
  • 性质：这是对陈述人（女友）在说话时刻身体状况 (Physical Condition) 的直接描述。
  • 结论：根据 FRE 803(3)，此类陈述具有较高的可靠性，因此无论陈述人是否出庭，均可采纳。

这就是为什么选项 C 是正确答案。

陷阱选项分析
为什么选项 D 错误？（关键区分） 选项 D 认为证据可采纳是因为“女友无法出庭”。这是一个经典的 MBE 陷阱。

在联邦证据规则中，传闻例外分为两类：
  • Rule 803：无论陈述人是否在场 (Availability Immaterial) 均适用。本题的“身体状况”属于此类。
  • Rule 804：仅在陈述人无法出庭 (Unavailable) 时才适用（如临终遗言 Dying Declaration）。
虽然女友确实无法出庭（已死亡），但这并不是应用 FRE 803(3) 的前提条件。即使她活着坐在法庭上，该陈述依然可以根据 803(3) 被采纳。因此 D 的法律推理是错误的。
为什么选项 B 错误？ 选项 B 涉及“因不法行为导致丧失质证权” (Forfeiture by Wrongdoing, FRE 804(b)(6))。

要应用此规则，控方必须证明被告谋杀受害者的具体意图 (Specific Intent) 是为了阻止其作证。仅证明被告杀了人是不够的，必须证明杀人是为了“灭口”。题目中没有提供证据表明被告杀人是为了阻止她作证。
💡 MBE 考试技巧：

当看到以 "I feel..."、"I plan to..." 或 "I am..." 开头的陈述时，立即联想 FRE 803(3) State of Mind/Body 例外。

注意限制：该例外通常只能证明当下的状态，不能用来证明导致该状态的过去的事实（"记忆或信念"）。
例如："我的头很痛"（可采纳，身体状况）；"被告打了我，所以我头痛"（"被告打了我"部分通常不可采纳，因为是关于过去事实的陈述）。

本题中，"I'm pregnant" 是纯粹的状态描述，因此完全可采纳。

A pedestrian sued a driver for injuries suffered in a hit-and-run accident.
At trial, the pedestrian called a witness who testified that he saw the accident and that as the car sped off he accurately dictated the license number into the voice recorder app on his cell phone. The witness has stated that he no longer remembers the number.
May the voice recording be played?

choices.a: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.

一名行人因一起肇事逃逸事故中受伤而起诉一名司机。

在庭审中，该行人传唤了一名证人，证人作证称他目睹了该事故，并在肇事车辆飞速驶离时，他将车牌号码准确地口述录入其手机的录音应用中。该证人陈述他已记不清该号码。

该录音可以播放吗？
options:
A. No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
不可以，因为它是传闻证据，且不符合任何例外规定。

B. Yes, as a present sense impression and as a recorded recollection.
可以，因为它既属于即时感观印象，也属于有记录的回忆。

C. Yes, as a present sense impression only.
可以，但仅作为即时感观印象。

D. Yes, as a recorded recollection only.
可以，但仅作为有记录的回忆。
data.explanation:
Reasoning for common hearsay exceptions


ExceptionReason for reliability
Present sense impressionNo time to fabricate statement
Excited utteranceNo time to fabricate statement
Past recollection recordedRecords made when fresh in person's mind
Then-existing mental/physical conditionPersons can perceive their own mental or physical state
Statement for medical diagnosis/treatmentSelf-interest creates motive for truth
Business & public recordsAccuracy verified to preserve legal rights & reputation
Documents & statements on property interestAccuracy verified to preserve legal rights & reputation
Certificates of birth, marriage, baptismAccuracy verified to preserve legal rights & reputation
Hearsay is an out-of-court statement (eg, the voice recording) offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein (eg, that the driver was responsible for the hit-and-run). These statements are generally inadmissible because they are considered inherently unreliable. But some out-of-court statements are sufficiently reliable to be excepted from the hearsay rule.

One hearsay exception applies to present sense impressions - ie, statements describing an event or condition that were made while or immediately after the declarant perceived it. These statements are inherently reliable because the declarant did not have time to reflect, distort, or fabricate prior to speaking. Here, the voice recording was made while the witness watched the car speed away from the accident. Therefore, the recording is admissible as a present sense impression.

Another exception applies to recorded recollections - ie, records that (1) concern a matter that a witness once knew but cannot recall at trial, (2) were made or adopted when the matter was fresh in the witness's mind , and (3) accurately reflect the witness's personal knowledge at that time. Here, the witness could not recall the license number at trial. And since his recording was made while the license number was fresh in his mind and was accurately dictated at that time, it is sufficiently reliable. Therefore, the recording is also admissible as a recorded recollection (Choices A, C & D).

Educational objective: The present sense impressions exception applies to statements describing an event or condition that were made while or immediately after the declarant perceived it. The recorded recollections exception applies to records that (1) concern a matter a witness once knew but cannot recall, (2) were made or adopted when the matter was fresh in mind, and (3) accurately reflect the witness's personal knowledge.

选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 49%（正确选项），C选项 10%，D选项 39%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

常见传闻证据例外的理由


例外情况可靠性原因
Present sense impression (即时感观印象)没有时间捏造陈述
Excited utterance (激动言辞)没有时间捏造陈述
Past recollection recorded (过往记忆记录)记录在个人记忆犹新时制作
Then-existing mental/physical condition (当时存在的精神/身体状况)个人能够感知自己的精神或身体状态
Statement for medical diagnosis/treatment (为医疗诊断/治疗所作的陈述)自身利益创造了说出真相的动机
Business & public records (商业与公共记录)为维护合法权利与声誉而核实其准确性
Documents & statements on property interest (关于财产利益的文件与陈述)为维护合法权利与声誉而核实其准确性
Certificates of birth, marriage, baptism (出生、结婚、洗礼证明)为维护合法权利与声誉而核实其准确性
传闻证据 (Hearsay) 是指在庭外作出的陈述（例如，该录音），用以证明其所主张事项的真实性（例如，证明司机对肇事逃逸负有责任）。这类陈述通常不可采纳，因为它们被认为是内在不可靠的。但某些庭外陈述具有足够的可靠性，可以作为传闻证据规则的例外。

传闻证据的一项例外适用于即时感观印象 (present sense impressions)——即在陈述人感知到某一事件或状况的当时或之后立即作出的、描述该事件或状况的陈述。这些陈述是内在可靠的，因为陈述人在发言前没有时间进行思考、歪曲或捏造。在本案中，录音是在证人目睹车辆从事故现场飞速驶离的当时制作的。因此，该录音可作为即时感观印象而被采纳。

另一项例外适用于有记录的回忆 (recorded recollections)——即符合以下条件的记录：（1）涉及证人曾经知晓但在庭审中无法回忆的事项；（2）在该事项于证人记忆中尚属清晰时制作或采纳；以及（3）准确反映了证人当时的个人认知。在本案中，证人在庭审中无法回忆起车牌号码。并且，由于他的录音是在车牌号码尚在其记忆中清晰时制作的，并且当时口述准确，因此该录音具有足够的可靠性。因此，该录音也可作为有记录的回忆而被采纳（选项 A、C 和 D）。

教学目的：即时感观印象例外适用于在陈述人感知到某一事件或状况的当时或之后立即作出的、描述该事件或状况的陈述。有记录的回忆例外适用于符合以下条件的记录：（1）涉及证人曾经知晓但无法回忆的事项；（2）在该事项于记忆中尚属清晰时制作或采纳；以及（3）准确反映了证人的个人认知。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 803(1) (hearsay exception - present sense impression).

Fed. R. Evid. 803(5) (hearsay exception - recorded recollection).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考题解析

Evidence / Hearsay Exceptions

✅ 正确答案：B
可以，因为它既属于即时感观印象 (Present Sense Impression)，也属于有记录的回忆 (Recorded Recollection)。

本题考察的是传闻证据规则（Hearsay Rule）的两个重要例外。虽然录音属于庭外陈述（Out-of-court statement），通常不可采纳，但本案中的录音同时满足了两个例外的条件。

⚖️ 法律依据与推理
1. 即时感观印象 FRE 803(1)

定义： 描述或解释某一事件或状况的陈述，且该陈述是在陈述人感知该事件时或感知后立即作出的。

本案应用：
证人是在肇事车辆“飞速驶离时”(as the car sped off) 录入的车牌号。这完全符合“感知时或感知后立即”的时间要求。因为没有时间去捏造，所以法律认为其具有可靠性。
2. 有记录的回忆 FRE 803(5)

定义： 当证人现在无法充分回忆以进行作证时，可以使用其之前制作的记录。需满足三个条件：

  • 证人曾经知晓该事项；
  • 记录是在记忆犹新时制作或采纳的；
  • 记录准确反映了证人的认知。
本案应用：
  • 无法回忆： 证人作证说他“已记不清该号码”。
  • 记忆犹新： 录音是在事故发生时制作的。
  • 准确性： 证人作证说他当时“准确地口述”了号码。
因此，该录音符合此例外。
❌ 为什么排除其他选项
  • 选项 A (No)： 错误。录音确实是传闻证据 (Hearsay)，但它符合例外规定，因此可以采纳。
  • 选项 C (Only PSI)： 错误。虽然它符合即时感观印象，但也符合有记录的回忆。MBE 题目中如果出现“Only”（仅），通常需要非常小心，除非确实排除了其他可能性。
  • 选项 D (Only Recorded Recollection)： 错误。理由同上，它同时也符合即时感观印象。
💡 MBE 备考锦囊

1. 区分两个例外的关键点：

  • Present Sense Impression 关注的是时间（Timing）。只要是“边看边说”或“刚看完就说”，通常就符合，不需要证人失忆。
  • Recorded Recollection 关注的是记忆缺失（Memory Loss）。必须是证人在法庭上想不起来了，才把之前的笔记/录音拿出来用。

2. 证据的展示方式：

根据 FRE 803(5)，有记录的回忆通常是“宣读/播放”进记录（read into evidence），而实物本身通常不作为呈堂证物（Exhibit），除非对方律师要求。本题问“May the voice recording be played?”（可以播放吗？），这符合该规则的操作方式。

questions.question:
A plaintiff sued a church, claiming that the church improperly removed a headstone from a small cemetery on the church's property. In the deed to the church, an easement was reserved for the use of burial plots by the grantor and his heirs and assigns. At trial, the plaintiff seeks to introduce evidence of the inscription on the removed headstone that read, "Here lies [family name of the grantor]."
Is the inscription on the headstone admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: No, because the inscription is a prior statement by an unavailable declarant.
choices.c: Yes, as a statement of fact about family history contained in a family record.
choices.d: Yes, provided that the plaintiff can authenticate the headstone by a preponderance of the evidence.

data.questionStem:
Q87013

A plaintiff sued a church, claiming that the church improperly removed a headstone from a small cemetery on the church's property. In the deed to the church, an easement was reserved for the use of burial plots by the grantor and his heirs and assigns. At trial, the plaintiff seeks to introduce evidence of the inscription on the removed headstone that read, "Here lies [family name of the grantor]."

Is the inscription on the headstone admissible?

一名原告起诉一所教堂，声称该教堂不当移除了其地产上一个小墓地中的一块墓碑。在该教堂的契约中，为出让人及其继承人和受让人保留了使用墓地的地役权。在审判中，原告试图引入被移除墓碑上的铭文作为证据，该铭文写着：“【出让人的姓氏】安息于此。”

该墓碑上的铭文是否可以采纳？
options:
A. No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
不可以，因为它是传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。

B. No, because the inscription is a prior statement by an unavailable declarant.
不可以，因为该铭文是由一名无法出庭的陈述人所做的先前陈述。

C. Yes, as a statement of fact about family history contained in a family record.
可以，因为它是包含在家庭记录中的关于家族史的事实陈述。

D. Yes, provided that the plaintiff can authenticate the headstone by a preponderance of the evidence.
可以，前提是原告能够通过优势证据规则对墓碑进行认证。
data.explanation:
Examples of family records excepted from hearsay


(FRE 803(13)) Family bible
Genealogy
Family chart
Engraving on ring or urn
Inscription on portrait
Engraving/inscription on burial marker
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

The rule against hearsay bars the admission of out-of-court statements (oral, written, or nonverbal) offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein unless a hearsay exclusion or exception applies. One exception applies to statements of fact about personal or family history contained in a family record - regardless of the declarant's availability (Choice B).

Here, the plaintiff seeks to introduce the inscription (out-of-court statement) to prove that the person named in the inscription (the grantor's heir) is the person buried there. But since the inscription is a factual statement about family history (relative's death) contained in a family record (headstone), it is excepted from hearsay. Therefore, the inscription is admissible (Choice A).

(Choice D) Tangible evidence (eg, headstone inscription) must be authenticated before it can be admitted at trial. This requires proof that the item is what the proponent claims it to be. This is an easier standard to meet than a preponderance of the evidence, which requires that a party show that the greater weight of the evidence (more than 50%) supports his/her argument.

Educational objective: Statements of fact about personal or family history contained in a family record are excepted from the rule against hearsay, regardless of the declarant's availability.

选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 0%，C选项 58%（正确选项），D选项 31%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

免于传闻证据规则的家庭记录示例


(FRE 803(13)) 家庭圣经
家谱
家族图表
戒指或骨灰瓮上的雕刻
肖像上的题词
墓碑上的雕刻/铭文
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence)。

传闻证据排除规则禁止采纳为证明其所主张事项的真实性而提出的庭外陈述（口头、书面或非语言），除非有传闻证据的排除或例外情况适用。其中一个例外情况适用于包含在家庭记录中的关于个人或家族史的事实陈述——无论陈述人是否可以出庭作证 (选项B) 。

在本案中，原告试图引入铭文（庭外陈述）来证明铭文中提到的人（出让人的继承人）就是埋葬在此处的人。但由于该铭文是包含在家庭记录（墓碑）中关于家族史（亲属死亡）的事实陈述，因此它属于传闻证据规则的例外情况。因此，该铭文是可采纳的 (选项A) 。

(选项D) 有形证据（例如，墓碑铭文）在审判中被采纳前必须经过认证。这要求证明该物品确实是证据提出方所声称的那个物品。这是一个比优势证据规则更容易满足的标准，后者要求一方当事人证明证据的较大权重（超过50%）支持其论点。

教学目标： 包含在家庭记录中的关于个人或家族史的事实陈述，不受传闻证据规则的限制，无论陈述人是否可以出庭作证。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 803(13) (hearsay exception for statements regarding personal or family history in family records).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay Exceptions

正确答案：C

本题考察的是传闻证据规则（Hearsay Rule）中的一个特定例外：家庭记录（Family Records）。

核心法律规则：FRE 803(13)

规则内容：关于个人或家族史的事实陈述（Statements of Fact about Personal or Family History），如果包含在家庭记录中，则不受传闻证据规则的限制。

关键点：无论陈述人（Declarant）是否可以出庭（Available），该例外均适用。

根据《联邦证据规则》（Federal Rules of Evidence, FRE），虽然墓碑上的铭文是庭外陈述，且被用来证明铭文内容的真实性（即谁埋葬于此），属于传闻证据（Hearsay），但它符合 FRE 803(13) 的例外情况。

什么是“家庭记录”？

FRE 803(13) 列举了多种被视为具有内在可靠性的家庭记录形式：

家庭记录示例 (Family Records)
家庭圣经 (Family Bibles)
家谱 (Genealogies)
戒指上的雕刻 (Engravings on rings)
肖像上的题词 (Inscriptions on portraits)
墓碑/骨灰瓮上的铭文 (Engravings on urns or burial markers)

在本案中，墓碑上的铭文 "Here lies [family name]" 是关于家族史（死亡与埋葬）的事实陈述，且刻在墓碑这一典型的家庭记录载体上，因此可以直接采纳。

为什么选项 D 是错误的？

选项 D 提到："Provided that the plaintiff can authenticate the headstone by a preponderance of the evidence."

错误原因分析：

  1. 认证标准错误：虽然实物证据确实需要认证（Authentication），但认证的标准通常是“足以支持陪审团认定该证据是真实的”（sufficient to support a finding），这是一个较低的门槛（Prima Facie showing）。而“优势证据”（Preponderance of the evidence，即 >50%）通常是事实认定者在最终裁决时的标准，或者是法官在处理某些初步问题时的标准，但对于基本的证据认证来说，描述不准确且标准过高。
  2. 未解决传闻问题：即使证据被完美认证，如果它是传闻证据且无例外适用，依然不可采纳。选项 C 直接解决了本题最大的法律障碍——传闻规则。
考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 证据法题目中，当看到涉及出生、死亡、婚姻等家族历史信息的证据时，请立即联想以下两个例外：

  • FRE 803(13) 家庭记录：适用于圣经、墓碑等实物（无论陈述人是否在世）。
  • FRE 804(b)(4) 家族史陈述：适用于口头陈述，但必须要求陈述人不可出庭（Unavailable）。

本题中墓碑铭文属于前者，因此不需要考虑陈述人是否可用。

questions.question:
A defendant was prosecuted for homicide. He testified that he shot in self-defense. In rebuttal, the prosecution called a police officer who testified that he came to the scene in response to a telephone call from the defendant. The officer offers to testify that he asked, "What is the problem here, sir?" and the defendant replied, "I was cleaning my gun and it went off accidentally."
Is the officer's testimony about the defendant's statement admissible?

choices.a: No, because of the defendant's privilege against self-incrimination.
choices.b: No, because the statement is hearsay not within an exception.
choices.c: Yes, as an excited utterance.
choices.d: Yes, to impeach the defendant and as evidence that he did not act in self-defense.

data.questionStem:
Q87054

A defendant was prosecuted for homicide. He testified that he shot in self-defense. In rebuttal, the prosecution called a police officer who testified that he came to the scene in response to a telephone call from the defendant. The officer offers to testify that he asked, "What is the problem here, sir?" and the defendant replied, "I was cleaning my gun and it went off accidentally."

Is the officer's testimony about the defendant's statement admissible?

一名被告因杀人罪被起诉。他作证称其开枪是出于自卫。在反驳阶段，检方传唤了一名警官，该警官作证称，他是接到被告的电话后赶到现场的。该警官提出要作证，他当时问：“先生，这里出了什么问题？”被告回答说：“我当时正在擦枪，枪支走火了。”

该警官关于被告陈述的证词是否可以采纳？
options:
A. No, because of the defendant's privilege against self-incrimination.
不可以，因为被告享有反对自证其罪的特权。

B. No, because the statement is hearsay not within an exception.
不可以，因为该陈述属于传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。

C. Yes, as an excited utterance.
可以，作为激动性陈述。

D. Yes, to impeach the defendant and as evidence that he did not act in self-defense.
可以，用以弹劾被告，并作为其并非出于自卫行为的证据。
data.explanation:
Witness's prior inconsistent statement


UseApplicabilityMethods of introduction
ImpeachmentAlways admissible to discredit witness's trial testimonyExamining witness about prior statement Introducing extrinsic evidence if: witness can address & opposing party can question witness about statement or justice so requires
Substantive evidenceAdmissible to prove truth only if excluded or excepted from hearsay
A prior inconsistent statement is a statement that was made by a witness in the past that is inconsistent with the witness's current testimony. Such statements can be used to impeach a witness by showing that the witness is unreliable.† Therefore, the officer's testimony - that the defendant previously claimed that he accidentally shot his gun - can be used to impeach the defendant's testimony that he shot in self-defense.

However, an out-of-court statement can only be used to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein if it falls within an exclusion or exception to the rule against hearsay. One exclusion is for statements made by and offered against an opposing party. Here, the prosecution seeks to admit the defendant's prior out-of-court statement against him. Therefore, it falls under this exclusion and can also be admitted to prove the truth asserted - that the defendant shot his gun accidentally, not in self-defense (Choice B).

†A party need not show or disclose the contents of a prior inconsistent statement to a witness before questioning the witness on the inconsistency. But the party must, on request, show the statement or disclose its contents to an adverse party's attorney.

(Choice A) The Fifth Amendment privilege against self-incrimination applies to custodial interrogations. Here, the defendant was not under arrest or restrained in his freedom of movement (ie, not in custody) when he responded to the officer. Therefore, this privilege does not apply.

(Choice C) An excited utterance is a hearsay exception for statements that relate to an exciting event and were made while the declarant was under the stress of excitement from that event. This exception is inapplicable here since the defendant's statement is not hearsay and even it if was, there is no indication that it was made under the stress of excitement.

Educational objective: Prior inconsistent statements - ie, statements made by a witness in the past that are inconsistent with the witness's current testimony - can be used to impeach a witness. But these out-of-court statements can only be used to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein if they fall within an exclusion or exception to the hearsay rule.

选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 6%，C选项 3%，D选项 88%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

证人先前的不一致陈述


用途可适用性引入方式
弹劾始终可采纳，用以削弱证人庭审证词的可信度就先前的陈述对证人进行询问
引入外在证据，条件是：证人有机会解释该陈述，且反对方有机会就该陈述对证人进行质询或司法公正要求如此
实质性证据仅在被排除于传闻证据规则之外或属于其例外情况时，才可被采纳以证明其内容的真实性
先前不一致的陈述是指证人过去所作的与其当前证词不一致的陈述。此类陈述可用于弹劾证人，以表明该证人不可靠。†因此，该警官的证词——即被告先前声称其枪支是意外走火——可用于弹劾被告关于其出于自卫而开枪的证词。

然而，庭外陈述只有在属于传闻证据规则的排除或例外情况下，才能用以证明其所主张事项的真实性。其中一种排除情况是由反对方作出并用以对抗该反对方的陈述。在本案中，检方试图采纳被告先前的庭外陈述以对抗他。因此，该陈述属于此排除情况，也可以被采纳以证明其所主张内容的真实性——即被告是意外开枪，而非出于自卫（选项 B）。

†一方在就前后不一致之处质询证人前，无需向该证人出示或披露先前不一致陈述的内容。但是，经请求，该方必须向对方律师出示该陈述或披露其内容。

（选项 A）美国宪法第五修正案中反对自证其罪的特权适用于羁押讯问。在本案中，被告在回答警官问题时，并未被逮捕，其行动自由也未受限制（即，未被羁押）。因此，该特权不适用。

（选项 C）激动性陈述是传闻证据的一项例外，适用于与某一令人激动的事件相关，且由陈述人在该事件所致的激动状态压力下作出的陈述。此例外在本案中不适用，因为被告的陈述不属于传闻证据，即便属于，也没有迹象表明该陈述是在激动状态的压力下作出的。

教学目的：先前不一致的陈述——即证人过去所作的与其当前证词不一致的陈述——可用于弹劾证人。但是，这些庭外陈述只有在属于传闻证据规则的排除或例外情况下，才能用以证明其所主张事项的真实性。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 801 (nonhearsay statements).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence / Hearsay & Impeachment

🔑 核心考点 (Key Concept) 当庭外陈述由当事人对手方 (Party-Opponent) 作出，并被用来对抗该方时，根据 Federal Rules of Evidence (FRE) 801(d)(2)，该陈述不是传闻证据 (Not Hearsay)。
✅ 正确答案解析 (Option D)

本题考察的是被告先前陈述的双重用途：

1. 弹劾 (Impeachment)：
被告在法庭上作证说是“自卫” (Self-defense)，但他之前对警察说是“意外走火” (Accident)。这构成了先前不一致陈述 (Prior Inconsistent Statement)。检方可以用此证据来攻击被告的可信度，证明他在撒谎。

2. 实质性证据 (Substantive Evidence)：
通常，先前不一致陈述只能用于弹劾，不能证明陈述内容的真实性（除非是在宣誓下作出的）。
但是！
因为陈述人是被告（案件当事人），且证据是由检方（对手方）引入的，这属于当事人对手方的自认 (Admission by Party-Opponent)。

在联邦证据规则下，这被归类为非传闻 (Non-hearsay)。因此，它不仅可以用来弹劾，还可以作为实质性证据，证明被告确实是“意外走火”而非“自卫”。

❌ 干扰项辨析
选项 A 自证其罪特权 (Self-Incrimination)
第五修正案的 Miranda 警告适用于“羁押讯问” (Custodial Interrogation)。本案中，警察刚到现场问“出了什么事”，这属于一般的现场调查，被告并未被羁押 (Not in custody)，因此其自愿回答不受第五修正案保护。
选项 B 传闻证据 (Hearsay)
这是一个常见的陷阱。根据 FRE 801(d)(2)，当事人自认被定义为“排除在传闻之外” (Exclusion / Exemption)，而不是传闻的“例外” (Exception)。虽然结果都是可采纳，但法律定性上它根本就“不是传闻”。
选项 C 激动性陈述 (Excited Utterance)
虽然这可能符合激动性陈述的条件，但不是最佳答案。因为即使没有激动情绪，基于“当事人自认”规则，该陈述也绝对可采纳。且选项 D 完整涵盖了证据的用途（弹劾+实质证据）。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip) 在 MBE 证据法题目中，如果看到被告 (Defendant) 以前说过的话被检方拿来用：
  • 首先想：Admission by Party-Opponent。
  • 结论通常是：既可以用来弹劾 (Impeach)，也可以用来证明事实 (Substantive Evidence)。
  • 不需要找其他传闻例外（如 Excited Utterance），因为它是 Non-hearsay。

questions.question:
A defendant is on trial for robbing a particular bank with his best friend. The friend has left the country and cannot be found. The prosecutor has called the friend's mother to testify to a conversation she had with her son the day before he left the country. She implored him not to go, but he said, "Mom, I have to go. I was involved in a robbery at the bank, and I don't want them to catch me." The prosecutor has other evidence indicating that the defendant and the friend were together on the morning of the robbery.
Is the statement by the friend to his mother admissible?

choices.a: No, because inculpatory statements against penal interest do not satisfy the confrontation clause.
choices.b: No, because the friend's statement to his mother was not corroborated.
choices.c: Yes, as a statement against penal interest that is not testimonial under the confrontation clause.
choices.d: Yes, as a statement of the friend's state of mind that is not testimonial under the confrontation clause.

data.questionStem:
Q87823 A defendant is on trial for robbing a particular bank with his best friend. The friend has left the country and cannot be found. The prosecutor has called the friend's mother to testify to a conversation she had with her son the day before he left the country. She implored him not to go, but he said, "Mom, I have to go. I was involved in a robbery at the bank, and I don't want them to catch me." The prosecutor has other evidence indicating that the defendant and the friend were together on the morning of the robbery.

Is the statement by the friend to his mother admissible? 一名被告因与其最好的朋友抢劫某家银行而受审。该朋友已离开该国且无法找到。检察官传唤了该朋友的母亲，让她就其儿子离开该国前一天与她的谈话作证。她恳求儿子不要走，但他说：“妈妈，我必须走。我参与了银行抢劫，我不想被他们抓到。”检察官有其他证据表明，被告和该朋友在抢劫案发生的早晨曾在一起。

该朋友对其母亲的陈述是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because inculpatory statements against penal interest do not satisfy the confrontation clause.
不可采纳，因为不利于刑事利益的归罪性陈述不满足对质条款。

B. No, because the friend's statement to his mother was not corroborated.
不可采纳，因为该朋友对其母亲的陈述没有得到佐证。

C. Yes, as a statement against penal interest that is not testimonial under the confrontation clause.
可采纳，因为这是不利于刑事利益的陈述，且根据对质条款，该陈述不属于证言性质。

D. Yes, as a statement of the friend's state of mind that is not testimonial under the confrontation clause.
可采纳，因为这是关于该朋友当时心智状态的陈述，且根据对质条款，该陈述不属于证言性质。
data.explanation:
A statement against interest is one that:
  • is contrary to the declarant's proprietary (ie, ownership) or pecuniary (ie, monetary) interest
  • tends to invalidate the declarant's claim against someone else or
  • exposes the declarant to civil or criminal liability.
These statements are excluded from the rule against hearsay if they were made by an unavailable declarant. But if the statement is offered in a criminal case and exposes the declarant to criminal liability, then the statement must also be supported by corroborating circumstances that clearly indicate its trustworthiness.

Here, the friend has left the country and cannot be located (unavailable), and his stated involvement in a robbery (criminal liability) is corroborated by evidence that he was with the defendant on the morning of the robbery (Choice B). Therefore, his statement falls within this hearsay exception. But since the friend cannot be confronted at the defendant's criminal trial, the introduction of this statement raises Sixth Amendment concerns.

The Sixth Amendment confrontation clause secures a criminal defendant's right to cross-examine witnesses offering testimonial evidence against the defendant. Evidence is testimonial if it was made primarily for use in a criminal investigation or prosecution. And such evidence is inadmissible unless (1) the declarant is unavailable as a witness at trial and (2) the defendant had a prior opportunity to cross-examine the declarant.

Here, the friend's statement is admissible because it was made to his mother—not for an investigation or prosecutor—so it is not testimonial under the confrontation clause (Choice A).

(Choice D) Statements of a declarant's then-existing state of mind (eg, motive, intent, plan) are excepted from the rule against hearsay. Since that state of mind must exist at the time the statement is made, statements of past memory or events (as seen here) do not fall under this exception.

Educational objective: Statements against interest—eg, ones that expose the declarant to civil or criminal liability—are excepted from the rule against hearsay if they were made by an unavailable declarant. But these statements are only admissible in a criminal case if they comply with the confrontation clause.





不利于己方利益的陈述是指：
  • 与陈述人的所有权利益（即所有权）或金钱利益（即金钱）相悖
  • 倾向于使陈述人对他人的主张无效或
  • 使陈述人面临民事或刑事责任。
如果这些陈述是由无法到庭的陈述人作出的，则它们不适用于反传闻规则。但是，如果该陈述在刑事案件中提出，并使陈述人面临刑事责任，那么该陈述还必须有佐证情节的支持，以清楚地表明其可靠性。

在本案中，该朋友已离开该国且无法找到（无法到庭），而他所陈述的参与抢劫行为（刑事责任）有证据佐证，即他与被告在抢劫案发生的早晨在一起（选项B）。因此，他的陈述属于此传闻例外。但由于在被告的刑事审判中无法与该朋友对质，引入该陈述引发了第六修正案的关切。

第六修正案的对质条款保障了刑事被告交叉询问提供对其不利的证言性质证据的证人的权利。如果证据主要是为了在刑事调查或起诉中使用而作出的，那么该证据就是证言性质的。除非（1）陈述人在审判时无法作为证人出庭，并且（2）被告曾有事先机会交叉询问该陈述人，否则此类证据不可采纳。

在本案中，该朋友的陈述是可采纳的，因为这是对他母亲说的——而不是为了调查或向检察官提供——因此根据对质条款，该陈述不属于证言性质（选项A）。

(选项D) 关于陈述人当时存在的心智状态（例如动机、意图、计划）的陈述，是反传闻规则的例外。由于该心智状态必须在陈述作出时就存在，因此关于过去记忆或事件的陈述（如本案所示）不属于此例外。

教学目标： 不利于己方利益的陈述——例如，使陈述人面临民事或刑事责任的陈述——如果是由无法到庭的陈述人作出的，则属于反传闻规则的例外。但这些陈述只有在符合对质条款的情况下，才可以在刑事案件中被采纳。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 804(b)(3) (hearsay exception for statements against interest).

data.htmlContent:
Evidence Law

MBE 考点解析

正确答案：选项 C

可采纳，因为这是不利于刑事利益的陈述，且根据对质条款，该陈述不属于证言性质。

本题考察的是证据法中两个核心概念的交叉点：传闻证据的例外与宪法第六修正案的对质条款。

核心考点分析

1. 不利于己方利益的陈述

Statement Against Interest (FRE 804(b)(3))

这是传闻规则的一个例外。要适用此例外，必须满足三个条件：

  • 陈述人无法出庭 (Unavailable)：本案中朋友已逃往国外。
  • 不利于自身利益 (Against Penal Interest)：朋友承认参与抢劫，这使其面临刑事责任。
  • 佐证情节 (Corroborating Circumstances)：在刑事案件中，必须有佐证证明陈述的可信度。本案中，检方有证据表明两人案发早晨在一起，满足了佐证要求。

因此，该陈述符合传闻例外，初步具备可采性。

2. 对质条款与证言性质

Confrontation Clause & Testimonial Evidence

即使符合传闻例外，在刑事案件中，针对被告的证据还必须通过宪法第六修正案的检验（Crawford v. Washington）。

  • 规则： 如果庭外陈述是证言性质的 (Testimonial)，且被告没有机会交叉询问陈述人，则该证据不可采纳。
  • 什么是证言性质？ 通常指为了在审判中使用而向执法人员作出的陈述（如警察审讯）。
  • 本案分析： 朋友是对他母亲说话，是在私密、非正式的场合。这种陈述被视为非证言性质 (Non-testimonial)。
逻辑推理链条

解题思路如下：

  1. 是传闻吗？是。
  2. 有例外吗？有（不利于己方利益的陈述）。
  3. 是否违反宪法对质权？否，因为对母亲说的话不是“证言”。
  4. 结论： 证据可采纳 (Admissible)。
常见陷阱辨析
为什么选项 D 错误？
State of Mind Exception

很多考生看到“不想被抓”会误选“当时的心智状态”。

关键区别： 心智状态例外（FRE 803(3)）仅适用于陈述人当下的感受、意图或计划（如“我打算去抢劫”）。但本案中，朋友说的是“我参与了抢劫” ("I was involved...")。这是对过去事实的记忆 (Statement of memory or belief)，明确被排除在心智状态例外之外。

为什么选项 A 错误？

选项 A 错误地认为所有不利于刑事利益的陈述都违反了对质条款。事实上，只有当这些陈述是证言性质（如对警察供述）时，才会因为无法对质而被排除。对家人朋友的私下谈话通常不在此列。

questions.question:
In a civil action for personal injury, a man alleges that he was beaten up by a bouncer during an altercation in a crowded bar. The bouncer's defense is that he was not the person who hit the man. To corroborate his testimony about the cause of his injuries, the man seeks to introduce, through the hospital records custodian, a notation in a regular medical record made by an emergency room doctor at the hospital where the man was treated for his injuries. The notation is: "Patient says he was attacked by the bouncer at the bar."
Is the notation admissible?

choices.a: No, as hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: No, unless the doctor who made the record is present at trial and available for cross-examination.
choices.c: Yes, as a statement made for the purpose of medical diagnosis or treatment.
choices.d: Yes, as hearsay within the exception for records of regularly conducted activity.

data.questionStem:
Q87029

In a civil action for personal injury, a man alleges that he was beaten up by a bouncer during an altercation in a crowded bar. The bouncer's defense is that he was not the person who hit the man. To corroborate his testimony about the cause of his injuries, the man seeks to introduce, through the hospital records custodian, a notation in a regular medical record made by an emergency room doctor at the hospital where the man was treated for his injuries. The notation is: "Patient says he was attacked by the bouncer at the bar."

Is the notation admissible?

在一起人身伤害的民事诉讼中，一名男子声称他在一家拥挤的酒吧里与人发生争执时，被一名保镖殴打。保镖的辩护理由是，他并非殴打该男子的人。为了证实其关于受伤原因的证词，该男子试图通过医院病历保管人，引入一份由其接受治疗的医院急诊室医生在常规医疗病历中所作的记录。该记录写道：“病人称其在酒吧被保镖袭击。”

该记录可被采纳为证据吗？
options:
A. No, as hearsay not within any exception.
不可以，因为该记录属于传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。

B. No, unless the doctor who made the record is present at trial and available for cross-examination.
不可以，除非制作该记录的医生出庭并接受交叉询问。

C. Yes, as a statement made for the purpose of medical diagnosis or treatment.
可以，因为该陈述是为了医疗诊断或治疗目的而作出的。

D. Yes, as hearsay within the exception for records of regularly conducted activity.
可以，因为该记录属于传闻证据中“日常业务活动记录”的例外情况。
data.explanation:
Common hearsay exceptions


Declarant unavailableDeclarant's availability irrelevant
Former testimonyPresent sense impression
Dying declarationExcited utterance
Statement against interestMental state or physical condition
Statement of personal or family historyMedical diagnosis or treatment
Statement offered against party that wrongfully caused declarant's unavailabilityRecorded recollection
Business or public records
Learned treatises, periodicals, or pamphlets
Judgment of previous conviction
Residual (catch-all) exception
Hearsay is an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein. This type of statement is considered inherently unreliable and therefore is only admissible if it falls within an exclusion or exception to the rule against hearsay. One exception raised here applies to records of regularly conducted activity - ie, records that are:
  • made at or near the time of the recorded event (or act, condition, opinion, diagnosis)
  • made by or based on information from someone with personal knowledge of that event and
  • made and kept as a regular practice in the course of regularly conducted business activities.
As a result, this exception would apply to statements in medical records that contain information within the personal knowledge of health care professionals, such as the patient's vital signs or the physician's diagnosis. But statements that merely report how a patient was injured (as seen here) would not fall within this exception (Choice D).

Another hearsay exception raised here applies to statements made for medical diagnosis or treatment - ie, statements that describe the declarant's medical history, past or present symptoms, or the inception or general cause of those symptoms. This exception would apply to statements about how a patient was injured - not who is responsible for that injury (as seen in the notation) (Choice C). And since no other hearsay exclusion or exception applies, the notation is inadmissible.

(Choice B) A record of regularly conducted activity is admissible regardless of whether the person who made the record is present at trial and available for cross-examination. So had the notation met this exception, the doctor's presence at trial would be irrelevant.

Educational objective: Medical records containing information within the personal knowledge of health care professionals fall within the hearsay exception for records of regularly conducted activity. And statements in those records that describe the declarant's medical history, symptoms, or their general cause fall within the hearsay exception for statements made for medical diagnosis or treatment.

选项正确率统计：A选项 47%（正确选项），B选项 5%，C选项 24%，D选项 22%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

常见的传闻证据例外


陈述人无法出庭陈述人能否出庭无关紧要
以往的证词即时感官印象
临终遗言激动言辞
不利于己方利益的陈述精神状态或身体状况
个人或家族史的陈述医疗诊断或治疗
针对不当导致陈述人无法出庭的一方当事人所提出的陈述记录下的回忆
商业或公共记录
学术专著、期刊或小册子
先前定罪的判决
剩余（兜底）例外条款
传闻证据（Hearsay）是指在法庭外作出的、为证明其所主张事项的真实性而提出的陈述。此类陈述被认为是内在不可靠的，因此只有在符合排除传闻证据规则的排除或例外情况下才可被采纳。本案中提出的一个例外情况适用于日常业务活动记录 - 即满足以下条件的记录：
  • 在被记录的事件（或行为、状况、意见、诊断）发生当时或临近当时作出
  • 由对该事件有亲身认知的人作出，或基于该等人士提供的信息作出，并且
  • 在日常业务活动过程中，作为常规惯例而制作和保存。
因此，此例外情况适用于医疗病历中包含医护专业人员亲身认知信息的陈述，例如病人的生命体征或医生的诊断。但是，仅仅报告病人如何受伤的陈述（如本案所示）则不属于此例外情况（选项D）。

本案中提出的另一个传闻证据例外情况适用于为医疗诊断或治疗目的而作出的陈述 - 即描述陈述人的病史、过去或现在的症状，或这些症状的起因或一般性原因的陈述。此例外情况适用于关于病人如何受伤的陈述，而不适用于关于谁对该伤害负责的陈述（如此处记录所示）（选项C）。并且，由于没有其他传闻证据的排除或例外情况适用，该记录不可被采纳。

（选项B）无论制作记录的人是否出庭并接受交叉询问，日常业务活动记录都是可采纳的。因此，即使该记录符合此例外情况，医生是否出庭也无关紧要。

教学目的：包含医护专业人员亲身认知信息的医疗病历，属于传闻证据中“日常业务活动记录”的例外情况。而这些病历中描述陈述人病史、症状或其一般性原因的陈述，则属于传闻证据中“为医疗诊断或治疗目的而作出的陈述”的例外情况。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 803(4) (hearsay exception for statements made for medical diagnosis or treatment).

Fed. R. Evid. 803(6) (hearsay exception for records of regularly conducted activity).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay Exceptions
正确答案：A 不可采纳，因为该记录属于传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。
核心考点：双重传闻 (Hearsay within Hearsay)

本题涉及一份包含病人陈述的医疗记录。要使整个记录可被采纳，记录中的每一层传闻都必须符合传闻证据规则的例外。

  • 第一层： 医生写的病历记录（本身是 Business Record）。
  • 第二层： 病人对医生说的话（"Patient says..."）。

1. 医疗诊断例外 (FRE 803(4))

这是本题的关键。根据 Federal Rule of Evidence 803(4)，为了医疗诊断或治疗目的而作出的陈述是可以采纳的例外。

规则范围： 包括对病史、症状、疼痛或感觉的描述，以及"症状的起因或一般性质" (inception or general character of the cause)。

规则限制（关键点）： 只有与诊断或治疗合理相关 (reasonably pertinent) 的陈述才被允许。通常，关于"是谁" (Identity) 造成了伤害的陈述，与医生如何治疗病人无关。

陈述内容 是否与治疗相关？ 可采纳性
"我被钝器击打" 是 (医生需判断伤情) ✅ 可采纳
"我被保镖袭击" 否 (这是法律归责问题) ❌ 不可采纳

2. 商业记录例外 (FRE 803(6))

虽然医院的病历本身属于日常业务活动记录 (Records of Regularly Conducted Activity)，但这只能解决"医生记录"这一层的传闻问题。

如果记录中包含的信息（即病人的话）本身不符合例外，那么即使它被写在合法的商业记录里，这部分内容依然不可采纳。因为病人并没有"商业义务"去如实报告。

为什么其他选项错误？

  • 选项 C (错误)： 虽然陈述是在就医时作出的，但指认"保镖"这一特定加害人的部分并非为了诊断或治疗所必需。
  • 选项 D (错误)： 商业记录例外不能自动洗白记录中包含的第三方（病人）的传闻陈述。
  • 选项 B (错误)： 商业记录例外的核心就是不需要制作记录的人出庭（只要有保管人 custodian 认证即可）。
💡 MBE 拿分技巧 在处理涉及医疗记录的传闻题目时，请务必区分：
1. 医学事实（"我背部被踢了"） -> Admissible
2. 归责事实（"是那个保镖踢的"） -> Inadmissible

除非是家庭暴力或性侵案件（在这些特殊情况下，施暴者身份可能与心理治疗或防止再次受伤的治疗方案相关），否则指认肇事者的陈述通常不被视为"为了医疗诊断"。

The decedent's primary care physician has testified at trial that the decedent had a routine checkup on February 15. The physician then identifies a photocopy of a questionnaire, provided by the physician and completed by the decedent on that date, in which the decedent wrote: "Yesterday afternoon I broke into a big sweat and my chest hurt for a while." The beneficiary now offers the photocopy in evidence.
Should the court admit the photocopy?

choices.a: No, because the original questionnaire has not been shown to be unavailable.
choices.b: No, because the statement related to past rather than present symptoms.
choices.c: Yes, as a business record.

Q87008

The beneficiary of a decedent's life insurance policy has sued the life insurance company for the proceeds of the policy. At issue is the date when the decedent first experienced the heart problems that led to his death.

The decedent's primary care physician has testified at trial that the decedent had a routine checkup on February 15. The physician then identifies a photocopy of a questionnaire, provided by the physician and completed by the decedent on that date, in which the decedent wrote: "Yesterday afternoon I broke into a big sweat and my chest hurt for a while." The beneficiary now offers the photocopy in evidence.

Should the court admit the photocopy?

一名死者人寿保险单的受益人，已起诉该人寿保险公司，要求支付保单收益。争议点在于死者首次出现导致其死亡的心脏问题的日期。

死者的主治医生在庭审中作证，称死者于2月15日进行了一次例行检查。医生随后辨认了一份问卷的复印件，该问卷由医生提供并由死者于当日填写，其中死者写道：“昨天下午我大汗淋漓，胸口疼了一会儿。”受益人现将该复印件作为证据提交。

法院是否应采纳该复印件？
options:
A. No, because the original questionnaire has not been shown to be unavailable.
不应采纳，因为尚未证明原始问卷无法获得。

B. No, because the statement related to past rather than present symptoms.
不应采纳，因为该陈述涉及的是过去的症状而非当前的症状。

C. Yes, as a business record.
应采纳，作为商业记录。

D. Yes, as a statement for the purpose of obtaining medical treatment.
应采纳，作为以获取医疗为目的的陈述。
data.explanation:
Statement made for medical diagnosis or treatment


(FRE 803(4)) Hearsay exception for statement by declarant (available or not) that is:

made for & reasonably pertinent to medical diagnosis or treatment and describes declarant's:
medical history past or present symptoms or sensations or inception or general cause of symptoms
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence

Under the rule against hearsay, an out-of-court statement (eg, a writing) is presumed unreliable and is generally inadmissible when offered to prove the truth of a matter asserted therein. One exception to this rule applies to statements that:
  • are made for and reasonably pertinent to medical diagnosis or treatment and
  • describe the declarant's medical history, past or present symptoms, or the inception or general cause of those symptoms (Choice B).
Such statements are deemed reliable because patients have an incentive to be truthful in order to receive proper medical care.

Here, the decedent noted his physical symptoms in the physician's medical questionnaire. And the decedent's statement about his sweating and chest pains was clearly made to obtain medical diagnosis and treatment. Therefore, the questionnaire is admissible as a statement made for this purpose. And under the best evidence rule, a duplicate is generally admissible to the same extent as the original writing - regardless of whether the original is available (Choice A). Therefore, the photocopy of the questionnaire is admissible.

(Choice C) For a record to be admissible under the business records hearsay exception, the record must have been made and kept as a regular practice in the course of regularly conducted business activities. Here, the record was made by the decedent - not the physician (or other hospital employee) as a regular practice in the regular course of medical activities. As a result, this exception does not apply.

Educational objective: One exception to the hearsay rule applies to statements that (1) were made for and reasonably pertinent to medical diagnosis or treatment and (2) described the declarant's medical history, past or present symptoms, or their inception or general cause.

选项正确率统计：A选项 6%，B选项 0%，C选项 20%，D选项 72%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

为医疗诊断或治疗目的作出的陈述


(FRE 803(4)) 传闻证据规则的例外，适用于陈述人（无论其是否可以出庭）所作的陈述，该陈述：

为医疗诊断或治疗而作出，且与此目的合理相关 并且 描述了陈述人的：
病史、过去或现在的症状或感觉 或 症状的起因或一般原因
FRE = 联邦证据规则

根据反传闻证据规则，庭外陈述（例如，书面文件）被推定为不可靠，并且当其被用于证明其内容所主张事项的真实性时，通常不予采纳。该规则的一项例外适用于符合以下条件的陈述：
  • 为医疗诊断或治疗而作出，且与此目的合理相关 并且
  • 描述了陈述人的病史、过去或现在的症状，或这些症状的起因或一般原因(选项B)。
此类陈述被认为是可靠的，因为患者有说实话的动机，以便获得适当的医疗。

在本案中，死者在医生的医疗问卷中记录了他的身体症状。死者关于他出汗和胸痛的陈述显然是为了获得医疗诊断和治疗而作出的。因此，该问卷作为为此目的作出的陈述应被采纳。并且，根据最佳证据规则，副本通常与原始文件在同等程度上可被采纳——无论原始文件是否可以获得(选项A)。因此，该问卷的复印件应被采纳。

(选项C) 要使一项记录根据商业记录的传闻证据例外规则被采纳，该记录必须是在正常进行的商业活动过程中，作为一项常规实践而制作和保存的。在本案中，该记录是由死者制作的——而非医生（或其他医院雇员）作为医疗活动正常过程中的常规实践。因此，该例外不适用。

教学目标：传闻证据规则的一项例外适用于以下陈述：(1) 为医疗诊断或治疗而作出，且与此目的合理相关；以及 (2) 描述了陈述人的病史、过去或现在的症状，或其起因或一般原因。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 803(4) (statement made for medical diagnosis or treatment).

MBE 证据法解析

Hearsay Exceptions & Best Evidence Rule
✅ 正确答案：D
核心考点：医疗诊断陈述例外

本题考察的是传闻证据规则（Hearsay Rule）的例外情况。根据 FRE 803(4)，以下陈述不被视为不可采纳的传闻：

  • 目的：为了医疗诊断或治疗（Medical Diagnosis or Treatment）而作出的陈述；
  • 内容：描述了病史、过去或现在的症状、疼痛或感觉，或者是症状的起因。

逻辑分析：
法律认为这种陈述具有内在的可靠性（Reliability），因为患者为了治好病，通常不会对医生撒谎。在本案中，死者在问卷上描述“昨天下午大汗淋漓、胸痛”，这显然是为了让医生进行诊断。因此，该陈述符合 FRE 803(4) 例外，可以采纳。

次要考点：最佳证据规则

题目中提到证据是“复印件”（Photocopy）。这涉及最佳证据规则（Best Evidence Rule）。

根据 FRE 1003，副本（Duplicate）通常与原件一样可被采纳，除非：

  1. 对原件的真实性提出了真正的质疑；或者
  2. 在特定情况下采纳副本是不公平的。

本题中没有事实表明原件真实性存疑，因此复印件完全可以作为证据使用，无需证明原件丢失。

为什么其他选项是错的？
❌ 选项 A (原件不可用)
这是旧的普通法规则。现代联邦证据规则（FRE）不要求必须证明原件丢失才能使用复印件，只要复印件是准确的副本即可。
❌ 选项 B (过去的症状)
这是一个常见的陷阱。虽然“现时感官印象”（Present Sense Impression）要求描述当下的情况，但医疗诊断例外（FRE 803(4)）明确包含“过去的症状”（Past Symptoms）。只要这些过去的信息对医生诊断病情有用，就是可采纳的。
❌ 选项 C (商业记录)
虽然医生的档案是商业记录，但问卷是由患者（死者）填写的。商业记录例外（Business Records Exception, FRE 803(6)）通常要求记录是由有义务报告信息的“内部人员”制作的。患者不是医院员工，没有商业义务，因此单纯依靠商业记录例外可能不足以涵盖患者的陈述内容，选项 D 是更直接、更准确的法律依据。
💡 MBE 考试技巧：
看到“看医生”或“医疗问卷”的情景，首先检查是否符合 FRE 803(4)。记住关键词：Past or Present Symptoms（过去或现在的症状）都是允许的，只要是为了求医治病。

questions.question:
A plaintiff, the first wife of a celebrity who recently died, sued an insurance company alleging that the celebrity's life insurance proceeds were improperly disbursed to the celebrity's second wife. In support of her claim, the plaintiff has produced a copy of the life insurance policy stating that all of the life insurance proceeds would be disbursed to the celebrity's first wife unless the celebrity remarried and remained married for at least 30 days. The celebrity's second wife alleges that they were married in secret well before the celebrity's death. The plaintiff now seeks to introduce evidence of the register of weddings at the church where the celebrity married the second wife to prove that they were married for less than 30 days before his death.
Is the church's wedding register admissible?

choices.a: No, because the wedding register is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: No, because there is no evidence that the church official who created the register is unavailable as a witness.
choices.c: Yes, because the date in the wedding register is relevant to determine the duration of the marriage.
choices.d: Yes, provided that the wedding register is part of the regularly kept records of the church.

Q87022

A plaintiff, the first wife of a celebrity who recently died, sued an insurance company alleging that the celebrity's life insurance proceeds were improperly disbursed to the celebrity's second wife. In support of her claim, the plaintiff has produced a copy of the life insurance policy stating that all of the life insurance proceeds would be disbursed to the celebrity's first wife unless the celebrity remarried and remained married for at least 30 days. The celebrity's second wife alleges that they were married in secret well before the celebrity's death. The plaintiff now seeks to introduce evidence of the register of weddings at the church where the celebrity married the second wife to prove that they were married for less than 30 days before his death.

Is the church's wedding register admissible?

一位原告，是一位最近去世的名人的第一任妻子，起诉了一家保险公司，声称该名人的人寿保险金被不当支付给了其第二任妻子。为支持其主张，原告出示了一份人寿保险单的副本，该保单规定，除非该名人再婚且婚姻关系维持至少30天，否则所有的人寿保险金都将支付给其第一任妻子。该名人的第二任妻子声称，他们在名人去世前很久就秘密结婚了。原告现在试图引入该名人与第二任妻子结婚教堂的婚礼登记簿作为证据，以证明他们在名人去世前结婚不足30天。

该教堂的婚礼登记簿是否可以采纳为证据？
options:
A. No, because the wedding register is hearsay not within any exception.
不可以，因为婚礼登记簿是传闻证据，且不属于任何例外情况。

B. No, because there is no evidence that the church official who created the register is unavailable as a witness.
不可以，因为没有证据表明制作该登记簿的教会职员无法作为证人出庭。

C. Yes, because the date in the wedding register is relevant to determine the duration of the marriage.
可以，因为婚礼登记簿中的日期与确定婚姻存续期相关。

D. Yes, provided that the wedding register is part of the regularly kept records of the church.
可以，前提是该婚礼登记簿是教会定期保存的记录的一部分。
data.explanation:
Religious records exception

(FRE 803(11)) Out-of-court statements are admissible for their truth if they:

  • concern personal or family history (eg, birth, legitimacy, death, ancestry, marriage, divorce) and are in regularly kept records of religious organization (eg, recorded in connection with religious ceremony)


FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

The rule against hearsay bars the admission of out-of-court statements (oral, written, or nonverbal) offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein unless a hearsay exclusion or exception applies. One hearsay exception applies to statements that:

  • concern personal or family history and are in a regularly kept record of a religious organization.


That is because such records generally contain additional guarantees of trustworthiness found in the solemn nature of religious ceremonies and the lack of personal interest of the church official making the record.

Here, the plaintiff seeks to introduce the church's wedding register (out-of-court statement) to prove that the celebrity and his second wife were married on the date listed therein. But since the wedding register concerns personal and family history, it is excepted from hearsay - and therefore admissible - if the register is part of the regularly kept records of the church (Choice A).

(Choice B) The religious records hearsay exception does not require that the proponent establish the declarant's unavailability as a witness.

(Choice C) The date in the church's wedding register is relevant to determine the duration of the marriage - a material issue in this case. But relevant evidence can still be excluded on other grounds, such as the rule against hearsay. Therefore, the wedding register is only admissible if it falls within a hearsay exclusion or exception.

Educational objective: Statements in regularly kept records of a religious organization that concern personal or family history are excepted from the rule against hearsay.

选项正确率统计：A选项 3%，B选项 1%，C选项 23%，D选项 71%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

宗教记录例外

(FRE 803(11)) 如果庭外陈述符合以下条件，则可以为证明其内容真实性而采纳：

  • 涉及个人或家族史（例如，出生、合法性、死亡、血统、婚姻、离婚）并且包含在宗教组织的定期保存记录中（例如，与宗教仪式相关的记录）


FRE = 《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence)。

禁止传闻证据规则禁止采纳为证明其所主张事项的真实性而提出的庭外陈述（口头、书面或非语言），除非有传闻证据的排除或例外情况适用。其中一个传闻证据的例外情况适用于符合以下条件的陈述：

  • 涉及个人或家族史并且包含在宗教组织的定期保存记录中。


这是因为此类记录通常因宗教仪式的庄严性质以及制作记录的教会职员缺乏个人利害关系而具有额外的可信度保障。

在本案中，原告试图引入教堂的婚礼登记簿（庭外陈述），以证明该名人及其第二任妻子在其中所列日期结婚。但由于婚礼登记簿涉及个人和家族史，如果该登记簿是教会定期保存记录的一部分，则属于传闻证据的例外情况——因此可以采纳为证据(选项A)。

(选项B) 宗教记录的传闻证据例外不要求证据提出方证明陈述人无法作为证人出庭。

(选项C) 教堂婚礼登记簿中的日期与确定婚姻存续期相关——这是本案的一个关键争议点。但相关证据仍可能因其他理由（如禁止传闻证据规则）而被排除。因此，婚礼登记簿只有在符合传闻证据的排除或例外情况时才能被采纳。

教学目标： 宗教组织定期保存记录中有关个人或家族史的陈述，属于禁止传闻证据规则的例外情况。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 803(11) (hearsay exception for regularly kept religious records regarding personal or family history).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay Exceptions
核心规则：FRE 803(11)

宗教组织的记录 (Records of Religious Organizations)

关于个人或家族史（如出生、婚姻、离婚、死亡等）的陈述，如果包含在宗教组织的定期保存记录 (regularly kept record) 中，则属于传闻证据的例外，可以采纳。

Step 1: 识别传闻 (Hearsay)
原告试图引入教堂的“婚礼登记簿”来证明“结婚日期”。这是一个庭外陈述 (Out-of-court statement)，且是为了证明内容真实性 (Truth of the matter asserted)。因此，它本质上是传闻。
Step 2: 寻找例外 (Exceptions)
虽然是传闻，但 FRE 803(11) 提供了一个特定的例外。
  • 内容：涉及婚姻（家族史）。
  • 来源：教堂（宗教组织）。
  • 条件：必须是“定期保存的记录”。
Step 3: 结论
只要该登记簿符合“定期保存”这一条件，它就是可采纳的证据。
选项辨析
选项 D (正确) 可以，前提是该婚礼登记簿是教会定期保存的记录的一部分。
这直接对应了 FRE 803(11) 的构成要件。宗教记录因其庄严性和缺乏作伪动机而被认为具有可信度。
选项 A (错误) 不可以，因为是传闻...
虽然是传闻，但它属于“例外情况”。MBE 中常见这种“半对半错”的选项，识别出例外是关键。
选项 B (错误) 不可以，因为没有证据表明...无法出庭。
这是一个经典的干扰项。FRE 803 下的例外（如商业记录、宗教记录、医疗诊断陈述等）不要求陈述人无法出庭 (Unavailability is immaterial)。只有 FRE 804 (如临终遗言) 才要求证人不可得。
选项 C (错误) 可以，因为...相关 (Relevant)。
“相关性”是证据可采纳的必要条件，但不是充分条件。即使证据相关，如果它是传闻且无例外适用，仍会被排除。做题时要警惕仅基于“相关性”就认为可采纳的选项。
💡 MBE 提分技巧：
看到“教堂记录”、“洗礼证书”或“家谱圣经”证明出生/婚姻日期时，立即联想 FRE 803(11) 或 (13)。切记：此类例外不需要证人“失踪”或“死亡”！

questions.question:
A plaintiff has sued a defendant, alleging that she was run over by a speeding car driven by the defendant. The plaintiff was unconscious after her injury and, accompanied by her husband, was brought to the hospital in an ambulance.
At trial, the plaintiff calls an emergency room physician to testify that when the physician asked the plaintiff's husband if he knew what had happened, the husband, who was upset, replied, "I saw my wife get run over two hours ago by a driver who went right through the intersection without looking."
Is the physician's testimony about the husband's statement admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.b: No, because it relates an opinion.
choices.c: Yes, as a statement made for purposes of diagnosis or treatment.
choices.d: Yes, as an excited utterance.

data.questionStem:
Q87056

A plaintiff has sued a defendant, alleging that she was run over by a speeding car driven by the defendant. The plaintiff was unconscious after her injury and, accompanied by her husband, was brought to the hospital in an ambulance.

At trial, the plaintiff calls an emergency room physician to testify that when the physician asked the plaintiff's husband if he knew what had happened, the husband, who was upset, replied, "I saw my wife get run over two hours ago by a driver who went right through the intersection without looking."

Is the physician's testimony about the husband's statement admissible?

一名原告起诉一名被告，指控她被被告驾驶的一辆超速行驶的汽车撞倒。原告受伤后失去知觉，在其丈夫的陪同下，被救护车送往医院。

庭审时，原告传唤一名急诊室医生作证。该医生作证称，当他询问原告丈夫是否知道发生了什么事时，情绪激动的丈夫回答说："我两小时前看到我的妻子被一个根本没看路口就直接冲过去的司机撞倒了。"

医生关于丈夫陈述的证词是否可以采纳？
options:
A. No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
不可以，因为该陈述是传闻证据，且不属于任何例外情况。

B. No, because it relates an opinion.
不可以，因为该陈述涉及意见。

C. Yes, as a statement made for purposes of diagnosis or treatment.
可以，因为该陈述是为医疗诊断或治疗目的而作出的。

D. Yes, as an excited utterance.
可以，因为该陈述属于激动言辞。
data.explanation:
An out-of-court statement offered for the truth of the matter asserted therein is inadmissible under the rule against hearsay unless it is excluded from that rule or falls within a hearsay exception. In the context of an emergency room visit (as seen here), a declarant's out-of-court statement may fall within the hearsay exception for:
  • excited utterances - statements related to a startling event or condition that are made while the declarant is still under the stress of the excitement caused by the event or condition
  • statements for medical diagnosis or treatment - statements made for and reasonably pertinent to medical diagnosis or treatment that describe the declarant's medical history, symptoms, or the inception or general cause of those symptoms.
Here, the husband made a statement to the emergency room physician two hours after seeing the wife get run over by the car. It is therefore unlikely that he was still in the state of excitement necessary for that statement to qualify as an excited utterance (Choice D). Additionally, his statement pertained more to the driver's recklessness than the wife's medical diagnosis or treatment (Choice C). And since no other hearsay exception (or exclusion) applies, testimony about the husband's statement is inadmissible.

(Choice B) The fact that an out-of-court statement relates an opinion does not automatically render it inadmissible. That is because an opinion is admissible if it is (1) rationally based on the declarant's personal knowledge, (2) helpful to understanding the declarant's statement or determining a fact in issue, and (3) excepted or excluded from the hearsay rule.

Educational objective: An out-of-court statement offered for the truth of the matter asserted therein is inadmissible unless it is excluded from the rule against hearsay or falls within a hearsay exception (eg, excited utterance, statement for medical diagnosis or treatment).



选项正确率统计：A选项 52%（正确选项），B选项 0%，C选项 26%，D选项 20%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

为证明其所述事项的真实性而提出的庭外陈述，根据反传闻证据规则是不可采纳的，除非该陈述被该规则排除或属于某一传闻证据例外。在本案急诊室就诊的情境中，陈述人的庭外陈述可能属于以下传闻证据例外：
  • 激动言辞 - 与某一令人震惊的事件或状况相关的陈述，且陈述人在作出该陈述时仍处于该事件或状况所引起的激动情绪压力之下。
  • 为医疗诊断或治疗目的而作出的陈述 - 为医疗诊断或治疗目的而作出，并与此目的合理相关的陈述，其内容描述了陈述人的病史、症状，或这些症状的起因或一般原因。
本案中，丈夫是在目睹妻子被车撞倒两小时后才向急诊室医生作出陈述的。因此，他当时很可能已不处于符合激动言辞所要求的激动状态下（选项D）。此外，他的陈述更多地是关于司机的鲁莽行为，而非其妻子的医疗诊断或治疗（选项C）。并且，由于没有其他传闻证据例外（或排除）情况适用，关于丈夫陈述的证词是不可采纳的。

（选项B） 庭外陈述涉及意见这一事实，并不自动使其变得不可采纳。这是因为，如果一项意见是（1）合理地基于陈述人的亲身认知，（2）有助于理解陈述人的陈述或确定争议事实，并且（3）属于传闻证据规则的例外或排除情况，那么该意见是可以采纳的。

教学目标：为证明其所述事项的真实性而提出的庭外陈述是不可采纳的，除非它被传闻证据规则排除或属于某一传闻证据例外（例如，激动言辞、为医疗诊断或治疗目的而作出的陈述）。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 801(c) (hearsay definition).

Fed. R. Evid. 803 (hearsay exceptions).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：传闻证据与例外

本题考察的是美国联邦证据规则（Federal Rules of Evidence, FRE）中关于传闻证据（Hearsay）及其例外（Exceptions）的细微差别。

正确答案：A
该陈述不可采纳，因为它是传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。

核心法律逻辑分析

首先，丈夫的陈述是典型的传闻证据（Hearsay）：这是一个庭外陈述（Out-of-court statement），被用来证明其内容及其所主张事项的真实性（Offered for the truth of the matter asserted），即证明司机确实没有看路。

要使该证据可采纳，必须符合传闻证据的例外。本题主要考察两个常见的例外，但它们在此处均不适用：

1. 医疗诊断或治疗例外 (Statement for Medical Diagnosis or Treatment, FRE 803(4))

虽然该规则允许采纳为诊断或治疗目的而作出的陈述，但有一个关键限制：

  • 可采纳：关于病因的一般描述（例如：“被车撞了”）。这有助于医生判断伤情。
  • 不可采纳：关于过错归属（Attribution of Fault）的陈述（例如：“司机没看路”、“司机闯红灯”）。

本案分析：丈夫说司机“没看路就冲过路口”，这属于归责陈述，对医生治疗骨折或内伤没有医疗上的帮助。因此，这部分陈述不符合该例外。

2. 激动言辞 (Excited Utterance, FRE 803(2))

该例外要求陈述是在令人震惊的事件发生后，陈述人仍处于该事件造成的压力（Stress of excitement）之下作出的。

本案分析：虽然丈夫很“沮丧（upset）”，但时间已经过去了两个小时。虽然时间不是绝对标准，但两小时通常足以让人恢复冷静并进行反思（Reflection）或编造。缺乏证据表明他在两小时内一直处于持续的极度激动状态，因此法院通常不会认定这属于激动言辞。

为什么其他选项是错误的？

选项 C 错误（医疗诊断）：
如上所述，陈述中关于“司机没看路”的部分属于归责（Fault-blaming），与医疗诊断无关。医生不需要知道司机是否疏忽大意就能治疗病人。
选项 D 错误（激动言辞）：
时间间隔（Time Gap）是关键。两小时的间隔削弱了“激动言辞”所需的自发性和缺乏反思的特性。
选项 B 错误（意见）：
虽然陈述包含意见，但这并不是其不可采纳的根本原因。普通证人（Lay Witness）基于感知的意见（Opinion based on perception）通常是允许的。它不可采纳是因为它是传闻（Hearsay）。
💡 MBE 答题技巧 在处理涉及医疗记录或医生证词的传闻题时，请务必使用“红笔测试”（Red Pencil Rule）：

想象法官拿着红笔划掉所有与“治疗”无关的内容。
✅ “我被车撞了，腿很疼” -> 保留（有助于诊断）。
❌ “那个司机是个疯子，闯了红灯” -> 划掉（这是法律责任问题，不是医学问题）。

questions.question:
A defendant is on trial for evading $100,000 in taxes. The prosecution offers in evidence an anonymous letter to the IRS, identified as being in the defendant's handwriting, saying, "I promised my mother on her deathbed I would try to pay my back taxes. Here is $10,000. I'll make other payments if you promise not to prosecute. Answer yes by personal ad saying, 'OK on tax deal.'"
Is the letter admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is an effort to settle a claim.
choices.b: No, because the probative value is substantially outweighed by the risk of unfair prejudice.
choices.c: Yes, as a statement of present intention or plan.
choices.d: Yes, as an admission of a party-opponent.

data.questionStem:
Q87044

A defendant is on trial for evading $100,000 in taxes. The prosecution offers in evidence an anonymous letter to the IRS, identified as being in the defendant's handwriting, saying, "I promised my mother on her deathbed I would try to pay my back taxes. Here is $10,000. I'll make other payments if you promise not to prosecute. Answer yes by personal ad saying, 'OK on tax deal.'"

Is the letter admissible?

一名被告因逃税10万美元而受审。控方提交了一封写给美国国税局（IRS）的匿名信作为证据，该信经鉴定为被告笔迹，内容如下：“我在母亲临终前向她承诺，我会尽力补缴我欠的税款。这里是1万美元。如果你承诺不起诉，我还会支付其他款项。请以个人广告形式回复‘同意税务交易’表示同意。”

这封信可采纳为证据吗？
options:
A. No, because it is an effort to settle a claim.
不可以，因为这是为了和解一项请求权。

B. No, because the probative value is substantially outweighed by the risk of unfair prejudice.
不可以，因为其证据价值被不公正偏见的风险实质性地超过了。

C. Yes, as a statement of present intention or plan.
可以，因为它是一项关于当前意图或计划的陈述。

D. Yes, as an admission of a party-opponent.
可以，因为它属于对方当事人的承认。
data.explanation:
Nonhearsay statements


(FRE 801(d))
Out-of-court statement admissible if witness subject to cross-examination & prior statement:
Statement by declarant-witness
  • is inconsistent with current testimony & was made under penalty of perjury
  • is consistent with current testimony & offered to (1) rebut charge of fabrication/improper influence or (2) rehabilitate witness or
  • identifies person witness perceived earlier
Out-of-court statement admissible if offered against opposing party & statement was:
Statement by party-opponent
  • made or adopted by party
  • made by person authorized by party
  • made by party's agent/employee on matter within scope of relationship or
  • made by party's coconspirator during & in furtherance of conspiracy
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Under the rule against hearsay, an out-of-court statement (eg, the defendant's letter to the IRS) offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein (eg, the defendant owed back taxes) is generally inadmissible. But certain statements are excluded from this rule and are therefore considered nonhearsay. One exclusion applies to statements made by and offered against an opposing party. As a result, the letter to the IRS written by the defendant and offered against the defendant at trial is admissible.

(Choice A) Statements made during settlement or plea negotiations are generally inadmissible because public policy encourages the settlement of disputes. But for this rule to apply, both parties must intend to enter such negotiations (not seen here). And in a criminal case, the statements must be made to a prosecutor - not a government agency (as seen here).

(Choice B) Relevant evidence may be excluded if its probative value is substantially outweighed by the risk of unfair prejudice - eg, that the jury will decide the case based only on emotion. Here, the letter is highly probative because it concerns the central issue in the case - whether the defendant evaded taxes. And since the letter poses no danger of unfair prejudice, this is not a basis for excluding it.

(Choice C) Statements of present intention or plan fall under the then-existing mental state exception to the rule against hearsay. Here, the defendant's promise was contingent upon the IRS promising not to prosecute so it likely is not a statement of plan. But this hearsay exception is unnecessary to admit that statement since it is nonhearsay.

Educational objective:

Statements made by and offered against an opposing party are excluded from the rule against hearsay.

选项正确率统计：A选项 27%，B选项 5%，C选项 11%，D选项 54%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

非传闻陈述


（联邦证据规则FRE 801(d)）
庭外陈述在以下情况下可采纳：证人可接受交叉询问，且先前的陈述：
陈述人-证人的陈述
  • 与当前证词不一致，且是在伪证罪处罚的宣誓下作出的
  • 与当前证词一致，且提出该陈述是为了 (1) 反驳关于捏造/不正当影响的指控，或 (2) 恢复证人的可信度 或者
  • 指认了证人早前感知到的人
庭外陈述在以下情况下可采纳：为反驳对方当事人而提出，且该陈述是：
对方当事人的陈述
  • 由该当事人作出或采纳的
  • 由该当事人授权的人作出的
  • 由该当事人的代理人/雇员在代理/雇佣关系范围内就相关事项作出的 或者
  • 由该当事人的共谋者在共谋期间且为促进共谋而作出的
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》（Federal Rule of Evidence）。

根据反传闻证据规则，为证明其所述事项（例如，被告拖欠税款）的真实性而提出的庭外陈述（例如，被告写给IRS的信）通常不予采纳。但是，某些陈述被排除在该规则之外，因此被视为非传闻陈述。其中一项排除适用于由对方当事人作出并用以反驳该当事人的陈述。因此，这封由被告撰写、并在审判中用以反驳被告的致IRS的信件是可采纳的。

(选项A) 在和解或辩诉协商期间作出的陈述通常不予采纳，因为公共政策鼓励争议的和解。但要适用此规则，双方必须均有进行此类协商的意图（本案中未见）。而且在刑事案件中，陈述必须向检察官作出——而不是向政府机构作出（如本案所示）。

(选项B) 如果相关证据的证据价值被不公正偏见的风险（例如，陪审团仅凭情感裁决案件）实质性地超过，则该证据可能被排除。在本案中，这封信具有很高的证据价值，因为它关系到案件的核心问题——被告是否逃税。由于该信件并未带来不公正偏见的危险，因此这不能成为排除它的理由。

(选项C) 关于当前意图或计划的陈述属于反传闻证据规则中“当时存在的精神状态”的例外情况。在本案中，被告的承诺取决于IRS承诺不起诉，因此这很可能不是一个关于计划的陈述。但由于该陈述属于非传闻陈述，因此无需利用此传闻证据的例外规定来采纳它。

教学目标：

由对方当事人作出并用以反驳该当事人的陈述，被排除在反传闻证据规则之外。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 801(d)(2) (nonhearsay - statement by party-opponent).
